Responsibilities:

  • Leading and developing the LATAM & Canada financial regulatory legal team by enabling the team to focus on critical matters for the business, while efficiently and effectively supporting routine business matters.
  • Providing direct regulatory legal advice for operations in Mexico while coordinating and supervising wider regulatory legal work across the the Americas (excluding the U.S.).
  • Supporting strong relationships with LATAM regulators, including the Central Bank of Mexico (BANXICO), the National Banking and Securities Commission of Mexico (CNBV), the National Anti-Monopoly Commission (CNA).
  • Maintaining corporate governance for PayPal LATAM entities.
  • Monitoring and advising on new and emerging legal and regulatory developments impacting Mexico operations, including identifying trends and potential impacts on business activities.
  • Collaborating with legal and business colleagues across PayPal globally on the resolution of regulatory legal issues.
  • Partnering with Compliance and Risk Management on AML/CTF or other compliance matters.
  • Providing financial regulatory legal advice in support of existing operations and business expansion opportunities for other markets, as necessary.

Skills & Experience: Candidates for this position should be able to demonstrate experience and competence with the following.

  • Deep, demonstrable financial services regulatory and contract negotiation skills and expertise, with an emphasis on payments laws, including the Mexican Fintech Law and the Payment Network Rules and regulations. 
  • Experience with oversight by and engagement with the CNBV, BANXICO and other regulators in LATAM.
  • Familiarity with, and strong interest in, financial services technology, mobile and alternative payments, as well as emerging technology.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and tolerate change and ambiguity.
  • Global thinker and demonstrated collaborator, who displays risk-based and pragmatic legal and business judgment in providing practical advice to clients on privacy and data protection issues.
  • Ability to translate legal advice into actionable policies, processes, and programs that enable business objectives.
  • Facility with a team-based approach to subject matter management and knowledge sharing, and comfort with a flexible, agile environment that emphasizes collaboration and team performance over management hierarchy. 
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively manage, coach, and mentor others and work with a sense of humor and resiliency, especially under tight deadlines and while managing multiple priorities.
  • Mature, self-motivated, independent, and well-organized with excellent interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Business acumen, strategic and creative thinking, strong project leadership, communication skills, and multi-tasking capabilities.

Qualifications: In addition to the above Skills & Experience, candidates should possess the following qualifications.

  • 10 or more years of experience practicing in-house (or in an equivalent setting) and/or at a reputable law firm.
  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent degree.  Admitted to practice law in Mexico.
  • Exceptional writing skills, with attention to detail and ability to generate creative, original drafting and documents.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to communicate and help non-experts understand applicable regulations and requirements.
  • Experience advising clients in the financial services, mobile payments, internet and technology industries preferred.

Job Summary:

Paidy is seeking a Manager, Risk Management. This role sits within PayPal’s Global Credit & Fraud Strategy and Governance organization and provides governance and control oversight across strategies supporting Paidy and PayPal’s lending products. The role partners with Strategy, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and SLOD to lead new and revised strategies through governance review and approval, ensuring key risks, controls, and mitigation plans are assessed and documented. It supports post-implementation monitoring and maintains strategy governance policies and procedures. The role also supports model governance by taking new models and material model changes through required reviews and approvals, coordinating with Model Development, Legal, Compliance, and Model Risk Management. It supports ongoing model monitoring, identifies performance deterioration or emerging risks, and coordinates remediation or escalation. The role also supports audit, regulatory, and partner governance requests.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Identify issues and recommend best practices for risk management within the organization.
  • Lead functional projects and programs that enhance risk assessment and mitigation efforts.
  • Collaborate with teams to analyze business trends and their implications for risk management.
  • Contribute to process improvements that enhance the effectiveness of risk management strategies.
  • Provide guidance and support to team members in executing risk management initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Lead Strategy Proposals through Governance Review and Approval
    Coordinate end-to-end governance reviews for new or revised strategic proposals, ensuring alignment with PayPal’s governance standards and control framework. Facilitate discussions with key stakeholders and present proposals in designated committee forums for review and approval. Maintain clear documentation of decisions and follow-up actions.

  • Lead Model Governance Review, Approval, and Support Ongoing Model Monitoring
    Coordinate end-to-end governance reviews for new models and material model changes, partnering with Model Development, Legal, Compliance, SLOD Model Risk Management, and other stakeholders to ensure applicable governance requirements are completed prior to implementation. Support ongoing model monitoring by reviewing model performance and key risk indicators, identifying performance deterioration or emerging risks, and coordinating appropriate remediation, escalation, and governance actions.

  • Lead and Support the Creation of Policies and Procedures
    Collaborate with stakeholders to develop and refine governance-related policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure these documents accurately reflect the current strategic framework, risk expectations, and compliance requirements. Drive updates and consistency across all strategy governance artifacts.

  • Ensure Strategic Proposals Align with Risk Appetite
    Partner with Strategy, Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams to assess whether proposed strategies operate within PayPal’s approved risk appetite. Identify potential risks, define mitigation plans, and escalate any deviations through appropriate governance channels for resolution and approval.

  • Monitor Strategy Performance and Effectiveness
    Track the execution and performance of approved strategies to verify they are delivering intended outcomes while remaining compliant with regulatory and internal control expectations. Report performance insights and emerging risks to leadership and relevant governance committees.

  • Maintain Strategies, Policies, and Procedures
    Oversee the repository of strategic documents, policies, and procedures, ensuring all materials remain current, version-controlled, and aligned with the latest strategic and governance requirements. Coordinate periodic reviews to maintain relevance and accuracy.

  • Support Internal and External Audit Activities
    Serve as a liaison for audit requests related to strategy governance, ensuring timely, complete, and accurate responses. Coordinate with internal teams to provide evidence, documentation, and clarification to auditors. Implement corrective actions or control enhancements as needed based on audit findings.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on VP, Corporate Controller to lead our global accounting and financial reporting organization as we continue to scale. The VP, Corporate Controller is a senior finance leader responsible for the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of the company's external and internal financial reporting. This individual will oversee SEC reporting, serve as a key partner to Investor Relations, set global technical accounting policy, own sustainability/ESG reporting, and provide oversight across product accounting, credit accounting, and operating expense/corporate cost accounting teams. This role requires a leader who can operate at both the strategic and technical level, translating complex accounting matters into clear guidance for the business, the Board, and external stakeholders.

Job Description:

Specific responsibilities include:

SEC Reporting & External Financial Reporting

  • Own the preparation, review, and filing of all SEC reports, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and proxy statements, ensuring compliance with SEC rules, GAAP, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Manage the quarterly and annual close and external reporting calendar, coordinating cross-functionally with Legal, Investor Relations, and external auditors.
  • Serve as primary liaison with external auditors on financial statement audits, quarterly reviews, and technical accounting matters.
  • Maintain and enhance disclosure controls and procedures, and support management's assessment of internal control over financial reporting (SOX/ICFR).
  • Partner closely with Investor Relations on earnings releases, earnings call materials, investor presentations, and non-GAAP reconciliations.
  • Provide technical accounting and financial reporting expertise to support investor and analyst inquiries.
  • Support preparation of Board and Audit Committee materials related to financial performance and reporting matters.

Technical Accounting & Global Policy

  • Set and maintain global technical accounting policies and procedures, ensuring consistent application across all business units and geographies.
  • Research and document accounting positions for complex and emerging transactions (e.g., revenue recognition, credit losses/CECL, business combinations, equity, new products).
  • Monitor emerging accounting standards (FASB/IASB) and lead impact assessments and implementation efforts for new pronouncements.
  • Provide accounting guidance and training to business partners and finance teams globally.

Sustainability / ESG Reporting

  • Own the company's sustainability and ESG reporting function, including data governance, controls, and disclosure in alignment with evolving regulatory frameworks (e.g., SEC climate disclosure rules, CSRD, ISSB/IFRS S1 & S2, GRI).
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Legal, Risk, Sustainability, Operations) to ensure accurate collection, validation, and reporting of ESG metrics.
  • Build scalable controls and processes over sustainability data comparable to financial reporting rigor.

Accounting Oversight

Provide oversight and leadership to the following functional teams:

  • Accounting for the company's processing products and platforms, credit products, credit allowances/CECL reserving and operating expenses, including partnering closely with the Company’s finance teams to understand and explain variances versus last year, forecast and budget.
  • Support the Company’s US Bank information, including with accounting shared services.
  • Oversee preparation and review of the consolidated balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement.
  • Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across close and reporting processes.
  • Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing global accounting organization; manage senior accounting leaders across each functional area.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • Active CPA license
  • 12+ years of progressive accounting/finance experience, including significant time in public accounting (Big 4 preferred) and public company corporate accounting/reporting
  • Deep expertise in US GAAP and SEC reporting requirements; public company reporting experience required
  • Experience with financial services, fintech, or payments industry accounting matters (e.g., credit losses, CECL, financial instruments)
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with Investor Relations and supporting external communications
  • Experience building or maturing ESG/sustainability reporting programs
  • Strong people leadership experience managing multiple accounting functions/teams, including global teams
  • Excellent communication skills with experience presenting to executive leadership, Audit Committee, and Board

Preferred

  • Prior experience as a Controller, Chief Accounting Officer, or similar senior reporting leader at a multi-billion dollar public company
  • Experience with ERP and reporting systems (e.g., Oracle, SAP, Workday, NetSuite) and financial close/consolidation tools (e.g., OneStream, Blackline, HFM)
  • MBA or advanced degree
  • Experience with international/multi-entity consolidations

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership: Ability to shape accounting strategy and build organization for future state, not just manage day-to-day
  • Operational Excellence: Drive process improvements, build controls, and ensure consistency across large organizations
  • Business Acumen: Understand business drivers, think strategically about how accounting can enable growth, and partner effectively with business leaders
  • Technical Depth: Deep expertise in GAAP, SEC reporting, revenue recognition, consolidations, and complex accounting standards
  • Change Leadership: Comfortable driving transformation, building buy-in, and moving teams through significant organizational change
  • People Development: Demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and retain strong talent; coach people through challenges
  • Communication: Clear communicator who can explain complex accounting topics to non-finance audiences; comfort presenting to executive leadership
  • Problem Solving: Solutions-oriented mindset; comfort jumping into ambiguous situations and driving clarity and resolution

Job Summary:

As a Senior Product Security Engineer at PayPal, you'll help secure 439M accounts and $1.8T in annual payment volume by designing, building, and operating automated security scanners and developer guardrails across the software development lifecycle. Partnering with engineering, platform, and security teams, you'll identify and reduce risk across source code, open source dependencies, secrets, software supply chains, AI/LLM tools, and other developer workflows.

Our team's mission is to make secure development the easiest path for engineers, building scanners and guardrails that catch risk before software reaches production — spanning source code, dependencies, supply chains, AI/LLM tools, edge/CDN environments, and developer workflows. You'll turn security requirements into reliable automation that meets engineers where they build and deploy, improving detection quality and remediation ease while supporting delivery speed, with impact reaching adjacent teams.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Independently apply security best practices to enhance and optimize systems, ensuring robust protection and efficiency, while beginning to understand and align security solutions with business objectives.
  • Partner with peers and internal teams to drive security initiatives, contribute to cross-functional projects, and at times co-lead efforts to strengthen security posture.
  • Analyze and resolve security challenges by adapting standard processes and exploring alternative approaches to address complex threats.
  • Influence the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the team through informed decision-making, with a potential impact on other teams.
  • Collaborate with other engineers to gather and incorporate feedback, driving continuous improvements in security processes.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SLSA, software bills of materials (SBOMs), provenance, artifact signing or verification, package repositories, or dependency governance. 

  • Experience creating or tuning rules for static analysis, secrets detection, or policy-as-code systems. 

  • Familiarity with security considerations for AI/LLM development tools, AI-assisted coding, or model and tool supply chains. 

  • Experience with GCP, complemented by hands-on expertise with Kubernetes, Terraform, and other cloud-native technologies. 

  • Familiarity in other programming and scripting languages, such as Java and Javascript, with the ability to troubleshoot code

Job Summary:

As a Staff Product Security Engineer, AI Security at PayPal, you’ll help protect 439M active accounts and $1.8T in annual total payment volume by providing technical leadership across three areas: securing AI-assisted software development, protecting AI-enabled products and agentic systems, and applying AI to improve vulnerability detection and remediation. You’ll partner with Security Architecture, engineering, product, and platform teams to translate AI security requirements into scalable controls, testing, and enforcement across PayPal’s products and business units. Through hands-on technical leadership and mentorship, you’ll turn emerging risks into durable capabilities and measurable risk reduction.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Leverage specialized security expertise to identify and resolve complex security issues, recommending best practices and determining new approaches that have an impact on broader security operations, while aligning security strategies with business priorities
  • Partner across teams and key stakeholders to drive security initiatives, leading and solutioning complex projects and programs to strengthen overall security posture.
  • Apply advanced analytical skills and sound judgment to solve security challenges, considering diverse perspectives and innovative solutions. Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, understanding their security implications to the company’s context.
  • Directly contribute to improvements within the security domain and occasionally beyond, ensuring decisions lead to meaningful enhancements in security practices.
  • Leverage relationships across teams, both within and outside of security, to influence initiatives and integrate feedback into security processes.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and execution of Product Security’s technical roadmap for AI security controls and assurance, partnering with Security Architecture to translate requirements into scalable engineering capabilities.
  • Design, implement, and operate controls for AI-assisted software development, including security review of AI-generated code, security context and constraints for coding agents, automated testing, and risk-based enforcement.
  • Conduct and lead security reviews of AI-enabled applications and their models, agents, retrieval systems, data flows, and external tool integrations.
  • Create controls for agent identity, least privilege, tool access, execution isolation, human approval, and interruption of unsafe behavior.
  • Design and help implement security controls for AI models, agents, toolsets, datasets, and pipelines.
  • Develop runtime monitoring, auditability, detection, containment, and incident-response requirements for AI systems, including visibility into agent actions, tool calls, and sensitive-data access.
  • Build and scale AI-driven capabilities for vulnerability discovery, validation, prioritization, and remediation across teams and engineering workflows.
  • Partner with AI platform and cloud engineering teams to integrate security across AI infrastructure, platforms, and workloads.
  • Help establish security criteria for evaluating, onboarding, integrating, and periodically reassessing third-party models, AI services, APIs, and developer tools.
  • Develop methods and metrics for evaluating AI security risk, control effectiveness, remediation performance, and adoption across teams.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex AI security issues and lead architectural reviews following significant incidents or control failures.
  • Mentor security and engineering professionals, deliver targeted technical guidance, and help teams apply AI security controls across diverse technology stacks.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, application security, product security, or cybersecurity, including leadership of complex security initiatives spanning multiple teams or technology platforms.
  • Deep knowledge of application security vulnerabilities, secure software development practices, and technical controls used to identify, prevent, and remediate software risk.
  • Hands-on experience securing AI systems.
  • Strong software-engineering experience building and operating production security tooling, automation, platform services, or developer-facing capabilities.
  • Track record of partnering with developers to implement robust security controls.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and senior stakeholder audiences.
  • Experience designing and operating security controls across cloud environments, CI/CD systems, and diverse application and infrastructure stacks.
  • Experience mentoring and developing engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on familiarity with application security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, WAF, Burp Suite).
  • Strong programming experience in at least one language such as Ruby, Java, Python, JavaScript, or Swift.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform, and version control systems such as Git.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud vendor (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).

What you need to know about the role

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with cross-organizational scope. You will help set technical direction, lead delivery, and mentor engineers while remaining directly involved in architecture reviews, control design, implementation, and technical problem-solving.

Meet our team

Our mission is to embed security into every phase of the product development lifecycle, recognizing that security promotes quality engineering. We strive to create a culture of security by empowering teams to take responsibility for securing their own code and environments. We do this by providing leaders and engineers with the visibility, tools, guidance, training, and support needed to create secure products and systems. We prevent, identify, and respond to critical vulnerabilities within our ecosystem, driving response to limit potential impact to the business.

Your way to impact

Your work will reduce the likelihood that AI-assisted development introduces exploitable vulnerabilities and that AI-enabled systems misuse sensitive data, tools, or business actions. You will also improve PayPal’s ability to detect, validate, and remediate software vulnerabilities at scale.

Your day-to-day

Your work will vary across hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and cross-functional program delivery. Typical activities may include:

  • Reviewing an AI architecture, threat model, or agent workflow and identifying material security risks.
  • Designing, prototyping, or integrating an AI security control into a product, shared platform, or engineering workflow.
  • Evaluating results from AI security scanners, adversarial tests, and runtime monitoring to determine required engineering action.
  • Partnering with developers and platform teams to resolve complex design or implementation issues.
  • Analyzing control coverage, effectiveness, adoption, and incident findings to determine program priorities.
  • Mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions that span multiple teams or organizational boundaries.

  • Perform hands-on testing of web applications, mobile applications, APIs, and internal infrastructure.

  • Perform network penetration testing and segmentation testing across internal, external, and cloud network environments.

  • Perform cloud penetration testing across cloud service provider environments, assessing configuration weaknesses, identity and access issues, and privilege escalation paths.

  • Review and validate potential vulnerabilities identified through AI assisted code reviews and other automated security tools.

  • Reproduce findings and assess exploitability, business impact, severity, remediation priority, and whether a finding is a false positive.

  • Communicate findings with clear context, reproduction steps, attack scenarios, and practical remediation guidance.

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This job focuses on establishing a unified vision for PayPal's crypto and stablecoin product portfolio and leading its strategic development with cross-functional teams. It shapes the roadmap to balance innovation, regulatory requirements, and profitability while prioritizing customer and merchant experience across digital asset products. The position uses metrics from usability studies, on-chain data, and market analysis to inform decisions and standardizes workstreams for data-driven insights. It also oversees product profitability and manages a team of product managers to enhance collaboration in a dynamic, fast-evolving digital asset environment.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Establish a shared vision across the company for a portfolio of products, or platform products enabling development & scalability, with a deliberate and cohesive strategy.
  • Leads product strategy development, and develops a clear, executable view of the product portfolio strategy with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Shapes the architectural roadmap and balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Champions the customer experience and prioritizes customer needs in product requirements and decision making.
  • Defines and uses metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Standardizes workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Responsible for product portfolio profitability, including budgetary decisions.
  • Leads operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with senior leadership as needed.
  • Maximizes efficiency in a constantly evolving environment where the process is fluid and creative solutions are the standard.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5 years of experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Role-Specific Experience & Capabilities

  • Deep fintech and crypto/digital asset expertise required, with demonstrated experience building and scaling products in regulated financial services and digital asset environments.
  • Experience leading product strategy and roadmaps across crypto and stablecoin products, including areas such as stablecoins, custody, on/off-ramps, payment rails, network expansion, and digital asset infrastructure.
  • Strong working knowledge of stablecoins, crypto infrastructure, and the regulatory landscape governing digital assets, with the ability to balance innovation, regulatory requirements, time-to-market, and product profitability.
  • Deep understanding of customer and merchant needs for digital asset products, including trust, transparency, and ease of use.
  • Experience using on-chain and transaction data, customer insights, market research, and competitive analysis to inform product strategy and decision-making.
  • Experience managing portfolio economics and investment tradeoffs across areas such as network, liquidity, and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, and Risk, and communicate portfolio strategy, performance, and priorities to senior leadership.

It also oversees product profitability and manages a team of product managers to enhance collaboration in a dynamic environment. This job is an individual contributor.

  • Leads product strategy development, and develops a clear, executable view of the product portfolio strategy with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • 5 years of experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Department: Payments Operations & Strategy, PayPal EU

Reports to: VP, Payments, PayPal Inc. — with dual accountability to the Luxembourg entity's Management Board on CSSF-supervised matters


About the Role

PayPal is seeking a Senior Director of Payments Operations and Strategy to lead payments operations and strategic direction for PayPal Europe, with a particular focus on the SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area) ecosystem. Based in Luxembourg, home of PayPal's EU-regulated entity, this leader will be accountable for the performance, resilience, and strategic evolution of SEPA-based payment flows — including SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT), SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst), and SEPA Direct Debit (SDD Core and B2B) — across PayPal's European customer and merchant base.


This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of payments strategy, regulatory operations, and cross-border execution, requiring close partnership with PayPal's EU regulatory, compliance, and banking stakeholders, as well as global Payments, Product, and Engineering teams. The role carries direct accountability for ensuring PayPal Europe's SEPA operations meet European Payments Council (EPC) scheme rules, and the operational expectations of the CSSF (Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier) as PayPal's EU competent authority.


Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the strategic roadmap for PayPal Europe's SEPA payment operations, including SCT, SCT Inst, and SDD, aligned to broader EU payments strategy and PayPal's global payments architecture.
  • Represent PayPal Europe's payments strategy in engagements with the European Payments Council, EBA CLEARING, national SEPA associations, and correspondent/agent banks.
  • Anticipate and plan for regulatory and scheme evolution, including PSD3/PSR, the SEPA Instant mandate, Instant Payments Regulation compliance deadlines, and IBAN/name-check (Verification of Payee) requirements — including the EU-mandated rollout timeline extending VoP coverage from SCT to SCT Inst transactions.
  • Build business cases for expanding instant payments coverage, reducing settlement risk, and optimizing SEPA-related processing costs across EU markets.
  • Act as the senior payments voice within PayPal Europe's leadership team, based out of the Luxembourg entity.

Operations Management

  • Own end-to-end SEPA operations: credit transfer and direct debit processing, settlement, reconciliation, R-transaction (returns, refusals, rejects, reversals, refunds) handling, and exception management.
  • Define and monitor KPIs specific to SEPA performance: SCT Inst success/settlement times, SDD mandate and dispute rates, R-transaction volumes, ISO 20022 message-quality/straight-through processing rates, and incident mean-time-to-resolution.
  • Ensure operational resilience and business continuity for SEPA payment rails, including incident management, root-cause resolution for payment disruptions, and a defined on-call/escalation rotation for the Luxembourg-based operations team.
  • Oversee relationships with PayPal's SEPA settlement and correspondent banks, clearing and settlement mechanisms (e.g., EBA CLEARING's STEP2, RT1), and payment infrastructure providers.
  • Maintain fluency in ISO 20022 XML messaging standards underlying SEPA schemes, and oversee the operational impact of any scheme-mandated messaging changes.

Regulatory, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure PayPal Europe's SEPA operations comply with EPC rulebooks (SCT, SCT Inst, SDD Core, SDD B2B), PSD2 (and forthcoming PSD3/PSR), the Instant Payments Regulation, and CSSF supervisory expectations.
  • Partner with PayPal's EU Compliance, Legal, and Regulatory Affairs teams on regulatory reporting, audits, and supervisory reviews conducted by or on behalf of the CSSF.
  • Own SEPA-related AML/CFT operational controls in partnership with Financial Crimes Compliance, including sanctions and verification-of-payee (VoP) requirements.
  • Manage mandate management, dispute, and chargeback frameworks for SDD in line with scheme rules and consumer protection obligations across EU member states.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage and negotiate relationships with SEPA-participating banks, payment infrastructure vendors, and clearing and settlement providers.
  • Monitor vendor and bank partner SLAs, driving accountability for settlement timeliness, cost, and service quality.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for SEPA operational issues involving external banking and infrastructure partners.

Team Leadership

  • Potential to lead a team in the future
  • Foster close collaboration with PayPal's global Payments Operations organization to ensure European SEPA strategy is integrated with worldwide payments initiatives.
  • Establish career development pathways and succession planning as the Luxembourg-based team scales.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to influence platform roadmaps supporting SEPA Instant adoption, Verification of Payee, and future scheme changes.
  • Work with Finance on SEPA-related cost forecasting, settlement account management, and liquidity planning.
  • Collaborate with Customer Experience and Merchant Services teams to reduce friction in SEPA-based transactions for EU consumers and merchants.

Qualifications

Required

  • 15+ years of experience in payments, fintech, or banking operations, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles (Director-level or above, leading multi-market or multi-team operations).
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of SEPA schemes — SCT, SCT Inst, SDD Core and B2B — including EPC rulebooks and EBA CLEARING/national clearing infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of EU payments regulation: PSD2 (and awareness of PSD3/PSR developments), the Instant Payments Regulation, and CSSF/EU regulatory supervisory expectations.
  • Proven experience managing bank and clearing/settlement partner relationships within the SEPA zone.
  • Demonstrated success building and leading payments operations teams at scale, ideally within a regulated EU financial institution or EMI/PI.
  • Strong analytical and executive communication skills, with experience presenting to EU-regulated entity leadership and/or the Luxembourg management board.
  • Fluent English required; French, German, or Luxembourgish language skills are a plus given the Luxembourg base and pan-European remit.
  • Willingness to travel within the EU (estimated 15–25%) for engagements with EPC, EBA CLEARING, national SEPA associations, and correspondent/agent banks.
  • Eligible to work in Luxembourg; role is subject to standard financial-services background screening (identity, employment history, and financial/regulatory checks) consistent with CSSF-supervised entity requirements.

Preferred

  • Direct experience operating within a PayPal (Europe) S.à r.l. et Cie, S.C.A.–type regulated entity or similar EU e-money/payment institution supervised by the CSSF or an equivalent EU regulator.
  • Advanced degree in Finance, Business, or a related field (MBA a plus).

Why Luxembourg

Luxembourg is home to PayPal's EU-regulated entity and serves as PayPal's European headquarters for regulatory and payments operations. This role offers the opportunity to shape how PayPal serves millions of European consumers and merchants through SEPA rails, working at the center of PayPal's EU regulatory and payments infrastructure.

Job Summary:

The Global Accounts Sr Account Manager will own the responsibility of expanding the commercial relationships with some of PayPal’s largest partners globally. Responsibilities will include owning the overall strategy & commercial goals for these partnerships with focus on developing a pipeline of value-based opportunities & fostering new strategic relationships.

The ideal candidate will possess :
• a combination of experience (Sales/BD/Product) allowing for effective engagement with key partners at several levels.
• a demonstrated ability to think strategically about new business models, product integrations, and technical challenges

The position also requires experience working for corporations in China, with related institutional knowledge & Mandarin language competency, so as to effectively communicate with these partners at executive levels and grow these partnerships.

  • Negotiate or renegotiate favorable commercial terms, contracts and agreements that create sustainable, long-term value for all parties. 
  • Close collaboration with internal stakeholders across PayPal Inc. globally such as product specialists, integration engineers, finance, pricing, legal, risk, sales operations, marketing and other teams as appropriate to achieve target results. 
  • Accelerate results through superior pipeline management, up-to-date pipeline reporting, navigating internal and external product roadmaps, and influencing resource allocation.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to manage pipelines, accurately forecast revenue, and report on sales activities and outcomes.
  • Leverage competitive and industry insights to refine account strategies and influence PayPal’s broader business initiatives.

  • Identify opportunities to increase PayPal’s share of checkout and influence merchants to adopt recommended optimization strategies that will increase overall PayPal awareness.
  • Prepare and give business reviews to PayPal and partner senior leadership.
  • Inspire collaboration, adaptability, and continuous learning within the team to deliver exceptional outcomes for merchants and PayPal.

Job Summary:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the roadmap for Braintree's mobile SDKs on iOS and Android. You'll work closely with merchants and developers from solo sellers to enterprise Braintree teams to deeply understand where mobile integration experiences fall short and where opportunities exist.
You'll track mobile trends, developer frameworks, and how our SDKs compare to the market. You'll drive decisions through real A/B testing and ensure full instrumentation to trace the merchant journey from SDK integration through backend processing.
As developer behavior shifts toward AI coding assistants and LLMs, you'll stay ahead of how these tools interact with our SDKs, ensuring our documentation and tooling evolve accordingly.
Day-to-day, you'll own standups, sprint planning, and roadmap sessions while partnering closely with engineering and contributing to cross-functional initiatives.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Uses data to build insights on product or platform requirements consistent with the shared vision for the product.
  • Gathers insights from the customer experience and customer needs to input to product requirements
  • Analyzes research, market analysis and usability studies, research and market analysis to support data-driven decision making
  • Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong experience with JIRA/Confluence.
  • 5 years of Mobile (iOS/Swift and Android/Kotlin) product management experience.
  • Working experience with SQL and data visualization tools (Tableau/Microsoft Excel/Power BI/DataViz).
  • Nice to have: Mobile SDK (as opposed to app) experience specifically.
  • Nice to have: API experience.
  • Nice to have hands-on familiarity with how LLMs and AI coding assistants are changing developer integration,e.g. Model Context Protocol (MCP), context/plugin patterns, or AI-assisted documentation

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Braintree's iOS and Android SDKs
  • Maintain and manage Jira project timelines.
  • Keep epics healthy, up to date, and clearly scoped to ensure the team stays aligned and on track toward delivery milestones.
  • Partner closely with engineering and developer relations to prioritize features, drive SDK releases, and keep the developer experience strong.
  • Write and maintain integration guides and developer documentation - External and internal documentation.
  • Make sure our documentation works for humans and for the AI coding agents reading it, too. That means writing in Markdown, structuring content so an LLM can find and cite the right information, and helping build out MCP servers so agents can pull accurate context directly rather than hallucinating it.
  • Keep track of how developers are actually using AI coding assistants and LLMs to integrate our SDKs, and how quickly frontier model capabilities are advancing, so we're building for where integration is headed, not just where it's been.
  • Gather and synthesize feedback from merchants, partners, and internal stakeholders to identify gaps and opportunities across payment methods (local payment methods, etc.).
  • Define and track success metrics around SDK adoption, integration health, and related metrics (work in progress).
  • Stay current on mobile platform changes (iOS/Android OS updates, app store policies) and proactively ensure SDK compatibility and compliance.
  • Collaborate with internal product managers across workstreams to evaluate, prioritize, and shepherd cross-functional asks.
  • Help prioritize work across the mobile SDK roadmap and drive major SDK version releases.
  • Own go-to-market for what you ship: not just announcing new features, but building the actual launch plan, lining up docs, sample code, and enablement content, briefing sales and support so they can speak to it, and tracking whether it actually moves adoption after launch

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

PayPal Ads is seeking an experienced Channel Partner Lead to drive growth in its expanding Ads business. In this role, you will own the relationships with key publishers and channel partners, enabling them to sell the combination of their own supply with PayPal's audiences. You will work hand-in-hand with partner teams and partner sales organizations — arming them with the positioning, tools, and support they need to successfully bring this combined offering to market and drive revenue.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead a team of Ad Sales professionals across a region or vertical
  • Set sales targets and manage performance metrics
  • Develop and maintain executive-level client relationships
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to shape go-to market strategy
  • Identify new revenue opportunities and market expansion strategies
  • Leverage ad platforms and attribution tools to measure ROI and advise on optimization

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Additional Responsibilities 

  • Own and grow strategic relationships with publishers and channel partners, positioning the combination of partner supply and PayPal audiences as a differentiated offering in market. 

  • Develop and execute a partnership roadmap that expands the number of partners actively selling this combined supply-plus-audience offering. 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for partner teams, providing ongoing enablement, training, and go-to-market support to help their organizations sell effectively. 

  • Directly support partners' sales teams — through joint pitches, deal support, and pipeline reviews — to ensure the partnership translates into closed revenue. 

  • Collaborate with internal teams to align advertiser goals with partner supply and audience-matching strategies. 

  • Analyze market trends and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for differentiated, jointly-sold capabilities. 

  • Track and report on partnership performance, with a focus on revenue production, partner sales activity, and pipeline health. 

  • Negotiate contracts and commercial terms that support a sustainable, mutually beneficial revenue-sharing model. 

  • Collaborate seamlessly with Legal, Privacy, Product, AdOps, Sales, Marketing, and other key teams to remove friction from partner selling motions. 
     

Preferred Requirements 

  • 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or sales within the advertising industry. 

  • Strong understanding of the advertising ecosystem, including Platforms, Publishers, and supply-side dynamics. 

  • Demonstrated experience enabling partner or channel sales teams — not just closing deals directly, but equipping others to sell successfully. 

  • Proven ability to build and nurture relationships with high-level stakeholders, including partner sales leadership. 

  • Excellent negotiation, analytical, and communication skills. 

  • Successful track record working in highly matrixed organizations. 

  • Strong understanding of the programmatic advertising ecosystem, including publisher monetization and auction dynamics. 

  • Experience structuring and negotiating unique supply-and-audience partnerships that partner sales teams can take to market. 

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decisions across all levels of an organization, including within partner companies.

Job Summary:

PayPal Ads is building the next generation of digital media — connecting brands, agencies, and consumers through the power of PayPal’s trusted ecosystem and unmatched transaction data. We are looking for a Director of Agency Development to lead strategic engagement and revenue growth across Holding Companies & Independents in the US.

This role is pivotal in shaping how PayPal Ads partners with agencies to drive adoption of our media platform, develop joint solutions, and deliver measurable value for clients across the commerce journey. The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of media agency dynamics, data-driven advertising, and consultative partnership development with a deep appreciation for PayPal’s mission to reimagine commerce.

You will serve as the senior relationship lead across multiple Holding Companies, responsible for executive alignment, commercial growth, and education.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex partnership projects and initiatives.
  • Resolve complex issues and provide strategic recommendations.
  • Manage and grow key partnerships.
  • Implement process improvements to enhance partnership effectiveness.
  • Contribute to the development of partnership strategies.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the complete relationship within designated Holding Companies, establishing strategic alignment between PayPal Ads and agency leadership (at both holding company and agency brand levels).
  • Drive agency revenue through proactive engagement, integrated media planning collaboration, and development of co-branded go-to-market initiatives.
  • Build and execute an annual joint business plan (JBP) outlining revenue targets, activation strategies, enablement programs, and measurement frameworks.
  • Represent PayPal Ads as a senior voice in industry forums, agency summits, and executive briefings — reinforcing PayPal’s role in the evolving commerce media ecosystem.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Data Science, Product, and PayPal’s broader commercial teams to deliver scaled and integrated solutions for Holding Company clients.
  • Lead forecasting, reporting, and pipeline management for the agency partnership; ensure accountability, consistency, and transparency across all engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in digital media sales, agency development, or holding company partnerships, with a strong track record in driving agency revenue.
  • Strong relationships and deep familiarity with agency ecosystem to include major Holding Companies organizational structure, operating model, and agency brands
  • Proven ability to navigate complex organizations, influence senior stakeholders, and drive alignment around strategic initiatives.
  • Expertise in commerce media, retail media, programmatic, or data-driven advertising ecosystems.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence — comfortable representing PayPal Ads in C-suite conversations.
  • Strong analytical and strategic planning skills, with a data-led mindset and business acumen.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent experience preferred.

  • Experience working within or alongside agency holding companies at a global or regional level.
  • Demonstrated success in launching or scaling ad platforms, particularly in retail or commerce media.
  • Deep understanding of advertiser KPIs, measurement frameworks, and attribution strategies.
  • A passion for innovation, collaboration, and building new capabilities in a fast-evolving ecosystem.
  • Ability to thrive in a matrixed, high-growth, entrepreneurial environment.

  • Analytical and strategic thinker with a proven ability to identify growth opportunities, address complex challenges, and deliver measurable business results.
  • Proficient in using CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) to manage pipelines, forecast revenue, and report on sales activities with accuracy.

locations: San Jose, California, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

The Director, AI Strategy and Product Management leads the application of AI across PayPal’s big bets — the company’s highest-priority enterprise initiatives — with the goal of simplifying how work gets done, reducing cycle time, and improving the quality of outcomes. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, operating process, and applied AI: designing and scaling capabilities that help teams move faster while giving leadership stronger, more automated visibility into progress and risk.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Establish a shared vision across the company for one or more products, or a platform product enabling development & scalability, with a deliberate and cohesive strategy.
  • Leads product strategy development, and develops a clear, executable view of the product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Influences the architectural roadmap and balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Champions the customer experience and prioritizes customer needs in product requirements and decision making.
  • Defines and uses metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Standardizes workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Responsible for product profitability, including budgetary decisions.
  • Leads operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with senior leadership as needed.
  • Maximizes efficiency in a constantly evolving environment where the process is fluid and creative solutions are the standard.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2 years of experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience at a regulated fintech, bank, or payments company. 

  • Familiarity with AI governance, model risk management, or responsible AI practices. 

  • Background in product management, software engineering, or operational process improvement.

Job Summary:

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you will support the SVP of Payment Services, drive critical workstreams within the org's AI Transformation, own PSP's operating expense (Opex) management, and help build and advance business cases that shape the org's direction. This is a high-visibility role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast without losing precision, and can flex between big-picture strategy and the details of getting things done.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex projects of diverse scope to optimize operational processes.
  • Participate in complex problem resolution and determine methods and procedures for new assignments.
  • Drive global process improvements within the organization.
  • Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.
  • Act as a liaison between business leadership, staff, and other key partners.
  • Influence the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of business processes.
  • Utilize internal and external data to provide actionable insights for business growth.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to drive business cases and strategic initiatives from concept to execution.

  • Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to see and communicate the bigger picture.

  • Demonstrated experience managing and influencing stakeholders at varying levels, including senior leaders, without direct reporting authority.

  • A track record of proactive, independent execution: someone who identifies what needs to happen and drives it forward without waiting to be asked.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and switching context between long-term strategic work and immediate, tactical asks.

  • Experience with budget/Opex management or financial operations is a plus.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing materials for senior leadership.

  • Prior business operations, strategy, or product management experience preferred.

What You'll Do

  • Chief of Staff Support: helping prioritize the org's agenda, prepare for key leadership and stakeholder engagements, and ensure follow-through on commitments across the organization

  • AI Transformation: Drive specific workstreams within the org's AI Transformation initiative, coordinating across cross-functional teams to keep projects on track, unblock issues, and report progress to leadership.

  • Opex / Budget Management: Own day-to-day management of PSP's operating budget, including tracking spend against plan, identifying variances, and partnering with Finance to ensure disciplined, transparent budget stewardship.

  • Business Case Development: Build, refine, and drive forward business cases for new initiatives, partnering with stakeholders to align on scope, investment, and expected outcomes.

  • Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships across the org and with cross-functional partners; influence without direct authority to keep initiatives moving and aligned.

  • Operational Rigor: Bring structure and attention to detail to fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous initiatives, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Your strategic thinking and ability to tailor solutions to complex business needs will be key to driving revenue and long-term partnerships by working closely with merchants to understand their unique business needs and align them with PayPal’s best-in-class payment solutions. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally, influence product direction through merchant feedback, and act as a trusted advisor to clients at multiple levels.

  • Determine appropriate actions for process improvements.
  • Recommend solutions to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Job Summary:

As PayPal continues its mission to revolutionize commerce, we’re looking for a driven Senior Account Executive, SMB Outbound to join our Small and Medium Business Sales team in Berlin.

Small businesses are the engine of local economies everywhere, and PayPal’s SMB team helps them compete on a bigger stage. In this role, you’ll own the end-to-end acquisition of higher-value SMB prospects with multiple stakeholders and longer decision cycles, including new-logo and winback opportunities generated through direct, partner and AI-supported channels.

You’ll manage these multi-stage sales cycles, shape tailored solutions and commercial offers, and bring together the right internal teams to convert opportunities into sustainable merchant relationships. It’s a role for someone who wants real ownership, from the first qualification and discovery conversation through negotiation, closing and a successful handover to Account Management.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate internally to influence process quality and efficiency.
  • Determine appropriate actions and consider alternative solutions.
  • Acquire, manage, and expand relationships with small and medium-sized merchants.
  • Use analytical skills and judgment to recommend best solutions.
  • Influence through defined processes and procedures.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:


What You’ll Do


In this role, you’ll take ownership of a pipeline of direct, partner-sourced and AI-supported opportunities, combining consultative selling, data-driven prioritisation and strong cross-functional execution. In practice, you’ll:


  • Lead higher-value acquisition opportunities from qualification and discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Assess and prioritise prospects using expected transaction margin, conversion potential and merchant readiness.
  • Develop tailored commercial propositions and coordinate the right internal teams to address merchant needs and remove barriers to closing.
  • Use AI-powered tools and commercial data to identify opportunities, sharpen your approach and progress deals effectively.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and forecast reporting, surface risks early and keep next actions moving with discipline.
  • Support less experienced Account Executives by sharing effective practices, and ensure a complete handover of newly acquired merchants to the Account Representative team.

What We’re Looking For


To succeed in this role, you’ll combine a strong new-business mindset with sound commercial judgement and the ability to navigate multi-stage sales cycles while keeping the merchant at the centre of your decisions.

Job Summary:

This job involves leading functional projects and programs, partners with others to analyze business trends, and recommends best practices. A Manager, Sales Development, contributes to business or process improvements within the function.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead functional sales development projects and programs.
  • Partner with others to analyze business trends.
  • Recommend best practices for sales development.
  • Contribute to business or process improvements.
  • Mentor and guide team members to achieve sales objectives.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

We are seeking a highly driven SMB Commercial Manager to join the IGM SMB team. This role is responsible for portfolio management and driving SMB growth initiatives, managing commercial programs, and developing scalable vendor partnerships and operating models that support customer acquisition, revenue growth, and operational excellence across the IGM region.

About the role:

At PayPal, we process over $1.5 trillion in annual payment volume across more than 160 countries, connecting consumers and businesses around the world through innovative commerce solutions. Our roots are deeply embedded in serving small businesses, helping them seamlessly send, receive, and accept payments globally. Today, PayPal continues to empower SMBs of all sizes, from freelancers and entrepreneurs to large cross-border e-commerce sellers

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys working cross-functionally, and is passionate about helping SMBs grow. You'll combine strategic thinking, analytical rigor, strong stakeholder management, and operational excellence to unlock growth opportunities and deliver meaningful business impact across the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute comprehensive growth strategies across the SMB customer lifecycle, leveraging product, pricing, marketing, sales, support, and operational levers to drive acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue growth.
  • Examine, analyze and monitor performance across the end-to-end customer journey, identifying growth opportunities and translating insights into impactful commercial programs.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives across the IGM region, partnering with Product, Marketing, Sales, Account Management, Support, Finance, Operations, and local market teams to deliver revenue and margin growth for the SMB segment.
  • Design and execute go-to-market programs, including merchant attach and adoption initiatives, to drive incremental TPV, customer engagement, and revenue growth.
  • Partner closely with local markets to develop a deep understanding of SMB customer needs, market dynamics, growth drivers, and competitive landscapes, translating insights into scalable commercial strategies.
  • Own the design, implementation, and optimization of vendor operating models that support long-tail SMB segments, ensuring scalability, operational efficiency, and strong customer outcomes.
  • Manage vendor relationships and performance, including onboarding, governance, KPI tracking, SLA management, and ongoing optimization to ensure vendors deliver against business objectives.
  • Monitor key business metrics and growth KPIs, providing performance analysis, recommendations, and regular updates to senior leadership.
  • Drive the introduction, adoption, cross-sell, and upsell of new products and solutions through close collaboration with global and regional stakeholders.
  • Develop customer segmentation frameworks and apply both qualitative and quantitative insights to measure and optimize growth initiatives.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, emerging technologies, competitive developments, and best practices in payments, fintech, SMB growth, and customer acquisition.

We are seeking an exceptional product leader who thrives on changing the status quo and is laser focused on making every experience seamless, simple, and intuitive. Essential Responsibilities:

  • Establish a shared vision across the company for a portfolio of products, or platform products enabling development & scalability, with a deliberate and cohesive strategy.
  • Leads product strategy development, and develops a clear, executable view of the product portfolio strategy with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Shapes the architectural roadmap and balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Champions the customer experience and prioritizes customer needs in product requirements and decision making.
  • Defines and uses metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Standardizes workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Responsible for product portfolio profitability, including budgetary decisions.
  • Leads operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with senior leadership as needed.
  • Maximizes efficiency in a constantly evolving environment where the process is fluid and creative solutions are the standard.

  • 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5 years of experience leading others

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with our internal teams like design, engineering, commercial, marketing, legal, compliance, risk, data, identity and customer service teams as well as external partners (Synchrony Financial, credit bureaus, networks) to ensure product success. Facilitate communication and alignment across teams and departments.
  • Strategic Planning: Participate in the development and execution of enterprise-level strategic planning processes, aligning release and program roadmaps with the organization’s overarching vision and OKR’s. Ensure that all initiatives are strategically positioned to maximize their contribution to the company’s long-term success.
  • Team Leadership & Management: Lead and mentor a team of diverse product leaders and managers. Foster a culture of working customer back, putting people first, winning as a team, innovation, growth and excellence. Participate in personal performance management and development activities including cross-training.

Bias To Action:


  • Proven leadership: self-motivated and a self-starter with a “can do” attitude.
  • Team player, energetic personality, quality minded, focused, committed and able to work independently in a fast paced, changing environment.
  • High degree of professional confidence and credibility with effective presence, strong written and verbal communication skills, able to communicate technical concepts and plans at all levels.
  • Sharp business judgment, detail oriented yet able to always see the “big picture”.
  • Strong partnering and influencing skills leveraging all communication mediums and throughout the organization, including senior leaders.
  • Define and articulate through narratives, presentations, and documentation the vision and direction of our revolving credit products.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, able to prioritize among conflicting needs, advocate a course of action and pursue it consistently.
  • Ability to adapt, be flexible and responsive to dynamic situations.
  • •  Challenge traditional products and experiences and build the next generation of revolving credit products and experiences.

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, engineering or a related field.
  • 15+ years of product management experience.
  • 10+ years of experience managing teams of product managers/leaders.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

The Sr. Manager, Product Sales- BNPL role is an important part of the PYPL sales org, whose overall goal is to grow and strengthen PayPal merchant partnerships, drive increased revenue for PayPal, and support overall adoption of PayPal’s revenue and payments solutions across Americas.

The specific focus of the Sr. Manager, Product Sales BNPL is the value-driven sale of our suite of BNPL, Pay Later and PayPal Credit solutions, with emphasis on solution selling. This role will function as a hunter focused on merchants who do not have PayPal on their e-comm checkout today.

The Sr. Manager, Product Sales BNPL will be expected to have a deep understanding of their specific portfolio of named merchant verticals, existing accounts and prospects to drive desired outcomes for PayPal. The Sr. Manager, Product Sales will also own engagement with the Product, supporting prioritization of new feature functionality, partnering on strategy formation and being a deep thought partner on ways to win.
