Scottsdale, Arizona, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

Running one of the world’s largest payment platforms means keeping our Kubernetes production environment fast, reliable, and efficient. Our team builds the in-house systems that make that possible, using machine learning, data analysis, automation, and AI to keep a very large production cluster running at its best.

The systems you build will support millions of users and billions of dollars in transactions. You’ll own meaningful pieces of the platform, write production code in Go, Java, and Python, and see the impact of your work in real time.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
  • Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
  • Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
  • Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
  • May contribute to code & design reviews

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Design, build, and operate components of our home-grown platform systems that keep our Kubernetes environment efficient. 
  • Apply machine learning, data analysis, and AI techniques to improve how the cluster runs. 
  • Build automation that reduces manual operational work and improves reliability. 
  • Analyze system behavior and performance at scale to find opportunities to improve efficiency and cost. 
  • Partner with application teams and platform/infrastructure teams to improve how services run on our platform. 
  • Take part in operational ownership of the systems you build, and drive root cause analysis and long-term fixes. 
  • Contribute to design and code reviews, and help raise engineering quality across the team. 
  • Work independently on well-scoped projects, and help break down larger, ambiguous problems with guidance from senior engineers.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, especially Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
  • Experience managing or operating large-scale clusters or production infrastructure. 
  • Experience applying machine learning or statistical methods to operational or infrastructure problems. 
  • Experience building automation for production systems. 
  • Familiarity with observability tooling (metrics, tracing, logging).  


Why Join Us

  • Real scale: Work on a huge production Kubernetes environment where efficiency gains translate directly into reliability and cost savings. 
  • High-ownership, home-grown systems: Build core platform technology rather than just configuring off-the-shelf tools. 
  • A blend of disciplines: Systems engineering, ML, data analysis, AI, and automation come together in everyday work. 
  • Collaborative environment: Work with strong engineers, get mentorship, and grow your scope and impact.

What you need to know about the role:
This role sits within PayPal’s Europe Revenue Operations team and turns sales and customer data into actionable insights. It supports commercial performance, process optimisation and faster, data-driven decision-making across revenue teams.

Meet our team:
Europe Revenue Operations partners with Sales, Account Management, Finance, Marketing and Product to drive growth and operational efficiency. The team acts as a strategic advisor to commercial leadership, ensuring data accuracy, scalable processes and clear visibility across the revenue funnel.

Your way to impact:
You will improve pipeline visibility, forecasting accuracy and sales efficiency. Through analysis, process optimisation and stakeholder partnership, you will help teams identify growth opportunities, remove operational bottlenecks and make smarter decisions that deliver stronger business outcomes.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Analyze sales data to recommend process improvements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Prepare detailed reports for management review.
  • Handle complex customer inquiries and provide solutions.
  • Mentor junior analysts and guide their professional growth.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Core Experience

  • 3–5+ years in Revenue Ops, Sales Ops, or Analytics roles within commercial environments
  • Proven experience supporting sales or account management teams with data and insights
  • Strong exposure to pipeline management, forecasting, and performance tracking

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel skills (modelling, analysis, reporting)
  • Strong SQL capability for data extraction and manipulation
  • Experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) for dashboarding and visualisation
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce (pipeline management, reporting, data quality)

Analytical & Business Skills

  • Strong problem-solving ability with a data-driven mindset
  • Ability to define and track key metrics (pipeline velocity, quota attainment, win rates)
  • Experience identifying trends, bottlenecks, and growth opportunities

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Strong storytelling skills—able to translate complex data into clear business insights
  • Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and influencing decision-making
  • Effective cross-functional collaborator

Ways of Working

  • Self-starter with a proactive, “see it, solve it” mindset
  • High attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Job Summary:

Global LE ABM & Vertical Plays owns account targeting and named-account execution for PayPal's largest merchants (GSA and NAM), and is organized around three pods reporting to the team's Director. You will own the Checkout pod and partner daily with Sales, Product Marketing & Partner Ecosystem, Solutions PMM, and our BDR team to hit Large Enterprise pipeline and revenue targets.
In this role, you will design and run the ABM programs and always-on nurture that keep BXO's (Branded Checkout) Large Enterprise accounts engaged, generating qualified leads and accelerating pipeline. You will lead sales-facing event execution and partner co-marketing for the segment, and translate BXO's product story into materials and outreach that sales and account teams can use directly. Your work rolls up to the same revenue line the broader team is measured against, contributing to Global LE ABM's 2026 target.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex marketing projects and initiatives to drive business growth
  • Resolve complex marketing problems and develop innovative solutions
  • Determine methods and procedures for new marketing assignments
  • Implement global process improvements to enhance marketing effectiveness
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to align marketing strategies with business goals
  • Provide thought leadership and expertise in marketing best practices

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:


  • Manage ABM digital campaigns: oversee the execution and optimization of ABM-focused digital marketing efforts, including email marketing, content syndication, social media advertising, and programmatic initiatives.
  • Run BXO's always-on ABM and email nurture programs for Large Enterprise: own the campaign brief, execution, and reporting for BXO's nurture and demand programs, partnering with our media and content agencies.
  • Drive lead generation and engagement: collaborate with sales and demand generation teams to identify and engage key stakeholders within targeted enterprise payment accounts, working on ABM programs and account lists.
  • Content development and distribution: work with content and creative teams to develop personalized and relevant content for accounts across multiple channels to enhance account engagement.
  • Own target account list creation and refresh for BXO campaigns: coordinate with Sales, BDR, and analytics to keep account segmentation and targeting current as the book evolves.
  • Coordinate ABM events, webinars, and industry-specific engagements for BXO: plan and execute account-centric events and virtual experiences to deepen engagement and support pipeline acceleration within the enterprise payments segment.
  • Measure and analyze ABM performance: track and report on campaign metrics and KPIs, using insights to optimize ABM strategies and tactics.
  • Partner on BXO co-marketing with platform partners: work with Product Marketing & Partner Ecosystem on BXO placements and campaigns across partners such as Woo, BigCommerce, and PlentyONE.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally within the team: align BXO programs with vertical strategy and ABM ops, and with audience, reporting, and analytics, to keep the pod's plans consistent with the broader Global LE ABM strategy.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Minimum 7 years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Proven success managing and executing B2B or ABM campaigns, ideally including always-on nurture programs.
  • Strong knowledge of digital marketing channels, tools, and marketing technology platforms.
  • Excellent communication, project management, and cross-functional coordination skills, including working directly with sales teams.
  • Experience working in technology, fintech, or SaaS industries.
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation tools like Salesforce and Demandbase.

The Sr. Sourcing Analyst, Technology is accountable for developing, managing and executing the sourcing strategy for IT procurement categories (such as Hardware, Software, Cloud based solutions, Storage, Telecom and Data Center related services) in North America.

Job Summary:

The Director, Revenue Operations – Europe will lead the regional Revenue Operations function, supporting sustainable revenue and TPV growth across European markets. The role will drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline management, sales planning, performance reporting, CRM governance, process optimisation and commercial execution.
Working closely with European commercial leadership and global Revenue Operations Centres of Excellence, the role will translate regional requirements into scalable solutions and lead effective deployment, adoption and change management.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Formulate business strategies to optimize revenue operations.
  • Advise executive leadership on sales support improvements.
  • Manage large-scale projects to streamline sales processes.
  • Coordinate with various departments to ensure seamless operations.
  • Mentor senior managers and guide their professional development.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with European commercial leaders to develop and execute the regional revenue operating plan.
  • Establish effective operating rhythms for forecasting, pipeline reviews, business performance and executive reporting.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex projects of diverse scope requiring an understanding of current business trends.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product sales strategies.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Job Summary

Sr. Manager, Product Sales – PSC (Payment Services & Crypto) is part of the Rest of Europe and Israel Commercial sales team, partnering with Account Management to grow adoption and transaction margin for PayPal's PSC portfolio across new and existing accounts in the Region.

The PSC portfolio spans the following solution areas: (1) Payouts, including Enterprise Payouts for platforms and marketplaces disbursing funds globally via bank transfers, cards, wallets and local payout methods, and PayPal Payouts for self-serve batch payments to PayPal and Venmo accounts; (2) Risk-as-a-Service (RaaS), including Fraud Protection Advanced, Chargeback Protection and Dispute Automation, which apply AI-driven risk models built on PayPal's global network data to protect merchant revenue while preserving approval rates; and (3) Crypto solutions for businesses, where applicable; 4) Braintree solution and local payment methods where available 5) ability to consult on holistic payment solutions beyond the PayPal checkout button.

Success is measured by profitable activated volume within assigned markets and verticals.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Managers to identify, shape, and advance PSC opportunities for new and existing accounts across the Region.
  • Lead deeper discovery, solution design, competitive positioning, and pricing construction on qualified opportunities.
  • Design and position the right combination of PayPal capabilities across Payouts, RaaS and Crypto, not a single product in isolation, and translate it into a client-specific business case with quantified value against competitive alternatives.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities that require sound judgment and an understanding of current market, regulatory and business trends.
  • Carry the target for the opportunities you develop or advance.
  • Use sales pipeline, back-book portfolio data, and product and merchant performance data to prioritize opportunities, build the commercial case, and support pricing decisions, treating data as the basis for prioritization, not a supporting exhibit.
  • Leverage internal and external data to identify growth opportunities and build pipeline.
  • Act as a force multiplier for Account Managers and other sellers, sharing PSC product knowledge and ushering merchants from lead to live.
  • Build credibility with and mobilize Account Management, Solution Engineering, Integration Engineers, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Product without formal authority over those teams.
  • Partner with product-line specialists to share best practice and adapt playbooks to local requirements.
  • Own and evolve the specialist team's playbook and selling process for the local market
  • Collect feedback and recommendations from Account Managers and customers, and channel them back to Product and GTM teams to help shape future product roadmaps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience across two or more of the following: domestic and cross-border payouts and disbursements; transactional fraud, chargeback and dispute management; crypto or digital-asset solutions for businesses. Direct experience with PayPal's products is a bonus.
  • Ability to position PSC solutions against competitive and in-house alternatives, and translate payout economics (disbursement speed, payout method flexibility), risk and dispute economics (chargeback ratios, dispute volume, approval rates) and crypto use cases into a quantified, merchant-specific business case.
  • Working knowledge of the European payments and regulatory landscape (for example PSD2/SCA and, for crypto, MiCA) and of how it varies by market.
  • Acts as a resource and force multiplier for other sellers, ushering merchants from lead to live with a focus on discovery and solutioning.
  • Expertise in getting the most out of AI, using AI tools to accelerate discovery, research, solutioning, and pipeline analysis, not just familiarity with them.
  • 5+ years of experience solution selling to senior executives at large enterprises, including experience engaging C-level decision makers across Product, Sales, Finance and Risk.
  • A consistent track record of exceeding quota targets.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CRM.
  • MBA or other advanced degree in Finance, Business, or a related field.
  • Financial analysis experience and a strong analytical mind, with the ability to build ROI-based business cases and evidence-based sales narratives.
  • Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams to structure win-win commercial outcomes.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders informally.
  • Expert in PowerPoint, Excel, and the Microsoft suite.
  • Skilled storyteller, with the ability to communicate a compelling, value-based narrative to executive audiences.
  • Fluency in English; additional European languages are an advantage.
  • Experience selling or knowledge of omni-channel and in-store payments solutions.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a CISO to be the Head of Cyber Risk for PayPal EU. In this role you will take on First Line of Defense role responsible for setting strategic direction and providing senior leadership over cyber risk, information security, ICT risk management, cyber resilience, and digital operational resilience matters for PayPal Europe and other assigned international markets.

Working closely with regional and global security teams in this role you will manage information systems risk, advise EU senior management as the security subject matter expert, and ensure compliance with CSSF, ECB, PSD2/3, SCA, DORA and GDPR requirements.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert advice and strategic counsel to senior executives, shaping the development of multi-year risk management and security governance strategies that align with business goals and long-term organizational objectives.
  • Determine the most effective methods and strategies for addressing complex security risks, driving innovation through collaboration with cross-functional teams to shape the organization’s security risk management and governance landscape.
  • Identify and resolve unique, high-impact security risks, applying deep expertise to situations of substantial significance, and develop innovative solutions that influence and strengthen the organization’s security framework.
  • Drive the future risk management and security governance roadmap, shaping the security vision that supports business growth and mitigates risk to provide a competitive advantage.
  • Lead the development and execution of key components of the multi-year security strategy, contributing to the broader security agenda within the organization.
  • Inspire and motivate team(s) to pursue innovative solutions, ensuring alignment with the overall security strategy and business objectives, while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and manage the information security strategy for PayPal Europe  
  • Ensure the information security strategy enforces applicable local and regional regulatory requirements and assess any new requirements that may be needed because of emerging regulations, with the support of PayPal’s Legal and Compliance teams.  
  • Develop, coordinate, publish, and maintain suitable procedures for handling cases of confidential information mismanagement (whether intentional or unintentional), considering national legislation as well as notification policies.  
  • Ensure that there is a robust due diligence process that ensures information security requirements are adequately addressed in IT projects undertaken by or on behalf of PayPal.  
  • Manage information security incidents and events that impact PayPal or its customers, in close cooperation and coordination with the global teams responsible for crisis management and security incident response, as well as with PayPal’s senior management team.  
  • Ensure that information security awareness and training initiatives are implemented on behalf of PayPal by the global information security team, and that the training meets the regulatory obligations set forth by regulatory bodies as well as PayPal’s own standards.  
  • Participate in the management of external partners / providers  
  • Oversee the security due diligence process on IT and information security issues for all new service providers/sub-contractors of PayPal.  
  • Support the security due diligence process led by global or regional teams, on IT and information security issues for mergers & acquisitions activities related to PayPal, as directed.  

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 15-20 years’ minimum experience in an IT security, risk management, or similar function. At least 5 years of this experience should involve executive-level communication and leading remote teams. Recent substantive interaction with C-level executives and boards of directors a plus.  
  • Excellent written and verbal skills; interpersonal and collaborative skills; and the ability to communicate information security-related concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.   
  • Strong influencing, negotiation, and relationship building skills; an ability to interface internally and externally to ensure successful, high-quality outcomes.  
  • Thorough understanding of how to effectively manage teams and lead projects supported by cross-functional/matrixteam structures.  
  • Critical thinker with strong problem-solving skills, and the organisation agility needed to switch between strategic and tactical thinking.  
  • Ability to work with geographically distributed teams, especially with teams situated abroad and in different time zones.

Job Summary:

This is a hands-on IC role with cross-organizational scope: you'll help set technical direction, lead delivery, and mentor engineers while staying involved in architecture reviews, control design, and implementation. Your work will reduce exploitable vulnerabilities from AI-assisted development and misuse by AI-enabled systems, while improving PayPal's ability to detect, validate, and remediate vulnerabilities at scale.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Leverage specialized security expertise to identify and resolve complex security issues, recommending best practices and determining new approaches that have an impact on broader security operations, while aligning security strategies with business priorities
  • Partner across teams and key stakeholders to drive security initiatives, leading and solutioning complex projects and programs to strengthen overall security posture.
  • Apply advanced analytical skills and sound judgment to solve security challenges, considering diverse perspectives and innovative solutions. Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, understanding their security implications to the company’s context.
  • Directly contribute to improvements within the security domain and occasionally beyond, ensuring decisions lead to meaningful enhancements in security practices.
  • Leverage relationships across teams, both within and outside of security, to influence initiatives and integrate feedback into security processes.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on familiarity with application security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, WAF, Burp Suite).
  • Strong programming experience in at least one language such as Ruby, Java, Python, JavaScript, or Swift.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud vendor (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • Familiarity with security considerations for AI/LLM development tools, AI-assisted coding, or model and tool supply chains. 
  • Experience with GCP, complemented by hands-on expertise with Kubernetes, Terraform, and other cloud-native technologies. 
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with software, platform, and security teams, with clear written and verbal communication of technical findings and tradeoffs. 

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Build and operate scanning and guardrail capabilities across source control, CI/CD, package ecosystems, and developer platforms. 
  • Tune SAST, SCA, and supply chain controls; investigate gaps and false positives and improve remediation guidance. 
  • Write and review code, APIs, detection rules, and automation that process findings and enforce security policy. 
  • Partner with developers, platform engineers, and security teams to troubleshoot integrations and deliver practical improvements. 
  • Evaluate new technical surfaces, including AI/LLM tools, and help define appropriate security controls. 
  • Use metrics and feedback to improve reliability, coverage, performance, adoption, and remediation outcomes.

Job Summary:

The Venmo Data Infrastructure team supports Venmo's internal and customer-impacting data movement and message streaming infrastructure. We are actively engaged in partnering with development groups, platform, and infrastructure teams — providing deep subject matter expertise on Kafka-based streaming architecture, and acting as the escalation point for analyzing and resolving complex, large-scale streaming and performance issues.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
  • Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
  • Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
  • Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
  • May contribute to code & design reviews

Expected Qualifications:

  • 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Job Summary

This is a senior technical leadership role for an engineer who will serve as the Kafka subject matter expert and technical authority for Venmo's real-time data and message streaming platform. You will act as a project or system lead, setting technical direction for other engineers, driving Kafka architecture and operational excellence at scale, and representing the team's engineering standards both internally and externally. This role goes beyond hands-on Kafka operations — it requires shaping how the broader organization designs, scales, and reasons about streaming infrastructure.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical roadmap and architecture for Venmo's Kafka streaming platform, ensuring it is secure, scalable, reliable, and performant for Venmo product, analytics, and downstream infrastructure teams
  • Set the technical direction and design patterns for Kafka cluster architecture, topic design, partitioning strategy, and multi-tenant governance across the organization
  • Lead the design and rollout of Kafka lifecycle management, including cluster upgrades, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and multi-region/multi-cluster replication strategies
  • Drive deep root-cause analysis and resolution for the most complex, large-scale Kafka performance, reliability, and data-loss incidents
  • Define and evangelize best practices for producer/consumer design, schema governance, and Kafka Connect/Kafka Streams usage across engineering teams
  • Establish and improve engineering standards, runbooks, and operational rigor for streaming infrastructure in partnership with management
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to senior and junior engineers working on Kafka and adjacent streaming/data infrastructure
  • Partner with Executive, Product, Engineering, and Analytics stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable streaming architecture decisions

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's and/or Master's in Computer Science or related field of study
  • Deep, hands-on expertise operating and scaling Apache Kafka in production at high throughput/high availability, including internals such as partitions, replication, ISR, controller quorum/KRaft, and consumer group rebalancing
  • Proven experience architecting Kafka topologies for multi-region resilience, disaster recovery, and zero/low-downtime upgrades
  • Strong experience securing Kafka with IAM-based authentication/authorization (e.g., AWS IAM/MSK IAM), including fine-grained IAM policy design for producers/consumers
  • Experience with Schema Registry, schema governance, and Kafka Connect/Kafka Streams patterns
  • Hands-on experience with IaaS and PaaS solutions from AWS (or similar cloud provider), including:

Job Description:

Job Summary:

This job drives accounting activities. You’ll lead multiple process workstreams through exploration, gap analysis, integration planning, execution, and problem-solving. Additionally, you’ll identify finance-related risks and collaborate with cross-functional teams to mitigate them, discuss finance and accounting concepts across the organization, and influence execution of plans through strong interpersonal skills. You’ll also proactively engage in resolving potential conflicts between Finance and non-Finance functions.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead several process workstreams through explorations, gap analysis, integration planning, execution, and problem solving
  • Identify finance-related risks and partner with cross-functional teams to mitigate the identified risks
  • Discuss finance/accounting concepts with others across the organization
  • Lead and drive execution of plans and influence where you do not have direct authority through strong interpersonal skills
  • Proactively engage, evaluate, and drive resolution of potential conflicts between various Finance and non-Finance functions
  • Manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Work collaboratively with workstream leads and subject matter experts to arrive at risk-based approaches related to tactical execution steps
  • Comfort with problem solving and creative solutioning

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

The Manager, Finance – Credit Controllership & Financial Reporting, is a hands-on finance role responsible for the preparation, execution and review of accounting, close, financial reporting, and control activities for PayPal’s credit portfolio. This role provides strong financial stewardship over credit products and related transactions, including loan receivables, expected credit losses, fair-value and valuation adjustments, credit asset sales, ABS/securitisation activities and related balance-sheet and P&L reporting.

The role combines technical accounting expertise, operational execution, analytical review, and control discipline. It partners closely with Credit, Risk, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Regulatory Reporting, Global Controllership, and the Controllership CoE in India to ensure that credit activities are accurately reflected in the books and records, appropriately controlled and supported by robust documentation and audit evidence.

The successful candidate will be expected to challenge data, assumptions, and accounting outcomes, resolve issues end-to-end, and convert complex credit activity into clear financial reporting and management insight.


Key Responsibilities

1. Credit Controllership & Month-End Close

·      Own day-to-day finance execution for assigned credit portfolios, ensuring transactions are completely and accurately reflected in the general ledger and financial reporting.

·      Prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, roll-forwards, accruals, reclassifications and close deliverables for credit-related balance sheet and P&L accounts.

·      Perform monthly close activities for credit products, including analysis of receivables, interest and fee income, credit losses, valuation movements, write-offs, and recoveries.

·      Investigate unusual movements, data breaks, and reconciliation differences; determine root causes and drive issues to resolution.

·      Prepare monthly management reporting and analytics that explain portfolio movements, financial performance, key drivers, and emerging risks.

2. Credit Products & Portfolio Accounting

·      Build and maintain a strong understanding of PayPal credit products, including consumer and merchant credit, revolving and instalment products, and portfolios originated, purchased, or sold by PayPal entities.

·      Execute and review accounting for credit asset purchases, transfers, sales, and related settlement flows, including assessment of balance-sheet presentation, gain/loss recognition and supporting reconciliations.

·      Support accounting for credit asset sales, forward-flow arrangements, ABS/securitisation structures and related funding or servicing arrangements, including preparation of transaction accounting papers and audit support.

·      Partner with Credit and Treasury to understand portfolio structure, contractual terms, funding arrangements and changes affecting accounting or reporting.

·       Maintain robust accounting documentation for significant and non-routine credit transactions and ensure conclusions are clearly supported by the applicable accounting framework.


3. ECL, Credit Losses & Valuation

·      Prepare, review, and challenge the financial reporting impact of expected credit loss (ECL) and related credit-loss estimates, including data, staging, model outputs, overlays, and management adjustments.

·      Coordinate with Credit Risk and Model teams to understand changes in PD, LGD, EAD, macroeconomic scenarios, calibration, and model methodology, and assess the financial reporting implications.

·      Perform analytical review of allowance movements, including originations, derecognitions, changes in credit risk, model changes, write-offs, and recoveries.

·      Support valuation and fair-value accounting for credit portfolios where applicable, including review of cash-flow forecasts, discount-rate assumptions, and valuation adjustments.

·      Ensure appropriate documentation of key judgments, estimates, sensitivities and management overlays for financial reporting and audit purposes.


4. Financial Reporting, IFRS / Local GAAP & Regulatory Requirements

·      Prepare and review financial statement and management reporting outputs relating to credit activities under IFRS, US GAAP and/or applicable local GAAP requirements, as relevant to the entity.

·      Prepare and maintain accounting bridges and reconciliations between local GAAP and IFRS where required.

·      Support statutory, prudential, and other regulatory reporting by providing accurate credit-related data, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

·      Monitor changes in accounting and regulatory requirements affecting credit products and translate them into practical actions for Finance and Business stakeholders.

·      Prepare technical accounting memos for significant credit transactions, new products, and changes in portfolio strategy.


5. Controls, Risk Management & Audit Readiness

·      Execute and evidence key financial controls over credit accounting, including reconciliations, review controls, data quality checks, and certification activities.

·      Identify control gaps, assess accounting and reporting risks, design practical remediation actions, and track issues through sustainable closure.

·      Maintain audit-ready support for credit balances, estimates, transaction accounting, and disclosures, including clear evidence trails and timely responses to auditor requests.

·      Work with Internal Audit, SOX, Risk, Compliance and external auditors on credit-related findings, testing, and remediation.

·      Ensure finance procedures and control documentation remain current as credit products, systems and processes evolve.


6. Partnership with the Controllership CoE in India

·      Work with the CoE as an execution partner for close, reconciliations, journal preparation, reporting packs, and control activities.

·      Provide clear priorities, accounting guidance, and quality expectations; review outputs and resolve exceptions rather than relying solely on high-level oversight.

·      Establish effective review routines, issue escalation, and service-level expectations across the end-to-end credit controllership process.

·      Drive standardisation, automation and process simplification across credit accounting and reporting activities.


7. Business & Cross-Functional Partnership

·      Partner with Credit, Risk, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Regulatory Reporting, Product and Operations teams on financial implications of credit initiatives.

·      Support new product launches, portfolio migrations, funding initiatives, and strategic transactions by identifying accounting, reporting, control, and data requirements early in the process.

·      Provide clear, concise financial analysis to management on portfolio trends, risks, accounting impacts, and execution priorities.

·      Influence across functions and geographies, including situations where the role does not have direct authority.


8. Continuous Improvement & Transformation

·      Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, quality, and resilience of credit close and reporting processes.

·      Use data queries, analytical tools and automation to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and improve the timeliness of financial insight.

·      Participate in ERP, data, reporting, and finance transformation initiatives affecting credit activities.

·      Develop repeatable documentation, dashboards and operating procedures that improve transparency and execution discipline.

·      Timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual close for assigned credit activities.

·      High-quality reconciliations with clear explanations and rapid resolution of exceptions.

·      Audit-ready support for ECL, valuation, credit asset sales, and securitization transactions.

·      Accurate and well-supported financial and regulatory reporting submissions.

·      Effective control execution with timely remediation of identified issues.

·      Improved automation, standardization, and use of data analytics across credit controllership.

·      Clear management insight into portfolio performance, financial impacts, and emerging risks.


Key Stakeholders

·      Controllership CoE India

·      Credit Risk, Model Risk and Credit Operations

·      Treasury / Funding and Liquidity

·      Experience in regulated banking, payments, fintech, or other highly controlled financial services environments.

Job Summary:

PayPal's Developer Experience team builds the APIs, tools, and infrastructure that let developers put PayPal to work anywhere they build. As commerce moves into AI coding assistants and agentic platforms, we make PayPal the easiest way to move money on any surface.

Job Summary:

This role leads a team of product and UX designers supporting developer experience, design systems, and AI-enabled design tooling across PayPal. Sets clear goals and quality standards, develops designers, and enables the delivery of useful, accessible, and consistent experiences for internal and external developers.

The successful candidate is an experienced people leader and active design practitioner who coaches designers, manages performance, builds a healthy team, and contributes directly when senior design judgment or technical depth can improve outcomes. Hands-on work may include prototypes, critical interaction concepts, design reviews, design-system guidance, and lightweight internal tools.

Partners closely with Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Documentation, Research, Accessibility, and senior leaders. Influences portfolio strategy and priorities while operating within the direction of the portfolio leader and accountable product and engineering teams.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Establish overall business or technical strategy for user experience initiatives.
  • Negotiate with and influence decision-making reaching the senior executive level
  • Identify and resolve unique situations of substantial significance in user interface or interaction design
  • Allocate resources, responsibly and apply creativity to enhancing user and customer experiences across digital and physical products and services
  • Lead the development of user experience strategies that resonate with target audiences.
  • Support and mentor less-experienced roles to provide an example of innovation, excellence, and day-to-day learning

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2 years of experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • 10 or more years of relevant experience in product design, UX design, interaction design, or a related field.
  • 5 or more years of experience directly managing product or UX designers.
  • Demonstrated experience with hiring, coaching, performance management, career development, team health, retention, and difficult feedback or personnel decisions.
  • A portfolio or set of case studies that shows strong storytelling, product and systems thinking, design judgment, leadership results, and meaningful personal contributions to the work.
  • Strong current skills in interaction design, prototyping, information architecture, design critique, and user-centered product development.
  • Experience leading design work for complex digital products and connecting user needs with business goals and technical constraints.
  • Working knowledge of design-system architecture, component models, semantic design tokens, accessibility, front-end implementation constraints, and design-to-code workflows.
  • Experience using qualitative and quantitative evidence to identify problems, guide design decisions, and evaluate outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries and influence product, engineering, design, and senior leadership partners without direct authority.
  • Clear written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of product and UX designers. Set clear expectations, give timely feedback, support career growth, recognize strong performance, and address performance concerns directly and fairly. 
  • Recruit and retain strong designers. Build an inclusive team environment that supports collaboration, sound judgment, high design quality, and sustainable performance. 
  • Translate portfolio goals into clear design priorities for the team. Balance near-term delivery needs with longer-term improvements to shared systems, tools, and practices. 
  • Assign work based on business priorities, designer strengths, growth goals, and available capacity. Identify staffing or skill gaps and recommend practical changes. 
  • Maintain current hands-on design knowledge. Contribute directly to selected work where senior judgment, systems thinking, or technical depth can reduce risk or improve quality. 
  • Lead design reviews and strengthen critique practices. Help designers use research, data, technical constraints, accessibility requirements, and business context to make sound decisions. 
  • Guide the design of developer dashboards, documentation experiences, and related tools. Ensure that these experiences support clear workflows and reduce effort for internal and external developers. 
  • Advise teams on the usability of APIs, SDKs, documentation, and MCP-based tools when the work aligns with the candidate's experience. Partner with product and engineering leaders who own the final product and technical decisions. 
  • Contribute to design-system strategy and standards. Advise on component architecture, semantic design tokens, accessibility, contribution practices, documentation, release practices, adoption, and alignment between design assets and production code. 
  • Coach designers and partner teams that use or contribute to the design system. Help teams resolve system-level design problems and apply shared patterns consistently. 
  • Improve approved AI-assisted design workflows and design tooling where these methods can produce clear gains in quality, speed, or consistency. Support small experiments, human review, and practical measures of results. 
  • Build or guide prototypes and lightweight internal tools when direct implementation is the fastest way to test an idea, reduce technical uncertainty, or improve a workflow. 
  • Research the needs of developers and other internal users. Use feedback and evidence to identify friction in tools, documentation, handoffs, and implementation workflows. 
  • Define and track meaningful outcomes for the team's work. Measures can include team health, design quality, task success, developer satisfaction, design-system adoption, accessibility, delivery time, and reduced rework. 
  • Build effective partnerships across Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Documentation, Research, Accessibility, Legal, and Security. Communicate clearly with senior leaders, resolve disagreements, and influence decisions through evidence and sound design judgment. 
  • Experience designing developer-facing products, platforms, dashboards, or internal tools.
  • Experience helping to build, govern, scale, or increase adoption of a design system.
  • Experience evaluating or improving AI-assisted design or development workflows.
  • Ability to use code or low-code tools to build functional prototypes or lightweight internal tools.
  • Experience improving the usability of APIs, SDKs, developer documentation, documentation platforms, or MCP-based tools and integrations.
  • Experience applying WCAG and inclusive-design practices to complex products and shared systems.
  • Experience with global products, regulated environments, or products that require strong security, privacy, and risk controls.
  • Experience defining and using measures for developer experience, design-system adoption, design quality, delivery effectiveness, or team health.

  • Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, and influence skills, with the ability to create alignment across Product, Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, and business leadership.

Job Summary:

This job will lead a team responsible for the design and delivery of the full suite of benefits offered in your region in this highly visible role. You'll be accountable for the overall vendor strategy and the financial management of programs, and you'll partner with local stakeholders on a roadmap to increase engagement. You'll work with internal and external thought partners and use feedback loops to develop action plans that contribute to our overall global benefits strategy and objectives.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop strategies and recommendations to evolve our regional benefit programs, aligned with local and global objectives.
  • Review and assess benefit programs for financial management, compliance, competitiveness, and effective delivery.
  • Lead the end-to-end vendor review process with our brokers and consultants, overseeing renewals and RFPs for regional benefits and service providers.
  • Build program evaluation metrics with vendors and thought partners to support our decisions to maintain, enhance, or sunset regional benefits.
  • Monitor benefits escalations and themes raised by employees to develop comprehensive engagement plans at various phases in the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, key life events, and departing PayPal.
  • Build a supportive network of stakeholders to advocate for benefits engagement, visibility, and future investments.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

This role owns US benefits strategy across retirement, healthcare, and leave/time off, ensuring programs are competitive, financially sound, and aligned to market benchmarks. The role has indirect oversight of retirement delivery and administration, and partners closely with the leads for US Healthcare and US Leaves & Time Off, as well as Finance, to drive an integrated US benefits roadmap. This is a strategy and financial stewardship role rather than a people-management role. Success depends on influence and cross-functional partnership rather than direct authority.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Owns consultant relationship
  • Own US retirement strategy, providing strategic direction and oversight to the US Retirement Delivery & Administration role on plan design, competitiveness, and vendor strategy.
  • Partner with Finance on all US benefits financials and forecasting, including IBNR, accruals, budget planning, and cost trend analysis across retirement and healthcare.
  • Partner with the US Healthcare lead — who manages vendor relationships, contribution strategy, and engagement with our engagement manager to ensure healthcare strategy is grounded in accurate financials and forecasting.
  • Partner with the Leaves & Time Off benefits manager to benchmark US leave and time off programs against market practice and drive plan design changes across the US region.
  • Develop and maintain a US benefits strategy that ties retirement, healthcare, and leave into one coherent roadmap, aligned to global benefits strategy and objectives.
  • Review and assess US benefit programs for financial management, compliance, competitiveness, and effective delivery.
  • Build program evaluation metrics with vendors, consultants, and internal thought partners to support decisions to maintain, enhance, or sunset US benefits.
  • Monitor benefits escalations and emerging themes to inform strategy and plan design recommendations.
  • Build a strong network across Finance, Healthcare, Leaves, and Retirement to keep US benefits strategy grounded, current, and well-supported.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience with retirement plan strategy (401(k) design, vendor oversight, benchmarking).
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience with benefits forecasting, IBNR, and working directly with Finance/Accounting.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and drive strategy without direct authority over the teams executing it.

Job Summary:

This job independently collaborates within the organization to enhance the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of processes and programs. They operate outside of defined processes to determine appropriate actions while considering alternative solutions.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Independently plan and execute operational processes.
  • Collaborate internally to optimize workflows and drive process improvements.
  • Influence the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of business processes.
  • Determine appropriate actions while considering alternative solutions.
  • Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.
  • Act as a liaison between business leadership, staff, and other key partners.
  • Create, analyze, maintain, and report on performance measures and key performance indicators (KPIs).

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

This job manages global financial analysis and reconciliation for the Corporate Real Estate & Facilities portfolio, including monthly actuals-to-forecast reconciliation, CAPEX/OPEX forecasting and budget tracking, accruals, lease payment processing, sublease invoicing and policy and procedure maintenance. The role builds and maintains rolling capital and operating forecasts, annual project budget trackers, and a master rent roll, while overseeing depreciation of site assets and ensuring real estate obligations are met accurately and on time. This person also delivers monthly financial summaries and variance commentary to leadership, maintains supporting documentation and audit trails for all reconciliation activity, and serves as the primary Finance point of contact for the department. They partner closely with Leasing, Accounting, Finance, Legal and other Places team stakeholders to ensure real estate costs are processed accurately and reflected correctly on the P&L.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Perform monthly financial analysis across the real estate portfolio, identifying variances against budget and prior periods, and reconcile actuals against forecasts and general ledger entries, flagging and resolving discrepancies.
  • Build and maintain rolling CAPEX and OPEX forecasts across the global portfolio, updating models monthly and partnering with stakeholder to reflect current site plans and lease activity.
  • Maintain annual CAPEX and OPEX project budget trackers and roadmaps, monitoring spend against approved budgets and keeping project timelines current across the portfolio.
  • Partner with the different departments within the Places team to prepare and process monthly accruals for real estate and facilities expenses, ensuring accurate coding and support, and reverse/true-up prior period accruals as actuals are received.
  • Process and track monthly lease payments across the portfolio, reconciling against lease terms, escalations, and CAM/operating expense true-ups, and maintain a master rent roll reflecting current payment status and upcoming obligations.
  • Partner with Accounting to ensure all real estate payments are processed timely and accurately on a cash basis and are reflected accurately on the P&L in accordance with accounting policies.
  • Oversee the depreciation of site assets, maintaining the asset list and ensuring depreciation is accurately reflected on the P&L.
  • Develop and maintain all Real Estate & Facilities policies and procedures to ensure consistency, and provide the team with a clear, up-to-date reference as processes and compliance requirements evolve.
  • Deliver monthly financial summaries, analysis and variance commentary to leadership and stakeholders, and maintain supporting documentation and audit trails for all reconciliation activity.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for the department Financial Analyst, ensuring the Finance team's needs are met in partnership with stakeholders.
  • Leverage AI tools and build automation to streamline reconciliation, forecasting, reporting, and overall processes, improving accuracy and efficiency in analytics and financial insights delivered to stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Familiarity with Visual Lease, Ariba, Claude, ChatGPT and SAP are preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Power Point.

Job Summary:

PayPal and Venmo, leading destinations for consumer financial services, are expanding their consumer credit offerings. As Legal Counsel on the U.S. Credit Legal team, you will be a trusted advisor to the business on PayPal and Venmo credit products, focusing on consumer revolving credit products (credit cards), and also supporting Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and other innovative new fintech credit offerings. You will guide new products from ideation through launch, and support the full customer lifecycle. You will partner with Product, Credit Risk, Compliance, Marketing, and our bank and merchant partners to launch and enhance products, and advise on new and emerging legal and regulatory issues. This role suits a pragmatic, business-minded consumer credit lawyer with a curiosity and enthusiasm for cutting edge fintech products and legal issues.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide specialized legal advice and support to enable business strategy while identifying and managing legal risk.
  • Ensure awareness of and advise on compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
  • Build strong partnerships with business counterparts across the enterprise to proactively identify potential legal risks and provide strategic legal guidance.
  • Identify, analyze, and advise on potential legal risks, presenting mitigation options and recommendations to protect the company and enable business objectives.
  • Escalate complex legal issues and significant risks to senior legal leadership where appropriate.
  • Research and analyze new laws, regulations, and regulatory guidance affecting the company's global operations, assessing potential business impact and recommended actions.
  • Manage assigned legal matters through resolution, coordinating with internal stakeholders and external counsel as needed.
  • Maintain current knowledge of legal developments relevant to assigned business areas and communicate implications.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Juris doctorate degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Serve as day-to-day legal counsel for PayPal consumer credit card and other revolving credit products, partnering with Product, Credit Risk, Compliance, Marketing, and Finance from concept through launch and ongoing operation, to include complaint review, marketing review, and issue management.
  • Advise on credit card product design, disclosures, marketing and rewards programs, underwriting and adverse action, servicing, collections, marketing and customer communications to ensure compliance with applicable federal and state consumer credit laws, including TILA/Reg. Z, ECOA/Reg. B, FCRA/Reg. V, EFTA/Reg. E, UDAAP, GLBA, SCRA, MLA, TCPA, and state lending, licensing, and other emerging product-specific laws.
  • Support merchant and partner teams in promoting credit products end to end, including distribution, sales enablement, co-marketing, and related commercial and program agreements.
  • Support PayPal’s relationship with its bank issuer and program partners, including card network rules and program governance.
  • Support regulatory exams, government inquiries, and internal and third-party audits.
  • Monitor and communicate emerging legal and regulatory developments affecting credit cards and consumer credit, fintech, and bank fintech partnerships, and research issues of first impression.
  • Develop practical guidance, templates, and training for business partners.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled tools to improve legal workflows and speed reviews.

  • Experience as in-house counsel at a fintech, bank, card issuer, or lender, or at a law firm with a consumer financial services regulatory practice, advising on consumer credit products from design through launch.
  • Working knowledge of TILA/Reg. Z (including open-end credit rules and CARD Act), ECOA/Reg. B, FCRA/Reg. V, EFTA/Reg. E, UDAAP, GLBA/Reg. P, FDCPA/Rev F, SCRA, MLA, CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and their state law equivalents.
  • Direct experience with credit cards or other revolving credit, including billing error and dispute handling, collections, and card network rules.
  • Familiarity with bank partnership or program-manager models.
  • Familiarity with state consumer lending and licensing regimes and the evolving state BNPL legislative and regulatory landscape, as well as landscapes governing other emerging fintech consumer credit products; experience with legislative or regulatory advocacy is a plus.
  • Experience with regulatory bodies, regulatory exams, and internal and third-party audits.
  • Experience with e-commerce, payments, or co-brand and merchant partnership agreements.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly strategic, creative, and data-oriented Senior Manager, Product Marketing to lead product marketing for Venmo’s Commerce business, specifically small business owners, solopreneurs, and micro-sellers (sub-$100K in annual sales) who are building their livelihoods through Venmo, and the communities of customers who show up for them. This individual will report directly into the Director, Product Marketing, Venmo and will play a pivotal role in shaping the overall product vision, strategy, positioning, and go-to-market for Venmo’s Commerce products. The ideal candidate is an experienced marketing leader in this Commerce space with proven success with this target merchant audience.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex marketing projects and initiatives to drive business growth
  • Resolve complex marketing problems and develop innovative solutions
  • Determine methods and procedures for new marketing assignments
  • Implement global process improvements to enhance marketing effectiveness
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to align marketing strategies with business goals
  • Provide thought leadership and expertise in marketing best practices

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

About the team:


“Just Venmo me.” You may have heard or used this phrase before. Venmo has verb-status and is deeply woven as a brand into the social fabric of our culture. But Venmo isn’t just about payments. It’s about community. It’s where your money finds meaning as you share, connect, and split purchases with friends and loved ones. People love sending money and paying with Venmo, and we've come a long way from our humble beginnings as a P2P app. Millions of users have now also made products such as the Venmo Debit Card a part of their lives, and there’s so much more we can do as their go-to for simple, social and rewarding payments. 


Many small business owners already use Venmo as a Consumer, and this Commerce-specific work evolves the way they view Venmo — from a place to send and receive money, to the ecosystem that helps them build their business: from payment acceptance and backend tools to run their business efficiently, to helping them get discovered by new customers, build repeat relationships, and grow — without asking them to learn a new system or their customers to leave the app they already use.


The Venmo Marketing team is a critical driver of Venmo’s growth trajectory, and the Product Marketing team specifically steers Venmo’s orientation to our customers via a deep understanding of the external landscape and strategic delivery of our evolving value proposition across all channels and partnerships. As a Product Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for crafting product marketing vision and narrative, partnering closely with cross-functional teams across Venmo on inbound and outbound product marketing initiatives to deliver on Venmo’s strategic goals. 


Additional Responsibilities: 

  • Two-Sided Product Strategy & Positioning: Develop and refine positioning, messaging, and value propositions for Venmo’s Commerce products — speaking distinctly and credibly to both the micro sellers and solopreneurs who run their business through Venmo, and the customers who discover and support them.
  • Go-to-Market Leadership Across the Seller Lifecycle: Lead the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for Commerce, building marketing around how small business owners actually operate, including product launches, feature updates, and ongoing marketing campaigns to drive awareness, consideration, adoption, and growth. 
  • Market Insights & Competitive Analysis: Bring firsthand fluency in both sides of this two-sided marketplace — the small, often one-person business, and consumers discovering, following, and being loyal to small businesses in their community. Partner with Consumer Insights on market research and competitive analyses to inform product development and marketing strategies, staying ahead of industry trends to identify new opportunities. 
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Commercial, Design, Consumer Insights, and other key Commerce partners to align on product vision, roadmap, and market needs. Act as the voice of the customer in product development discussions. 
  • Creative Excellence: Work with your Marketing and Creative counterparts to uphold creative excellence throughout your campaigns.  
  • Performance Metrics & Optimization: Define key performance indicators (KPIs) across both sides of the Commerce business (seller/consumer) and measure the success of product marketing initiatives. Use data-driven insights to optimize campaigns and inform future strategies. Partner with Marketing Analytics to post-mortem launches and set us up for a successful learning agenda. 
  • Team Leadership & Development: Manage and mentor a team of more junior product marketing managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. 
  • Stakeholder Management: Effectively engage senior stakeholders across the company, keeping them informed about performance and quickly escalating and unblocking any challenges.

  • People management experience, with a vested interest in setting more junior team members up for short and long-term career success.

We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

PayPal's marketing organization is undergoing a multi-year transformation — building an AI-native operating model that changes how we acquire, activate, and retain customers at scale. The Manager, Marketing Operations & Growth sits at the center of that transformation, turning strategy into execution and keeping the organization moving with clarity and speed.

This is a strategic leadership role — not an administrative one — with real accountability for outcomes and a direct path to senior leadership for the right person.

  • Identify growth opportunities across the marketing organization — new capabilities, partnerships, or operating model improvements that can accelerate key business outcomes
  • Partner with ROI & Effectiveness leads, Data Science, Marketing, and Finance to develop investment scenarios and consolidate them into clear recommendations
  • Translate analytical and financial information into concise recommendations, clearly articulating what leadership needs to decide, why the recommendation is supported, what uncertainties remain, and what action should follow

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Build and manage the internal communications rhythm — town halls, all-hands, leadership updates, and team announcements — keeping the organization aligned and informed
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships across Marketing, Finance, Product, Technology, Legal, and HR — ensuring marketing's priorities are understood and supported
  • Lead cross-functional task forces on priority business issues — convening the right people, driving to decisions, and holding the organization accountable for follow-through

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in marketing strategy, digital marketing, business operations, , and management consulting, ideally in a large consumer technology or fintech organization
  • Proven ability to operate at the intersection of strategy and execution — able to develop a clear point of view and then make it happen
  • Experience supporting or working directly with senior executives — managing agendas, preparing materials, and representing leadership priorities
  • Strong background in marketing operations, budget management, and performance measurement
  • Experience contributing to cross-functional investment, planning, measurement, analytics, or business-review processes across Marketing, Finance, Data Science, Analytics, or business stakeholders.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — able to write a crisp one-pager, a board presentation, and an internal team announcement with equal clarity
  • Strong analytical and structured thinking — able to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations
  • High emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential matters with discretion
  • Bias for action — comfortable moving quickly and making decisions without always having perfect information
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA preferred

Job Summary:

The Manager, B2B Marketing Measurement & Effectiveness will support PayPal's B2B Marketing measurement and investment capability, helping leadership understand how effectively Marketing is contributing to business outcomes, where opportunities exist, and how investment should evolve.

This role partners closely with B2B Marketing, Data Science, Finance, and cross-functional partners to support a fit-for-purpose measurement strategy, helping define key questions, identify data gaps, support the right analytical approaches, and translate evidence into clear business and investment recommendations.

The ideal candidate brings strong B2B marketing measurement experience and solid analytical judgment, including in environments where data is still maturing. This person won't build every model personally; instead, they'll help determine what Marketing needs to learn, ensure the right analytical approach is used, and support leadership in acting confidently even when evidence is imperfect.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and execution of marketing strategies and campaigns
  • Identify and recommend best practices for marketing processes and initiatives
  • Analyze business trends to inform marketing decisions and strategies
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive marketing projects and programs
  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of marketing activities
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior marketing team members

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Support the B2B Marketing measurement and effectiveness strategy, helping translate Marketing and business priorities into a clear roadmap of measurement questions, analytical needs, capability gaps, and investment decisions to be supported.

  • Help build a fit-for-purpose B2B Marketing measurement framework that connects Marketing activity to relevant customer, merchant, funnel, pipeline, revenue, and commercial outcomes based on the Marketing motion and business objective.

  • Support clear measurement priorities and maturity goals, helping determine what PayPal can credibly measure today, where important evidence gaps remain, and which capabilities should be developed first to improve Marketing decision-making.

  • Translate B2B Marketing questions into analytical requirements, partnering with Data Science to help determine the appropriate methodology, data, assumptions, outputs, and interpretation required for the decision being supported.

  • Apply fit-for-purpose measurement judgment across methods, including experimentation, incrementality, attribution, customer or account-level analysis, funnel and commercial-outcome analytics, cohort analysis, econometric approaches, and other methods as appropriate.

  • Help integrate multiple sources of evidence into a coherent view of B2B Marketing effectiveness, clearly distinguishing what is known, what remains uncertain, and which conclusions are sufficiently supported to inform a decision.

  • Contribute to analytically sound recommendations when data or measurement are incomplete, making assumptions and limitations explicit while helping Marketing leadership move forward with the best available evidence.

  • Help build and maintain a prioritized B2B Marketing learning agenda, helping identify the highest-value questions that require stronger evidence and partnering with Experimentation, Data Science, and other teams to close those gaps over time.

  • Support the framing of B2B Marketing investment scenarios and trade-offs, helping translate measurement findings into clear recommendations on where Marketing should increase, decrease, or shift investment across markets, audiences, programs, channels, and customer segments.

  • Partner with the Global Marketing Investment & Measurement team on enterprise allocation questions, providing the B2B evidence, scenarios, constraints, and recommendations to help compare investment opportunities across the broader Marketing portfolio.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in B2B marketing measurement, B2B marketing analytics, marketing effectiveness, GTM analytics, revenue analytics, Marketing Strategy & Performance, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience contributing to a B2B Marketing measurement capability, framework, roadmap, or operating model, including in environments where data or measurement are still maturing.

  • Experience defining appropriate outcomes and KPIs for different B2B Marketing motions and connecting leading Marketing indicators to downstream customer, merchant, pipeline, revenue, or other commercial outcomes.

  • Working knowledge of multiple Marketing measurement approaches, including experimentation, incrementality, attribution, funnel or pipeline analytics, cohort analysis, customer or account-level analysis, econometric methods, and other fit-for-purpose approaches.

  • Ability to help select the appropriate measurement approach for a business question based on available data, customer journey, scale, analytical feasibility, required precision, and the decision being supported.

  • Experience working with incomplete, fragmented, or imperfect data and developing a clear analytical point of view without overstating the strength or causality of the available evidence.

  • Experience contributing to Marketing investment scenarios, evaluating trade-offs, or recommending where B2B Marketing resources should increase, decrease, or shift based on available evidence.

  • Experience contributing to a structured learning agenda and using experimentation or other analytical approaches to help close high-priority Marketing evidence gaps.

  • Experience partnering across Marketing, Analytics or Data Science, Finance, GTM, CRM, data, or business teams where the information required to measure Marketing impact is distributed across functions.

  • Working knowledge of marketing mix modeling is a plus but not required; candidates should understand how MMM can complement other B2B measurement approaches and work effectively with internal or external MMM experts.

  • Experience within enterprise B2B, financial services, fintech, payments, commerce, platform, SaaS, marketplace, or another business with complex customer journeys and data-intensive Marketing is preferred.

Job Summary:
