This is a high-impact role at the intersection of AI-powered commerce, emerging financial infrastructure, identity, and go-to-market execution. You’ll help define how innovations such as AI agents, digital assets, and biometric experiences create meaningful value for merchants, partners, and their customers.

You’ll translate customer and market insights into strategy, craft positioning that sets us apart, and drive launches that fuel adoption and growth. You’ll partner closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, and regional teams to bring these emerging capabilities to market and help define PayPal’s role in the next generation of commerce.

  • Champion customer needs to ensure products address key pain points and deliver value
  • Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new product launches and feature updates
  • Build a deep understanding of markets, competitors, and regulatory landscapes to inform strategy
  • Collaborate with client-facing teams to gather customer feedback and refine product positioning
  • Support the launch of new markets and offers by coordinating with global and regional teams
  • Lead the prioritization and execution of marketing campaigns to increase adoption and market share
  • Provide expertise on product capabilities, value propositions, and best use cases
  • Monitor product performance metrics and identify opportunities for growth and optimization
  • Drive commercial readiness by developing positioning, messaging, and cross-channel launch strategies

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, and Sales teams to drive the commercial success of PayPal’s agentic commerce, crypto and stablecoin, and biometric capabilities. 

  • Champion customer needs to ensure emerging technologies address meaningful business problems and deliver clear value for merchants, partners, and their customers. 

  • Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new products, capabilities, use cases, and market expansions. 

  • Build a deep understanding of customer needs, markets, competitors, emerging technologies and use cases, and relevant regulatory landscapes to inform strategy. 

  • Collaborate with client-facing teams to gather customer and partner feedback and refine product strategy, positioning, and go-to-market priorities. 

  • Identify and prioritize high-value use cases for agentic commerce, AI-powered shopping and payments, digital assets, stablecoins, and biometric experiences. 

  • Develop differentiated positioning, messaging, and value propositions that translate complex and emerging technologies into clear, compelling business value. 

  • Lead the prioritization and execution of marketing programs that build category awareness, increase adoption, and support growth. 

  • Monitor product performance, market developments, and customer feedback to identify opportunities for growth and optimization. 

  • Drive commercial readiness through customer narratives, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, thought leadership, and cross-channel launch strategies.

Strategy 

  • Serve as the voice of the customer, translating insights from customers, partners, Sales, and the market into actionable recommendations for Product teams. 

  • Partner with Product teams to define compelling value propositions and shape product and business decisions across emerging areas such as agentic commerce, digital assets, and identity. 

Go-To-Market 

  • Lead global go-to-market strategy for launches and enhancements across PayPal’s agentic commerce, crypto and stablecoin, and biometric capabilities. 

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to create compelling narratives, build category understanding, scale enablement, and drive customer adoption.

  • Collaborate across Product, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, and regional teams to ensure consistent positioning and effective execution. 

  • Influence senior stakeholders and lead complex initiatives in fast-moving categories where technology, customer expectations, competitive dynamics, and regulation are rapidly evolving. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 6+ years of product marketing, product management, management consulting, or related experience in payments, fintech, AI, crypto, SaaS, or enterprise technology (B2B SaaS). 

  • Proven track record of shaping product strategy and driving successful product launches in a global, cross-functional environment. 

  • Strong analytical and customer orientation, with the ability to translate data, customer insights, and market developments into strategy and execution. 

  • Excellent storyteller, with experience simplifying complex technologies and crafting clear, compelling narratives for business and executive audiences. 

  • Experience or strong knowledge in one or more relevant emerging technology areas — including agentic AI or agentic commerce, AI-powered shopping and payments, crypto, blockchain, stablecoins, digital identity, authentication, or biometrics — strongly preferred. Job Summary:

You don't just manage programs — you move mountains. At PayPal, you'll own how lifecycle marketing actually gets built and delivered in one of fintech's most ambitious marketing modernization efforts: migrating legacy platforms, standing up our next-generation lifecycle platform, and rebuilding the way journeys and content move from idea to customer. You'll orchestrate customer journeys across email, push, and in-app channels that reach hundreds of millions of consumers and merchants globally, and you'll make the process behind them faster, simpler, and repeatable. This is a high-visibility seat — the journeys you launch and the operating model you build will be showcased to the CMO and executive leadership as the face of the transformation. If you want your work felt by millions — this is your moment.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex marketing projects and initiatives to drive business growth
  • Resolve complex marketing problems and develop innovative solutions
  • Determine methods and procedures for new marketing assignments
  • Implement global process improvements to enhance marketing effectiveness
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to align marketing strategies with business goals
  • Provide thought leadership and expertise in marketing best practices

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

About the Team:

You'll join the Lifecycle Transformation team, which carries a CMO-level mandate to modernize how PayPal plans, builds, and measures lifecycle marketing. You'll be one of two Senior Managers leading the Lifecycle Marketing Platform (LCMP) transformation, owning the "Create · Deliver" side of the program, and partnering closely with your counterpart who leads data, decisioning, and measurement. You'll work hand-in-hand with the Transformation Office, AI & Automation, MarTech, Brand and Creative, and partners including Adobe and Publicis Sapient.


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Lead the journey, audience, and content delivery workstream of the LCMP transformation, from journey design and platform migration through scaled adoption across the business. 
  • Own the lifecycle journey portfolio and orchestration strategy across email, push, and in-app, spanning onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and win-back. 
  • Lead the Braze platform build-out and migration from legacy platforms, including journey rationalization, template and component libraries, and channel cutover sequencing. 
  • Drive audience activation in partnership with the Data, Decisioning & Measurement lead, turning audiences and decisions into live, measurable journeys. 
  • Redesign content production and delivery, including modular content, creative workflow, approvals and compliance review, and cycle-time reduction from brief to launch. 
  • Partner with the AI, Orchestration & Process lead to embed future-state process standards, the Integrated Workflow Manager, and AI and automation into campaign build, QA, and launch. 
  • Work with embedded process partners across B2B, Consumer, Venmo, Creative, and Content to drive adoption of standard ways of working, and track progress on the adoption scorecard. 
  • Define and manage operational KPIs and SLAs, including cycle time, campaign volume, quality, and error rates, and run a continuous-improvement backlog so every process keeps getting faster. 
  • Manage systems integrators and agency partners (e.g., Adobe, Publicis Sapient) and maintain a close working partnership with MarTech IT. 
  • Prepare executive reports and roadmap updates, and contribute delivery capacity and sequencing input to annual planning. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 10+ years of experience in lifecycle or CRM marketing, marketing operations, or marketing technology, with at least 3 years in a leadership or people management capacity. 
  • Deep hands-on experience with lifecycle marketing platforms such as Braze, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or Acoustic, including migration planning and platform rationalization across complex enterprise environments. 
  • Track record designing, launching, and scaling multi-channel customer journeys (email, push, in-app, SMS) at enterprise scale. 
  • Experience defining and evolving marketing operating models, including workflow design, creative production processes, content supply chain, and CMS/DAM platforms (e.g., AEM). 
  • Demonstrated experience integrating AI and automation into campaign execution, such as content generation, build automation, and QA. 
  • Experience leading large-scale MarTech transformation programs from business case through execution, managing budgets in the $10M+ range and coordinating systems integrators or consulting partners (e.g., Publicis Sapient, Deloitte, Accenture). 
  • Track record of driving measurable efficiency gains — whether through cycle time reduction, campaign volume scaling, or headcount optimization — while maintaining or improving quality and compliance. 
  • Experience leading change management and adoption across federated, multi-business-unit teams. 
  • Proven ability to build compelling executive narratives and present transformation roadmaps to SVP/C-suite audiences, translating delivery and technology decisions into business outcomes. 
  • Comfortable operating in matrixed organizations where influence without direct authority is essential. 
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree in a related field preferred. 
  • Experience in financial services, fintech, payments, or another regulated industry with formal compliance review is a strong plus. 
  • Background working with agile delivery methodologies and familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Asana, Workfront, or similar tools for program management is expected.

You'll lead the "Understand · Decide · Measure" side of the Lifecycle Marketing Platform (LCMP) transformation, working across the Transformation Office, Data Supply Chain, MarTech, Analytics, and partners including Adobe and Publicis Sapient.


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Lead the data, decisioning, and measurement workstream of the LCMP transformation, from business requirements and architecture decisions through production adoption.
  • Define the customer data, audience, and signal strategy for lifecycle marketing across Data Supply Chain, MarTech, and Analytics, ensuring data is accurate, consented, and decision-ready.
  • Own offer decisioning and next-best-action strategy, translating business rules, eligibility, and propensity models into real-time decisions across email, push, and in-app channels.
  • Build and run an enterprise experimentation program, including test design standards, holdout strategy, and a cadence that turns results into roadmap and budget decisions.
  • Establish the marketing ROI (mROI) and measurement framework, including incrementality, attribution, and baselines that underpin value realization for the program.
  • Own the capability-gap scorecard and benefits tracking, reporting transformation value against baseline to the CMO, Head of Lifecycle Transformation, and executive stakeholders.
  • Ensure audiences and decisions activate cleanly in live journeys, with measurement built into every launch.
  • Bring performance insight into annual planning and budget prioritization, identifying where investment should shift to maximize growth.
  • Champion enterprise data governance principles, including data quality, consent management, and identity resolution, as foundations of effective lifecycle marketing.
  • Prepare executive narratives that translate technical data and decisioning choices into business outcomes and financial impact.

  • Proven leadership of experimentation programs, including A/B and multivariate testing, holdout design, incrementality, and statistical rigor.
  • Strong measurement expertise across marketing mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, incrementality testing, and mROI frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise data governance, consent management, identity resolution, and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Fluency with SQL and modern data and BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Tableau, Looker), with the ability to go deep with analysts, data scientists, and engineers.

  • Comfortable operating in matrixed organizations where influence without direct authority is essential.
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or related field preferred.
  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or payments is a strong plus.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Job Summary:

This role runs internal engineering programs, overseeing multiple engineering operational projects and ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives. You’ll work closely with engineers and technical stakeholders, developing enough context on the systems and infrastructure behind your programs to identify dependencies and risks early. You’ll also actively apply AI agents and emerging tools to planning, synthesis, reporting, documentation, research, and cross-team coordination. We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical program leadership with curiosity and hands-on experimentation—someone eager to identify where agentic workflows can reduce coordination overhead and help teams operate more effectively.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Scope: The project & program responsibilities are focused on the delivery of a product or computer-based system from design to release for customers.
  • Develop and manage program plans, including timelines, milestones, deliverables, and procurement activities.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple projects to ensure alignment with program objectives.
  • Monitor program performance and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Communicate program status to stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Manage program budgets and financials.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and resolve conflicts.
  • Ensure adherence to engineering standards and best practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Proven track record of managing complex programs within an engineering environment.

  • Drive internal engineering programs requiring close partnership with software engineers and technical stakeholders.
  • Develop sufficient understanding of architectures, systems, dependencies, and technical tradeoffs to identify risks and ask informed questions.
  • Identify repetitive coordination, reporting, documentation, research, and planning activities that can be improved through AI-assisted or agentic workflows.
  • Experiment hands-on with AI agents and tools such as Claude Code, Claude Cowork, or comparable technologies as part of day-to-day program management.
  • Design and improve workflows that use AI agents to reduce manual coordination overhead and increase program effectiveness.
  • Champion responsible experimentation with AI-assisted workflows and share effective practices and learnings across the organization.
  • Demonstrated hands-on use of AI assistants, coding agents, or workflow-automation tools in professional or personal projects preferred.
  • Experience working closely with software engineering teams; prior technical, engineering-adjacent, or technical education experience is preferred.
  • Ability to engage credibly in technical discussions without requiring a hands-on software engineering background.
  • Experience automating a recurring workflow, creating a lightweight internal tool, or otherwise applying AI agents to practical work is preferred.
  • Strong curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and a track record of independently experimenting with new tools and approaches.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and applying sound judgment to responsible AI experimentation.

Job Summary:

The Director, Technical Product Management sets the product vision and strategy for Developer Platform Engineering (DPE), spanning CI/CD, Developer Frameworks, observability, test infrastructure, developer tooling, and the developer portal, in close partnership with cross-functional teams and business-unit stakeholders across the company. Leading a team of Technical Product Managers who each own a platform domain end to end, the Director integrates their roadmaps into a single strategy, resolves cross-domain trade-offs, and represents DPE to CTO-level stakeholders. The Director balances architectural judgment with disciplined technical execution, meets regulatory requirements, and treats the developer as the customer, using metrics to define and track platform success. The Director also brings a forward-looking view of the agentic SDLC, meaning how AI agents reshape planning, build, test, and release, and shapes how that thinking gets applied across DPE.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Establish a shared vision across the company for one or more products, or a platform product enabling development & scalability, with a deliberate and cohesive strategy.
  • Leads product strategy development, and develops a clear, executable view of the product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Influences the architectural roadmap and balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Champions the customer experience and prioritizes customer needs in product requirements and decision making.
  • Defines and uses metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Standardizes workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Responsible for product profitability, including budgetary decisions.
  • Leads operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with senior leadership as needed.
  • Maximizes efficiency in a constantly evolving environment where the process is fluid and creative solutions are the standard.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Champion AI fluency across DPE by modeling hands-on use of agentic AI tools and building enablement programs that turn access into measurable value for teams.
  • Track developer experience against Core4 and DORA across all domains, using the data to drive platform excellence and prioritize requirements.
  • Drive standardization initiatives, including SDLC policy, library governance, and quality gates, across a large, federated engineering organization.
  • Own vendor and contract strategy for platform tooling, including build-vs-buy decisions and migrations, in partnership with Technical Product Managers.
  • Hire, coach, and grow Technical Product Managers into stronger technical and product operators, and build the team's succession bench.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Demonstrated ability to ramp quickly into ownership of in-flight, high-stakes programs with existing deadlines and stakeholder relationships.
  • Proven track record architecting and leading agentic AI adoption strategy at an organizational level.
  • Experience operating in regulated environments where audit findings and compliance frameworks shape the roadmap.
  • Substantial experience managing and developing product managers into high-performing operators, with a history of scaling teams through organizational change without losing platform continuity.
  • Experience navigating a federated or matrixed organization, driving influence without full authority over every team on the platform.
  • Track record of vendor and contract management at scale, including high-stakes renewals and platform migrations.
  • Broad technical fluency across the full SDLC toolchain, from source control and build systems to artifact management and deployment pipelines.
  • Sharp prioritization instincts that hold up under competing stakeholder pressure across security, compliance, cost, and velocity.
  • Proven experience presenting to CTO-level audiences and translating platform strategy into business and risk language.
  • Experience managing a platform on a meaningful scale, serving a 10,000+ internal engineering population.

Job Summary:

  • Increases results & effectiveness of all software engineers in a large domain
  • Sets the technology roadmap for a domain

Job Summary:

Enterprise Messaging & Collaboration Engineering owns the platforms PayPal relies on daily, including Slack, Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, and the identity and compliance systems supporting them. The team ensures messaging reliability and that platform controls meet Legal, Compliance, and regulatory requirements. As AI agents increasingly operate alongside employees, it also governs what non-human identities can access and do. This Staff-level role owns the administration and production operations of PayPal’s Slack Enterprise Grid environment, supporting tens of thousands of employees across regulated businesses. Responsibilities include assessing apps, agents, integrations, and Slack Connect requests; managing defensible retention and export configurations; responding to service degradation; establishing architecture and platform standards; and building and operating the services and pipelines surrounding Slack—not simply configuring the platform.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's network and security infrastructure to ensure high performance and reliability.
  • Architect and integrate networks across multiple business units and diverse cloud environments, ensuring seamless connectivity and scalability.
  • Champion the use of Infrastructure as Code processes to automate and maintain infrastructure consistency, scalability, and up-to-date configurations.
  • Oversee the configuration, deployment, and management of F5 Local Traffic Managers (LTMs) and Advanced Security Modules (ASMs) to ensure seamless application delivery and security.
  • Create and implement strategies for integrating cloud Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), interconnects, and direct connects, ensuring efficient and secure data flow between on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance the network’s scalability and resilience, ensuring it can handle growing business demands and traffic loads.
  • Work closely with infrastructure, application, and security teams to ensure network designs meet cross-functional requirements and adhere to best practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Responsibilities

  • Platform ownership: Run day-to-day administration and production operations of Slack Enterprise Grid. This covers org and workspace policy, SSO/SCIM identity integration, and Slack Connect governance.
  • App and agent governance: Approve, scope and revoke apps, integrations and AI agents. Keep an inventory with a named human owner for each agent, and control which external AI clients can reach Slack's MCP server.
  • Compliance and records: Configure and defend retention, legal hold, eDiscovery and audit evidence, including AI-generated content. Check that the archiving vendor supports each new object type before the feature is turned on.
  • Production triage: Lead high-severity messaging incidents to root cause and work Slack vendor cases to closure.
  • Automation and services: Script against the Slack Admin, Discovery, Audit Logs and Web APIs. Build and run the surrounding bots, pipelines and connectors as real cloud services, with infrastructure as code, CI/CD and monitoring.
  • Technical leadership: Set the multi-year direction and standards for the platform. Make build-versus-buy and vendor calls, mentor engineers, and work with Security, Legal, Compliance, IAM and the AI platform team without direct authority.

Job Summary:

This job leads complex projects related to risk management, collaborates with teams to identify risks, develops strategies for risk mitigation, assesses business trends, and drives global process improvements.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex projects and problem resolution efforts related to risk management.
  • Collaborate with teams to identify and analyze risks that may impact operations and assets.
  • Develop and implement strategies for risk mitigation and compliance.
  • Assess current business trends to inform risk management practices and improvements.
  • Drive global process improvements through effective project management and stakeholder engagement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

About the Role

PayPal Europe is seeking a Sr. Manager, Payments and Fraud Oversight to provide independent second-line oversight of payment and fraud-related risks across our European payment operations. You will deliver risk challenge, independent opinion, and thematic analysis, ensuring that first-line processes operate within risk appetite and that controls remain effective.

As part of your role, you will contribute to the continued enhancement of risk analytics, data insight, and technical capability to improve the CRO’s visibility over the payments and fraud risk landscape.

This role is critical to maintaining strong risk governance and alignment with EU and Luxembourg regulatory expectations, while preserving clear separation from Payments Compliance and first-line functions.

Key Responsibilities

Payments and Fraud Risk Oversight

  • Provide independent oversight and challenge on first-line Payments and Fraud Risk Frameworks, ensuring alignment with enterprise risk appetite and EU/Luxembourg supervisory expectations.

  • Review and advise on risk appetite, tolerances, and KRIs/KCIs, ensuring appropriate coverage of payments and fraud risks.

  • Perform independent second-line risk assessments to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of key payments and fraud controls.

  • Monitor and assess risk exposures related to cash and settlement reconciliation, liquidity and funding, ledger integrity, and operational resilience.

Risk Analytics, Data Insight, and Technical Enablement

  • Lead second-line risk analytics initiatives to improve visibility of payments and fraud risk trends through data-driven analysis.

  • Assess and challenge the data sources, metrics, and outputs used by first-line analytics teams, ensuring accuracy and relevance.

  • Partner closely with enterprise and Payments Risk Analytics teams to align data definitions, methodologies, and analytical approaches.

  • Provide independent insights to the CRO and senior management through dashboards, visualizations, and thematic reviews.

  • Encourage continuous development of technical capability within the team, supporting the use of data analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Python, Power BI, and Tableau.

Payments and Fraud Monitoring

  • Monitor key payments and fraud risk exposures, including credit, operational, liquidity, and fraud losses, escalating appetite breaches and emerging trends to senior management and committees.

  • Provide thematic analysis of risk drivers and control effectiveness, focusing on prevention, detection, and mitigation of significant payments and fraud risks.

  • Assess the effectiveness of first-line oversight of partner banks and third-party relationships, including credit, operational, and concentration risk aspects.

Independent Review and Challenge

  • Conduct independent second-line reviews of critical payments and fraud management processes (SEPA operations, acquiring, payouts) and present risk opinions and recommendations to ARCC and CRO forums.

  • Challenge new product, market, or payment-flow changes to ensure that material risks have been properly assessed and mitigated before implementation.

  • Partner with Payments Compliance on regulatory interpretation, maintaining a focus on assessing exposure, control strength, and adherence to risk appetite.

Governance, Collaboration, and Reporting

  • Act as the EU/Luxembourg point of contact for payments and fraud risk oversight, aligning local oversight with global frameworks and governance.

  • Engage regularly with first-line, global risk, and analytics stakeholders to ensure a consistent approach to risk monitoring and reporting.

  • Prepare independent risk reporting and thematic analyses on payments and fraud risk for ARCC, CRO, and senior management.

  • Support interactions with CSSF, ECB, and other European regulators on payments and fraud topics, demonstrating strong oversight and governance practices.

Requirements

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in payments-related roles

  • Strong understanding of payments systems, risk management frameworks, and regulatory oversight applicable to the EU and Luxembourg environment.

  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and metrics; proficiency with Python and database tools is a plus.

  • Experience with visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) strong plus, comfort using data to communicate insights to senior management.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across global and regional teams, prioritize tasks, and manage competing deadlines in a dynamic environment.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge constructively.

Job Summary:

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Enterprise Quality, the Director, Enterprise Quality is a founding leader of PayPal’s new enterprise quality function. Today, quality is managed inconsistently across the company – standards differ from team to team, issues surface late, and feedback loops are broken. The Director helps change that: shaping the common standards and ways of working that make quality an enterprise discipline, and partnering across Product, Engineering, Design, Risk, Servicing, and Go-to-Market to build quality into how PayPal plans, builds, launches, and operates its products.
Working across all three business units and enabling functions, the role concentrates, depending on focus, on defining the enterprise standards for quality or on driving their adoption and adherence in the field. It is fundamentally an influence role: success comes through clarity, trust, and enablement rather than direct authority over business-unit roadmaps.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design, analysis, and optimization of business processes to enhance efficiency, compliance, and effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to align process improvements with organizational goals and strategic priorities.
  • Identify, assess, and resolve complex business process challenges, driving sustainable improvements and measurable business outcomes.
  • Oversee governance frameworks and ensure compliance with internal standards and external regulatory requirements.
  • Leverage Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies to implement large-scale process improvement initiatives with significant impact on cost, quality, and productivity.
  • Develop and implement performance management systems to monitor key process metrics, ensuring accountability and continuous optimization.
  • Lead user acceptance testing and change management efforts to ensure adoption of improved processes and tools.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and mentor, coaching teams and leaders on process improvement best practices and methodologies.
  • Establish and maintain documentation, standards, and best practices to promote operational consistency and scalability.
  • Prepare and present detailed reports, insights, and recommendations to executive leadership on process performance and improvement opportunities.

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

This attorney will work closely and partner with leaders in our merchant checkout products groups and regional legal and business partners globally. You’ll provide legal and regulatory guidance as the product team develops, implements and updates PayPal’s products and services in markets around the globe.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide specialized legal advice and support to enable business strategy while identifying and managing legal risk.
  • Ensure awareness of and advise on compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
  • Build strong partnerships with business counterparts across the enterprise to proactively identify potential legal risks and provide strategic legal guidance.
  • Identify, analyze, and advise on potential legal risks, presenting mitigation options and recommendations to protect the company and enable business objectives.
  • Escalate complex legal issues and significant risks to senior legal leadership where appropriate.
  • Research and analyze new laws, regulations, and regulatory guidance affecting the company's global operations, assessing potential business impact and recommended actions.
  • Manage assigned legal matters through resolution, coordinating with internal stakeholders and external counsel as needed.
  • Maintain current knowledge of legal developments relevant to assigned business areas and communicate implications.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Juris doctorate degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

The successful candidate will have the specific qualifications and experience:


  • 5 or more years of experience practicing either in-house (or in an equivalent setting) or at a reputable law firm, with at least 5 of those years focused on product or regulatory counseling in the Finance or FinTech space.
  • Ability to collaborate with international colleagues in product, sales, and legal to evaluate products in international markets and drive decision-making at a global legal level.
  • Ability to provide timely, concise and business-focused legal advice on US federal and state money transmission and banking regulations; non-US payments licensing regimes; consumer protection laws; data privacy laws; and new rules, enforcement actions and other guidance coming out of regulatory agencies (e.g. CFPB and the FTC in the US).
  • Working knowledge of payment card network and NACHA rules.
  • Experience advising on financial legal issues in support of international product launches.
  • Ability to provide legal and regulatory guidance on the design and modification of products, proactively identify associated risks and recommend mitigation strategies, review product user experiences to ensure legal compliance and proper disclosures, and help document guidance for consumption by members of both the legal and product teams.
  • Familiarity with, and strong interest in, PayPal, creating novel commerce experiences for international audiences, cross-border payments, mobile and alternative payments, emerging payments technology (including agentic commerce) and the payments industry.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and to tolerate change and ambiguity.
  • Ability and drive to take ownership of projects and tasks which, in many cases, will be matters of first impression.
  • Comfortable with gray areas and interpreting and applying the law in unsettled contexts.
  • Confident self-starter with strong interpersonal and organizational skills and a demonstrated ability to effectively and proactively provide sound legal advice, exercise good business judgment, work well with other attorneys, senior management and cross functional stakeholders, and implement policies and processes.
  • Openness to adapting his/her practice in response to the changing landscape of the industry.
  • Facilitate a team-based approach to subject matter management and knowledge sharing, and comfort with a flexible, agile environment that emphasizes collaboration and team performance over management hierarchy or personal gain. The successful candidate will enthusiastically partner with PayPal legal colleagues across our global organization.
  • Creative thinker with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to stay calm under challenging circumstances.
  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent degree.  Admitted to and in good standing with a state bar.
  • Exceptional writing skills, with attention to detail and ability to generate creative original drafted documents.
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills and ability to work both in teams and independently.
  • Ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously, with effective resolution of conflicting priorities.

descriptionHtml:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

PayPal is seeking a strategic and results-driven Senior Manager, Marketing CBT (Field, Partner & Paid Media) to lead integrated marketing across International Growth Markets (IGM), including Asia, MEA, and LATAM. This role is responsible for driving growth through field marketing, partner marketing, paid media, social media, and go-to-market execution, translating global priorities into impactful regional strategies.

As a key marketing leader, you will build scalable programs and playbooks, identify and activate strategic partner opportunities, optimize media investments, and drive customer acquisition, engagement, and revenue growth. Working closely with cross-functional and regional stakeholders, you will establish repeatable frameworks, strengthen marketing capabilities, and position partner marketing as a sustainable, measurable growth engine across diverse markets and partner ecosystems.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex marketing projects and initiatives to drive business growth
  • Resolve complex marketing problems and develop innovative solutions
  • Determine methods and procedures for new marketing assignments
  • Implement global process improvements to enhance marketing effectiveness
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to align marketing strategies with business goals
  • Provide thought leadership and expertise in marketing best practices

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:


Key Responsibilities


This role will lead integrated marketing initiatives for PayPal’s Global Cross-Border Trade business, translating business priorities into insight-led campaigns that drive merchant and consumer awareness, adoption, engagement and growth across priority markets.


The role will partner closely with Product, Commercial, Sales, CRM, Analytics and regional teams to develop go-to-market plans, coordinate multi-channel campaign execution, and measure and optimize performance. 


  • Develop and execute integrated marketing plans for priority cross-border products, markets, customer segments and commercial initiatives.
  • Translate merchant, market and performance insights into clear positioning, messaging, campaign briefs and growth opportunities.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to coordinate go-to-market activity across paid, owned, partner and in-product channels.
  • Define success metrics, monitor campaign performance and recommend optimisations to improve business impact and return on investment.
  • Support marketing budget planning, agency management and scalable ways of working across global and regional teams.
  • Influence senior stakeholders through clear recommendations, performance updates and data-backed business cases.

Partner Marketing Strategy & Growth

  • Lead the channel and partner marketing strategy across Asia, MEA, and LATAM, prioritizing key partner segments and growth opportunities.
  • Develop scalable marketing-to and marketing-through partner programs that combine PayPal-led and partner-led initiatives to maximize reach, engagement, and conversion.
  • Build and institutionalize repeatable partner marketing playbooks, including co-marketing frameworks, partner value propositions, activation models, and performance management approaches.
  • Identify, develop, and execute strategic partner marketing opportunities that support market expansion and revenue growth.

Paid Media & Performance Marketing

  • Own regional paid media strategy, investment planning, and performance management across IGM.
  • Drive efficient budget allocation and optimization to meet acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue objectives.
  • Leverage data, audience insights, and measurement frameworks to continually improve marketing effectiveness and ROI.
  • Partner closely with internal and external stakeholders to drive best-in-class performance marketing execution.

Field & Social Marketing

  • Lead field marketing initiatives across IGM to strengthen brand presence, generate demand, and support local business priorities.
  • Develop and execute regional social media strategies aligned with field marketing, partner marketing, and paid media objectives.
  • Ensure marketing activities are locally relevant while maintaining alignment with PayPal's global brand and growth priorities.

Marketing Capability & Operational Excellence

  • Champion data-driven marketing practices across paid, owned, earned, CRM, lifecycle marketing, and web channels.
  • Establish governance models, operating rhythms, and measurement frameworks to ensure consistent execution and scalable growth across markets.
  • Monitor partner and marketing performance indicators, including conversion, payment success, acquisition efficiency, and commercial contribution, to inform investment decisions.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate closely with General Managers, Product, Go-to-Market, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Global Marketing teams to drive business outcomes.
  • Influence and align stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies, often without direct authority, to deliver strategic priorities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to regional leaders on partner marketing, field marketing, and paid media strategy.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in marketing, growth marketing, partner marketing, performance marketing, field marketing, or related disciplines.
  • Proven success in developing and executing multi-market marketing strategies that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong expertise across multiple marketing disciplines, including paid media, partner marketing, field marketing, social media, CRM, lifecycle marketing, digital marketing, and web marketing.
  • Experience managing marketing budgets, investments, and performance metrics, with a focus on optimizing acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data, insights, and analytics to inform strategy, measure effectiveness, and improve ROI.
  • Proven track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across diverse functions, geographies, and cultures.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate business priorities into scalable marketing programs.
  • Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, payments, e-commerce, digital platforms, or related industries is preferred.
  • Experience marketing within key verticals such as Travel, Retail, Gaming, and B2B is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of partner ecosystems, channel partnerships, and indirect growth models.
  • Experience working across international markets, particularly within Asia, the Middle East & Africa (MEA), and Latin America (LATAM).
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and drive alignment without direct authority.

Job Summary:

The Sr. Manager, Solution Sales, Risk-as-a-Service is part of the North America sales team, partnering with Account Management to grow adoption & transaction margin for PayPal's RaaS solutions across new and existing accounts.

These solutions apply AI-driven risk models, built on transaction data from across PayPal's global network, to help merchants protect revenue while preserving approval rates. Fraud Protection Advanced puts fraud decisioning directly in the merchant's hands with expert support, Chargeback Protection has PayPal assume that risk on eligible transactions, and Dispute Automation centralizes how merchants manage and contest disputes across payment providers.

This is a consultative sales role. The Specialist lead with discovery, diagnosing each merchant's specific needs before designing the right solution & positioning differentiated value against competitors, from opportunity through activation.

Success is measured by profitable volume within assigned verticals.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex projects of diverse scope requiring an understanding of current business trends.
  • Participate in complex problem resolution and determine methods for new assignments.
  • Implement initiatives that result in global process improvements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product sales strategies.
  • Provide expertise in product knowledge and market insights to enhance sales efforts.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:


Additional Required Qualifications 

  • Extensive experience with transactional risk and fraud tools across the transaction lifecycle, and the ability to deploy the right combination of solutions to optimize for a merchant's unique needs; experience with Fraud Protection Advanced (FPA), Chargeback Protection (CBP), and Dispute Automation (DA) specifically is a bonus. 
  • A consistent track record of exceeding quota targets. 
  • A strong analytical mind, with the ability to build ROI-based business cases and evidence-based sales narratives. 
  • Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams to structure win-win commercial outcomes. 
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders informally. 
  • Skilled storyteller, with the ability to communicate a compelling, value-based narrative to executive audiences. 
  • Expert in PowerPoint, Excel, and the Microsoft suite. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Ability to position FPA, CBP, and DA against competitive and in-house alternatives, and translate risk and dispute economics, including chargeback ratios and dispute volume, into a quantified, merchant-specific business case. 
  • 5+ years of experience solution selling to senior executives at Fortune 1000 companies, including experience engaging C-level decision makers across Product, Sales, and Finance. 
  • Experience selling or knowledge of omni-channel and in-store payments solutions. 
  • Expertise in getting the most out of AI, using AI tools to accelerate discovery, research, solutioning, and pipeline analysis, not just familiarity with them. 
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CRM. 
  • Financial analysis experience. 
  • MBA or other advanced degree in Finance, Business, or a related field. 

Additional Responsibilities 

  • Partner with Account Managers to identify, shape, and advance product-specific opportunities for new and existing accounts. 
  • Lead deeper discovery, solution design, competitive positioning, and pricing construction on qualified opportunities. 
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities that require sound judgment and an understanding of current market and business trends. 
  • Carry the target for the opportunities you develop or advance. 
  • Leverage internal and external data to identify growth opportunities and build pipeline. 
  • Own and evolve the specialist team's playbook and selling process. 
  • Collect feedback and recommendations from Account Managers and customers, and channel them back to Product and GTM teams to help shape future product roadmaps. 
  • Designs and positions the right combination of PayPal capabilities, not a single product in isolation, and translates that combination into a client-specific business case and quantified value against competitive alternatives. 
  • Uses sales pipeline, back-book portfolio data, and product and merchant performance data to prioritize opportunities, build the commercial case, and support pricing decisions, treating data as the basis for prioritization, not a supporting exhibit. 
  • Builds credibility with and mobilizes Account Management, Solution Engineering, Integration Engineers, Finance, Legal, and Product without formal authority over those teams. 
  • Acts as a resource and force multiplier for other sellers, sharing knowledge of RaaS systems and operations, and ushering merchants from lead to live with a focus on discovery and solutioning.

Job Summary:

The Credit Platform team builds the core foundation behind PayPal’s global credit ecosystem, powering PayPal’s credit products like Credit Cards, Buy Now Pay Later, Working Capital, and Merchant Term Loans for millions of customers and businesses worldwide.
Our team supports credit products across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Australia, with plans to expand into additional markets in 2026.
We own and develop core credit business capabilities through well-defined RESTful APIs that support the end-to-end credit application journey, from offers and eligibility through application, account management, and asset externalization. Our platform enables consistent and scalable credit experiences across products and markets.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
  • Advises immediate management on project-level issues
  • Guides junior engineers
  • Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
  • Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Design, build, and evolve large-scale backend services that power PayPal’s credit products.
  • Partner with product, risk, compliance, and engineering teams to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Build reusable, configuration-driven systems that support rapid product launches and market expansion.
  • Develop event-driven, asynchronous services using messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka and Pulsar.
  • Improve system scalability, performance, reliability, and observability as platform usage grows globally.
  • Contribute to technical direction through design reviews, mentorship, and shared engineering standards.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
    5+ years of professional experience in software engineering
  • 5+ years in Java, with experience building RESTful APIs using Spring Boot or similar frameworks
  • Proven experience designing microservice architectures and operating high-concurrency production systems
  • Experience with relational databases (Oracle, MySQL), NoSQL databases (DynamoDB), and analytical data warehouses (BigQuery)
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, SQL optimization, and database fundamentals beyond basic CRUD usage
  • Hands-on experience building event-driven systems, including messaging or streaming platforms such as Kafka or Pulsar
  • Experience with asynchronous programming patterns for decoupled, resilient services
  • Demonstrated ability to write reliable, scalable, maintainable, secure, and performant code
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical decisions and mentor other engineers

Nice to have

  • Experience building and operating services on cloud platforms such as GCP, or AWS
    Background in payments, credit, or financial services
  • Strong foundation in large-scale distributed system architecture, including fault tolerance, observability, and cost optimization

Job Summary:

As a Senior Software Engineer (CL6) on the Credit Platform, you will design and operate Java-based backend services alongside BigQuery-powered data workflows that support credit and asset externalization processes.
You will work on systems where real-time services, large-scale data processing, and financial reporting intersect. This role requires strong technical ownership, sound judgment, and comfort operating in environments where system correctness and data integrity are essential.
This is a hands-on role with broad technical scope and meaningful cross-team collaboration.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
  • Advises immediate management on project-level issues
  • Guides junior engineers
  • Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
  • Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build Java-based backend services and RESTful APIs supporting credit and asset externalization workflows
  • Own BigQuery-backed datasets and pipelines used for reporting, reconciliation, and external data delivery
  • Design data models and access patterns that support accurate, auditable representation of credit assets
  • Optimize BigQuery performance, cost, and reliability using partitioning, clustering, and query tuning
  • Build and operate real-time and near-real-time pipelines using Pub/Sub, batch or streaming frameworks, and Java services
  • Leverage Dataproc for large-scale data processing and synchronization across BigQuery tables
  • Ensure strong observability, data quality controls, and operational readiness across services and data workflows
  • Partner with product, finance, risk, compliance, and engineering teams to deliver secure and compliant solutions
  • Influence platform architecture and best practices through design reviews and technical leadership.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of professional experience as a software engineer building production systems
  • Strong proficiency in Java, including designing and building RESTful APIs using Spring Boot or similar frameworks
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience on Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions
  • Deep expertise in BigQuery internals, includingQuery execution plans and performance tuningTable partitioning and clustering strategiesPartition sizing and cost versus performance tradeoffsBulk updates, real-time updates and deletes, and materialized views
  • Experience designing and operating real-time and near-real-time data pipelines
  • Strong experience with logging, monitoring, and observability, including dashboards, alerting, and production troubleshooting
  • Proficiency with IAM, service accounts, and data access controls, including data localization and compliance requirements
  • Ability to design scalable, reliable systems with a strong focus on correctness, performance, and operational excellence

  • Experience building systems that support financial reporting, reconciliation, or external data sharing
  • Familiarity with regulated environments and auditability requirements
  • Experience with modern data architectures such as Data Lakes, Data Mesh, or Data Fabric
  • Background in payments, credit, or financial services

Job Summary:

PayPal Credit’s Developer Experience (DevEx) team designs, deploys, and operates cloud-native platforms supporting Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL), consumer revolving credit, and merchant lending products across AWS, on-premises environments, and PayPal’s modernization strategy into GCP. DevEx partners with business, product, Security, Compliance, Audit, Edge, and Networking teams to deliver innovative infrastructure, reduce friction, streamline operations, and accelerate product launches.

We are seeking a Manager, Systems & Cloud Engineering to lead Cloud Infrastructure Engineers and serve as a strategic product partner. This role will own the roadmap for platforms, tools, and service architecture supporting PayPal Credit, including the Loan Management System built on Apache Fineract. The manager will align resources to business priorities, partner with security, audit, and compliance stakeholders, and oversee budgets and vendors.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead a team of highly skilled network engineers, providing technical guidance and support.
  • Develop and manage both long-term and short-term strategic transformation plans.
  • Implement scalable global connectivity solutions and oversee all phases of project lifecycles.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to address hybrid cloud connectivity requirements.
  • Champion the development of network lifecycle automation and visibility/telemetry tools.
  • Drive business outcomes by acting as a customer advocate.
  • Vendor Relationship Management: Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and influence the vendor community's roadmap.
  • Co-lead initiatives in industry innovations.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Additional Responsibilities

  • Own the DevEx product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog by translating business priorities and developer feedback into JIRA epics that define the team’s work.
  • Lead, coach, hire, and develop a team of infrastructure engineers, including performance management and career growth.
  • Direct the design, deployment, and operation of infrastructure powering PayPal Credit's Loan Management System and lending products, spanning AWS and on premises environments, certificate lifecycle management, patching, disaster recovery, and resiliency testing.
  • Serve as the primary partner for Security, Audit, and Compliance, overseeing vulnerability remediation, PCI/SOX requirements, access reviews, and audit responses.
  • Manage AWS budgets, vendor relationships, purchase orders, invoices, forecasting, and cost-optimization initiatives.
  • Partner with development and business teams to remove delivery blockers and identify new platforms, tools, and partnerships that support product launches and revenue growth.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of direct engineering management experience, preferably in DevOps, SRE, cloud, or infrastructure engineering. Prior experience as an engineer in one of these disciplines is a plus.
  • Experience owning technical product roadmaps and translating business priorities into actionable backlogs.
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD and deployment tooling, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), scripting, and monitoring and observability platforms (Datadog, Splunk).
  • Experience managing cloud budgets, optimizing infrastructure costs, and using tools such as AWS Cost Explorer, tagging, and committed-use discounts.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities and partnering with security teams and auditors on PCI, SOX, cloud security, and access-control requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to represent technical roadmaps to senior leadership, security, and audit partners.

Job Summary:

The Director, Bank Controller is a Utah-based leader responsible for establishing and leading PayPal Bank’s controllership function. Reporting to the Bank CFO, the Director owns legal-entity books and records, accounting policy, close and balance-sheet controls, GAAP and regulatory reporting, ACL accounting, internal controls, and external audit coordination.

The Director is accountable for accurate, complete, timely, and auditable financial information and an accounting framework appropriate for an FDIC- and state-supervised industrial bank. The role retains authority over ledger integrity, accounting decisions, key journal entries, reporting certifications, and submissions, while overseeing affiliate and third-party services. The Director partners with Finance, Treasury, Risk, Legal, Tax, Operations, Technology, and Internal Audit and serves as the Bank’s accounting subject-matter expert for regulators and external auditors.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of financial controllers and ensure their effective performance
  • Perform risk assessments and identify improvements in the control and risk management framework
  • Develop and maintain accounting and reporting processes in compliance with laws and regulations
  • Monitor Key Performance Indicators and Key Risk Indicators to drive operational performance
  • Ensure regulatory compliance of outsourced activities
  • Manage the month close process and present reports to senior leadership
  • As a finance leader, you will help shape the strategy for CAO and finance, and influence decision making of stakeholders across the enterprise.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline (or equivalent combination of education and experience); active CPA license required.
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting and controllership experience, including meaningful experience within an insured depository institution or comparable regulated banking environment.
  • 5+ years in a senior management or Director-level role with responsibility for accounting teams, financial reporting, regulatory reporting, and first-line controls.
  • Deep knowledge of bank GAAP and regulatory accounting, including Call Report preparation, standalone bank financial statements, CECL/ASC 326, investment securities, loan, deposit and payments accounting, regulatory capital, and intercompany accounting.
  • Demonstrated experience with close and reconciliation governance, accounting policy, ICFR, external audit, control-deficiency evaluation, and Part 363 or SOX environments.
  • Experience with bank accounting systems, general ledgers and subledgers, data lineage, interface controls, and oversight of activities delivered through affiliate or third-party service arrangements.
  • Direct experience supporting banking regulators and communicating complex accounting, data, control, and service-provider matters to auditors, executives, technologists, and Board-level stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with a de novo bank charter, industrial bank buildout, bank conversion, acquisition, or comparable financial-institution transformation.
  • Big Four or other major public-accounting experience serving banks or financial institutions.
  • Experience with affiliate-supported or outsourced operating models, including service governance, performance monitoring, Regulation W, TPRM, SOC reports, and contingency planning.
  • Experience with merchant and/or consumer lending, digital deposits, acquiring and settlement accounting, bank regulatory-reporting platforms, and CECL production.

Job Summary:

PayPal is seeking a Senior Director, Product Growth to lead end-to-end growth across our U.S. consumer credit portfolio, including PayPal Credit, PayPal Cashback Mastercard, and Venmo Credit Card. This leader will shape and drive a cohesive strategy spanning customer acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and lifetime value. Working across the PayPal and Venmo ecosystems, the role will bring together product, marketing, pricing, rewards, channel, and lifecycle strategies to unlock new growth opportunities, deepen customer relationships, improve the end-to-end experience, and drive portfolio health and sustainable growth.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Drive revenue growth and global market expansion by identifying and cultivating strategic partnerships, channels, and opportunities
  • Lead the negotiation with external partners and engage cross-functional support colleagues to ensure the successful delivery of solutions for large complex partnerships
  • Develop and execute an overall business strategy to identify and cultivate strategic partnerships, channels, and opportunities to drive revenue growth and global market expansion
  • Influence the negotiation with external partners, engaging cross-functional support colleagues, to ensure successful delivery of solutions for large complex partnerships
  • Align product and business levers (such as pricing and FX) to maximize revenue and market expansion opportunities
  • Engage closely with product, engineering, and architecture teams to drive the architectural runway and determine the best technical implementation/design
  • Represent the end customer on an ongoing basis and use this knowledge to drive effective prioritization and decision-making

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Role Scope & Priorities 

  • Shape the vision for growth across the U.S. consumer credit portfolio - PayPal Credit, PayPal Cashback Mastercard, and Venmo Credit Card - leveraging industry best practices, the broader PayPal and Venmo ecosystems, and innovative growth drivers. 
  • Develop and execute an overall business strategy that unifies new-customer acquisition and existing-customer growth across the three products into a cohesive portfolio strategy. 
  • Support acquisition strategy across the portfolio and partner with the US Consumer and Venmo teams to unlock cross-sell and upgrade opportunities, optimize placement and targeting, and expand the addressable customer base. 
  • Partner with Product, Risk, and the issuing bank to improve the application, underwriting, onboarding, and activation experience and improve funnel conversion. 
  • Partner to drive existing-customer growth across early-month-on-book, engagement, reactivation, retention, and win-back, while improving the end-to-end customer experience. 
  • Shape and align growth levers including product roadmap inputs, go-to-market and marketing strategy, pricing and rewards economics, offers and incentives, channel mix, and customer lifecycle management. 
  • Champion the voice of the customer and influence priorities across US Consumer, Venmo, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Risk, Analytics, Finance, Legal and Compliance, as well as issuing bank, network, and merchant partners. 
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team, with success measured through portfolio health and product growth, delivered jointly with the US Consumer team and partner functions. 

Experience & Capabilities 

  • Issuer-side credit card experience required, with demonstrated experience currently leading or having previously led a sizable credit card portfolio at a major issuer. 
  • Demonstrated track record driving both new-customer acquisition and existing-customer growth for a consumer credit or card portfolio. 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and influence key portfolio and P&L performance levers, including revenue, costs, credit and fraud losses, pricing, rewards, and lifecycle economics, while operating with an owner mindset. 
  • Strong understanding of consumer credit needs, consumer behavior, and portfolio P&L dynamics. 
  • Experience developing strategy and roadmaps for large-scale products and translating business priorities into measurable execution. 
  • Experience working with issuing bank and network partners in a partnership or co-brand credit model. 
  • Experience leading significant co-brand or portfolio negotiations or renegotiations. 
  • Breadth across risk, fraud, product, and operations 
  • Experience with card processors such as Fiserv and navigating both legacy platforms and modern digital experiences. 
  • Proven ability to lead through complex, highly matrixed organizations and influence cross-functional teams. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify gaps and initiate solutions in complex environments. 
  • Strong communication skills, with experience presenting portfolio performance, insights, and recommendations to senior internal and external leaders. 
  • Exceptional people leadership capabilities, with experience building, coaching, and developing high-performing teams.
