Job Summary:

This job oversees key Treasury processes (e.g. global cash management activities, FX, investments). you will introduce and implement best practices for Treasury based on your proven expertise. You will prioritize projects within your function and you will be responsible for timely delivery of quality of Treasury projects related to your area. You will collaborate with peers under direction of Treasury leaders to optimize treasury processes, manage liquidity, and collaborate with internal teams for compliance and product expansion.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of key Treasury processes such as corporate cash management or FX risk management activities.
  • Partner with internal constituents to solve corporate cash management issues.
  • Leading junior treasury team members for professional growth.
  • Institute and socialize BCP/BIA processes and planning.
  • Maintain and manage Treasury Workstation usage, optimization, testing, and upgrades.
  • Integrate acquisitions and standardize policies across the organization.
  • Provide oversight of intercompany loans and other Treasury Policies.
  • Identify automation initiatives for daily operations efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Risk and Compliance teams for regulatory and licensing compliance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

The Treasury Manager position will report to the Treasury Senior Manager, Product Liquidity & New Products and be based in the Luxembourg.


In this hands-on role you will 1)  manage cash forecasting models 2) ensure sufficient funds are available to meet ongoing operational requirements 3) manage treasury regulatory aspects of EU and UK PayPal entities


The Treasury Manager will also operationalize the design of product funds flow and lead the transformation of day-to-day EMEA operations, collaborating with the Bank Admin team to stand up new bank accounts, funding sweeps or other banking and/or Treasury systems infrastructure to support new product rollouts at PayPal. The Treasury Product Liquidity function is integral to the strategy & execution of liquidity to support PayPal’s global business and is responsible for ensuring appropriate management of company’s financial resources in accordance to treasury policies and procedures. The team works closely with Finance functions (such as Accounting, Tax, Intercompany Group, Controllership), other internal constituents (such as Legal, IT, Product), and external parties (particularly banking partners). The New Products function supports new initiatives across PayPal globally, serving as a primary point of entry for Product and Commercial teams and enabling successful product delivery. The Treasury New Products team represents Treasury for all new initiatives impacting liquidity strategies and account structures.


Your way to impact


  • You will develop and maintain robust, forward-looking cash and FX forecasting and controls that ensure products are always funded, compliant, and resilient to incidents across markets
  • You will strengthen the operating environment by deepening bank and cross-functional partnerships, resolving payment issues quickly, and driving automation that removes manual work and repeat errors
  • You will embed Treasury into new product design by shaping funds flows, bank account structures, and tooling so launches are operationally smooth and scalable from day one

In your day-to-day role you will

  • Support and provide oversight of day-to-day cash management operations, including cash and FX needs forecasting, in accordance with treasury policies and procedures to meet PayPal product liquidity and PayPal entities regulatory requirements
  • Support the EU and UK treasury regulatory activity (safeguarding, regulatory projects)
  • Identify weaknesses and associated risks in our internal process controls and recommend mitigation of risks and reduction of repeat operational issues
  • Document, maintain and update operational processes, exceptions to policies and cross-train
  • Identify opportunities for and explore the build-out of critical tools to automate routine work where possible and address longer-term issues, partly through design of monitors, reports, dashboards & early warning mechanisms (with product and engineering teams)
  • Work on the optimization of the banking infrastructure and automation of EMEA operations, ensuring alignment with EU regulatory requirements and oversight bodies
  • Understand product flows and any operational issues as it relates to payment rails
  • Manage our bank relations and ensuring a functioning set-up while we expand to new countries or integrate new acquisitions
  • Participate in the development of funds in/out processes for existing and new products. Work across business functions including Engineering, Compliance, Finance and Product/Platform.
  • Participating in financial contract/ instrument review and negotiations
  • Incident management, including tracking & reporting, and support settlement of customer activities for fiat and crypto flowing through the platform
  • Support resolution of payment operational challenges (with internal and external teams)
  • Execute on continuous improvement of our treasury & cash management tools, systems and processes, including cash flow, liquidity & FX forecasting, payments and reconciliations
  • Work on ad hoc projects as assigned

What do you need to bring


  • Expertise in cash management, ideally including euro payment schemes and infrastructures such as SEPA Credit Transfer, SEPA Instant Credit Transfer and SEPA Direct Debit. Experience should include operations, real-time monitoring, incident management, and a strong focus on scheme compliance and controls.
  • Demonstrated experience automating and transforming cash management activities through technology.
  • Hands‑on experience operating TARGET services (T2/RTGS, TIPS) via ESMIG, including ISO 20022‑based connectivity, intraday liquidity management, queue and limit configuration, and straight‑through processing with robust reconciliation and exception handling
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, and comfortable working with executive leadership
  • Self-motivated and results oriented, a problem-solver who takes initiative and able to prioritize and execute tasks
  • Intellectually curious, able to handle sensitive information, and to communicate and make decisions under pressure
  • Demonstrated leadership qualities and ability to build strong internal and external relationships across geographies and functions, getting work done through others
  • Team-oriented, cooperative and collaborative
  • Enjoys working in a fast-paced and autonomous environment
  • 5 years+ of experience in the treasury function, preferably within regulated financial industries
  • Master’s degree in finance, accounting or similar related fields preferred. MBA, CFA, CTP a plus
  • Fluency in English a must, other languages will be advantageous

Job Summary:

Operating autonomously in-market while staying tightly aligned to global strategy, the role balances product design with technical, regulatory and customer needs to deliver relevant, high-quality experiences. It drives in-year growth and investment decisions within global parameters, owning consumer outcomes, commercial performance and P&L. Co-designing products with the global Consumer team, it adapts the local proposition and leads cross-functional partners across product, financial services, marketing, CRM and GTM, using standardized analytics and market research for data-driven decisions. Success is measured through growth, relationship depth, funnel health, PP+ execution, revenue and market intelligence that shapes global product strategy.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Drive revenue growth and global market expansion by identifying and cultivating strategic partnerships, channels, and opportunities
  • Lead the negotiation with external partners and engage cross-functional support colleagues to ensure the successful delivery of solutions for large complex partnerships.
  • Develop and execute an overall business strategy to identify and cultivate strategic partnerships, channels, and opportunities to drive revenue growth and global market expansion.

  • Engage closely with product, engineering, and architecture teams to drive the architectural runway and determine the best technical implementation/design.
  • Represent the end customer on an ongoing basis and use this knowledge to drive effective prioritization and decision-making.
  • Collaborate and influence product outcomes in a matrix organization with multiple stakeholders such as Engineering, Operations, Risk, Legal, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Finance, and Banking Partners.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • End-to-end ownership of a consumer growth funnel in a market or regional context — from acquisition and activation through habituation and revenue — with a track record of hitting commitments like active accounts, new accounts volume and quality, 7-day activation, 30-day habituation, and PP+ enrollment against plan. These also carry financial responsibilties for your market to meet commitments

  • Fluency in turning cohort and funnel data into concrete growth, risk, and investment calls — deciding where to lean in, where to pull back, and when a product or engagement lever is the right fix.

  • Experience shaping global product direction from the field: synthesizing local market signal into a ranked, quantified narrative that earns a seat in product discovery and roadmap conversations, even without formal roadmap authority.

  • A history of co-owning launches from day one — signing off readiness at ramp gates and ensuring products land on time, at quality, with the network (merchant, partner, or channel) genuinely activated.

  • Comfort operating at the intersection of demand and supply: representing consumer priorities into merchant or partner relationships while leaving deal terms and platform build to the teams that own them.

  • Proven influence across a matrixed organization — product, marketing, CRM, GTM, sales, and financial services — without direct authority over any of them, built through clear priorities, trust, and disciplined trade-offs.

  • Background in payments, financial services, technology, or another complex marketplace, ideally with direct P&L, commercial strategy, or consumer product management experience.

  • Strong quantitative instincts — able to size market opportunity, judge cohort and product quality, and defend a business case with numbers, not just narrative.

  • An executive communication style: confident setting vision, comfortable making hard trade-offs, and credible enough to align stakeholders who don't report to you.

  • A bias for autonomy and sound judgment in ambiguity — commercially minded, customer-obsessed, and results-driven even when the mandate is broad and the org lines are blurry.

  • Solid background from the payments and fintech landscape

  • Exposure to loyalty programs

Job Summary:

This job leads the direction and execution of the organization's recruitment processes. They drive efforts to optimize and streamline operations, ensuring efficiency and scalability. This job involves developing and implementing innovative strategies to attract top talent, enhancing the candidate experience, and recognizing the broader impact on other business areas. The Senior Manager analyzes data from multiple sources to make informed decisions, effectively communicating complex information and presenting various options. They utilize best practices and knowledge of industry trends to continuously improve Talent Acquisition services. Collaboration with senior leaders, peers, and internal partners is essential, and they manage large-scale projects and cross-functional initiatives to support the organization's growth and success

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Leads large and complex cross-functional and cross-organizational recruiting projects and programs with high visibility
  • Designs, evaluates, and selects process and service improvements based on thorough understanding of business needs and industry trends
  • Develops new procedures, processes, and standards for Talent Acquisition to improve operating effectiveness, creating better candidate experience and efficiency in recruiting process
  • Identifies and resolves unique situations of substantial significance, requiring conceptual and creative thinking to develop solutions to complex problems with broad impact on the business; appropriately challenges the status quo with solutions
  • Leverages knowledge of external trends and evolving practices to guide decisions and make recommendations on how trends may be operationalized at PayPal
  • Viewed as a key advisor and influencer of overall Talent Acquisition strategy
  • Strong influence on how PayPal identifies and invests in talent pipeline
  • Proactively identifies and participates in the resolution of complex problems that impact the direction of PayPal’s talent pipeline and candidate experience
  • Develops and delivers innovative strategies that benefit hiring managers
  • Leads major projects which impact Talent Acquisition or assigned business unit
  • Collaborates with customers, peers, account leaders and internal and external partners

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Engineering Recruiting to lead a team of recruiters supporting our Engineering organization. You will translate business priorities into recruiting plans, develop a strong team, and partner with Engineering leaders to hire the technical talent their organizations need.

This role requires someone who can move between strategy and execution: advising leaders on hiring priorities, coaching recruiters through complex searches, and addressing the issues that affect hiring results. You will bring sound judgment, technical recruiting expertise, and the ability to build productive partnerships across a complex organization.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the team. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, and hold recruiters accountable for search quality, stakeholder partnership, candidate experience, and results. Build their ability to advise hiring managers and independently manage challenging searches.
  • Own recruiting delivery for your Engineering portfolio. Translate approved hiring plans into recruiting priorities, allocate team capacity based on role complexity and business needs, and adjust plans as priorities change.
  • Advise Engineering leaders. Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and hiring managers. Bring market insight and recruiting data to discussions about talent availability, role requirements, location, compensation, and hiring timelines. Challenge assumptions and recommend practical tradeoffs.
  • Guide technical search strategy. Help recruiters and sourcing partners develop targeted approaches for specialized and difficult-to-fill roles. Ensure searches reflect the skills, experience, and scope each team needs.
  • Strengthen hiring decisions. Partner with hiring managers to define clear role requirements, establish consistent evaluation criteria, and prepare interview teams to assess candidates effectively. Address unclear expectations or conflicting feedback that slows decisions.

Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to help shape the future of Commerce at Venmo.

Millions of people already use Venmo to pay businesses, whether they’re paying a local business in the Venmo app or using Pay with Venmo at checkout. And we believe there’s a much bigger opportunity ahead.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Manages multiple projects through direct reports and may directly manage individual software development projects. Ensures project delivery through supervision of costs, methods, and staffing
  • Sets operational targets that impact their group and drives operational rigor around engineering KPIs such as unit test coverage, uptime/resiliency targets, execution velocity
  • Responsible for the delivery of projects and continuous improvement that impact up to three domains
  • Leads the effort in resolving highly complex or unique technical situations that impact business success or addresses future concepts, products, or technologies
  • Creates the roadmap for multiple scrum teams. Responsible for turning a high-level operational strategy into a well-defined resourcing plan
  • Demonstrates perseverance in pursuing difficult, complex, or ambiguous goals or problems, applying advanced analytical thought and judgment.
  • Collaborates with direct team, managers in org, stakeholders, managers in other orgs and business stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Venmo has always made payments between people simple and social. We want to bring more of that experience to commerce, making it easier for customers to discover and pay businesses they care about, and giving merchants better ways to reach and engage Venmo customers. 

You’ll own engineering for a big part of that experience. You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to define what we build, set the technical direction with your engineering team, and turn ideas into products that operate at Venmo scale. 

This isn’t a role where everything is already mapped out. We have clear business goals and a strong foundation, but there are still important product and technical questions to answer. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable with that ambiguity and wants to help chart the course.

What You’ll Do 

  • Lead and develop an engineering team responsible for building and scaling Venmo Commerce products used by millions of customers and businesses 
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Analytics, and business teams to identify customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn ideas into products 
  • Own the technical direction for your area, working with senior engineers and architects to make decisions that balance speed, simplicity, reliability, and long-term scale 
  • Build a strong team through hiring, coaching, regular feedback, career development, and thoughtful organizational design 
  • Give engineers clear ownership and the context and autonomy to make good decisions 
  • Drive execution across complex initiatives, identify risks early, and help the team navigate dependencies and changing priorities 
  • Maintain a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, security, and operational excellence 
  • Make thoughtful trade-offs when there isn’t an obvious answer and communicate those decisions clearly 
  • Work across Venmo and PayPal when solving problems that span products, platforms, or organizations 
  • Build a culture where people challenge assumptions, learn quickly, take ownership, and care deeply about the customer experience 
  • Help the team use AI effectively in how we build software, from development and testing to debugging and operations, while applying good judgment about where AI adds value and where it doesn’t 

What We’re Looking For 

  • Significant experience leading software engineering teams and delivering complex products at scale 
  • A track record of building, developing, and retaining strong engineering teams 
  • Strong technical judgment. You don’t need to be writing code every day, but you should be able to go deep when needed, ask the right questions, and guide teams through difficult architecture and engineering decisions 
  • Experience building large-scale distributed systems and familiarity with modern mobile, web, and backend architectures 
  • Experience taking products or major capabilities from idea through launch, iteration, and scale 
  • Strong product instincts and a customer-first mindset. You think about the problem we’re solving before the technology we’re using to solve it 
  • AI fluency and hands-on experience using modern AI tools in software development. You understand their strengths and limitations and can help a team adopt them thoughtfully to improve engineering velocity and quality 
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, bringing structure to complex problems, and adjusting as customer and business priorities evolve 
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to build trust with Product, Design, business, and engineering partners 
  • Clear communication and the ability to explain complex technical decisions to different audiences 
  • A consistent track record of delivering on commitments without sacrificing engineering quality or the health of the team 

Nice to Have 

  • Experience with payments, fintech, or other highly available financial systems 
  • Experience building consumer products at significant scale 
  • Background in commerce, marketplaces, social products, or platform businesses 
  • Experience building products or tools for merchants and small businesses 
  • Experience working in both fast-moving and large-scale engineering environments 
  • Experience leading teams across multiple locations or time zones

Job Summary:

PayPal Bank (In formation) is seeking a Director, Head of Core Banking Technology Platforms, to lead the strategy, architecture, implementation, and operation of platforms supporting deposits, lending, payment gateway services, and Federal Reserve master-account connectivity. The deposit platform will be built on a modern, cloud-native core, while lending will leverage and evolve existing in-house capabilities. The role will also lead payment gateway implementation and related Federal Reserve payment services. The leader will unify these capabilities through composable APIs and event-driven architecture, integrating with PayPal’s identity, fraud, credit, payments, finance, treasury, compliance, data, servicing, and customer-experience platforms. This highly visible role requires deep banking and payments expertise, strong architectural judgment, and experience delivering secure, resilient, regulated infrastructure at scale

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Directs and controls the delivery of business and technical outcomes that comprise multiple projects and operational activities within a domain through organizational and technical leadership
  • Defines engineering health objectives that drive organization health, engineering best practices and operational targets
  • Drives product and technical strategy with cross-functional leaders across the enterprise to deliver Domain goals
  • Responsible for the delivery of programs, establishing annual organizational goals and ensuring performance and results that impact both their domain and potentially enterprise
  • Develops engineering strategy that translates into operational and tactical plans; uses ground-breaking methods to think beyond existing solutions
  • Sets the tri-annual roadmap for a domain level organization. Defines the operational strategy for a domain based on a defined budget
  • Evaluates key business challenges and can complete complex, ambiguous initiatives having impact across engineering; directs the development of new or innovative solutions. Ability to deal with high levels of technical domain level ambiguity.
  • Collaborates with direct team, managers in org, stakeholders, managers in other orgs, external partners and business stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2 years of experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Build the technology foundation for PayPal Bank, establishing a modern banking platform that can scale from initial deposit products to broader banking, lending, and payment capabilities across the PayPal ecosystem.
  • Lead the implementation, integration, and evolution of a modern, cloud-native core banking platform, including product configuration, integration architecture, testing, production launch, and ongoing modernization.
  • Own the end-to-end technology architecture for banking products, spanning account onboarding and servicing, deposits, lending, transaction posting, interest processing, ledgering, reconciliation, and general-ledger integration.
  • Design and deliver integrations across PayPal’s enterprise ecosystem, connecting banking platforms with identity, fraud, risk, credit decisioning, compliance, payments, treasury, finance, servicing, and data capabilities.
  • Establish reusable APIs, events, and banking services that enable banking capabilities to be securely consumed across PayPal products while supporting an extensible, event-driven architecture.
  • Deliver secure, resilient, highly available, and auditable banking infrastructure, establishing strong financial controls, observability, data lineage, production readiness, and connectivity to payment networks and Federal Reserve payment services.
  • Build and lead a high-performing banking technology organization and partner ecosystem, developing senior engineering and architecture talent while managing strategic vendors and remaining actively engaged in critical architecture and technology decisions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of software engineering or technology-platform experience, including significant leadership responsibility, with 7+ years leading engineering teams supporting banking, payments, financial services, or other highly regulated platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing, modernizing, or operating core banking platforms spanning deposits, lending, payments, or related financial infrastructure.
  • Deep knowledge of banking technology and operations, including deposit accounts, lending systems, transaction posting, interest processing, clearing and settlement, reconciliation, ledger design, double-entry accounting, and general-ledger integration.
  • Experience with modern cloud-native banking cores, enterprise API platforms, event-driven distributed systems, and public- or hybrid-cloud environments.
  • Experience with bank payment connectivity, including ACH, wire, instant payments, payment gateways, and ideally Federal Reserve services such as FedACH, Fedwire Funds Service, or FedNow Service.
  • Knowledge of regulated banking environments, including FDIC-insured deposits, FBO/custodial/omnibus structures, pass-through deposit insurance, brokered deposits, technology risk, cybersecurity, financial-crime controls, and related regulatory requirements.
  • Experience launching a de novo or digital bank, building configurable interest-bearing banking products, or integrating separate deposit and lending cores through shared API, event, and accounting architecture is highly desirable; bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Job Summary:

The Senior Manager, Systems Analysis and Technical Delivery will lead technical requirements, systems analysis, technical product delivery, and user acceptance testing for PayPal Bank products and platforms. The role will oversee requirements and delivery across APIs, core banking, data, vendor integrations, and enterprise shared services.
This leader will establish the requirements and delivery cadence necessary to support the Bank’s initial technology buildout and ongoing operations. Working closely with Product, Technical Program Management, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and external vendors, the individual will translate business and regulatory needs into technical requirements and drive execution from solution design through implementation and production readiness.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the analysis of business processes and gather requirements from various stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement effective solutions.
  • Convert system specifications into detailed technical requirements.
  • Manage user acceptance testing to ensure deliverables meet business needs.
  • Identify and resolve system issues, providing ongoing support and maintenance.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of system processes and specifications.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Lead the elicitation, analysis, documentation, validation, and lifecycle management of business, functional, technical, data, integration, operational, and regulatory requirements.
  • Translate product and business objectives into system specifications, process flows, API and integration requirements, data requirements, user stories, and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Ensure requirements are complete, testable, traceable, prioritized, and aligned with the Bank’s target architecture, product roadmap, control framework, and regulatory obligations.
  • Lead technical delivery for banking products and platforms, including deposits, lending, payments, APIs, core banking, data capabilities, vendor solutions, and enterprise integrations.
  • Partner with Product, Program Management, and Engineering leaders to convert roadmaps into prioritized backlogs, technical capabilities, release plans, milestones, and executable delivery plans.
  • Coordinate delivery across engineering teams, enterprise platforms, business functions, and external vendors, managing scope, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and changes in partnership with program management leads.
  • Drive Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, planning cadences, roadmap tracking, release planning, execution reviews, and delivery reporting.
  • Manage requirements and delivery for APIs and integrations, including security, authentication, resiliency, error handling, performance, monitoring, auditability, and operational support.
  • Define and validate data requirements, including source-to-target mapping, data quality, reconciliation, lineage, retention, reporting, and downstream consumption.
  • Oversee third-party vendor deliverables, integration commitments, testing obligations, milestones, service expectations, and issue resolution.
  • Establish and manage the UAT framework, including test planning, scenarios, entry and exit criteria, test data, defect management, evidence retention, approvals, and business sign-off.
  • Coordinate functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, operational-readiness, and user acceptance testing across internal teams and vendors.
  • Ensure testing validates customer journeys, accounting events, data flows, reconciliations, controls, exception handling, and regulatory requirements.
  • Establish delivery governance, demand intake, prioritization, requirements management, decision tracking, change control, release management, and production-readiness processes.
  • Identify and mitigate delivery risks, resource constraints, execution gaps, control deficiencies, and operational challenges throughout the lifecycle.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation, approvals, traceability, evidence, and audit trails are maintained to support governance, compliance, and regulatory review.
  • Provide clear reporting to senior leaders on delivery status, risks, dependencies, testing progress, operational readiness, and decisions requiring escalation.
  • Support production stabilization, problem resolution, and effective handoff to technology operations, servicing, support, and control owners.
  • Build and lead a strong systems analysis, technical product delivery, and UAT capability for PayPal Bank.
  • Provide direction and coaching to systems analysts, technical product managers, delivery leads, and testing resources.
  • Establish clear accountability across business, product, program management, engineering, operations, vendor, and testing teams.
  • Communicate complex technical and delivery matters effectively to executive, business, technology, risk, compliance, and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, transparency, disciplined execution, strong documentation, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in systems analysis, technical product management, technology delivery, program management, or related leadership roles within banking, fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technical requirements and delivering large, complex, cross-functional technology initiatives.
  • Strong experience translating business and product needs into functional requirements, technical specifications, data requirements, integration requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience delivering APIs, enterprise integrations, data platforms, cloud-based solutions, core platforms, and third-party technology products.
  • Strong knowledge of requirements management, SDLC governance, Agile delivery, release management, change control, and operational-readiness practices.
  • Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, delivery roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and executive reporting.
  • Experience leading UAT, requirements traceability, test-scenario development, defect management, evidence retention, and business acceptance.
  • Knowledge of banking technology governance, operational controls, security practices, FFIEC guidance, and regulatory expectations.
  • Familiarity with banking domains such as deposits, lending, payments, merchant acquiring, treasury, finance, servicing, and regulatory reporting.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors, fintech integrations, enterprise shared services, and external delivery dependencies.
  • Understanding of data integration, data quality, reconciliation, lineage, reporting, and financial-control requirements.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder-management, communication, negotiation, and executive-presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment while balancing execution speed, quality, governance, operational resilience, and regulatory rigor.
  • Experience establishing technology delivery capabilities for a new bank, regulated financial entity, or major banking-platform transformation.
  • Experience implementing or integrating cloud-native core banking, deposit, lending, or payment platforms.
  • Familiarity with API-first, microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience supporting regulatory examinations, internal audits, control testing, or technology-risk assessments.

Job Summary:

The Head of Compliance Governance & CMS Oversight is a foundational leadership role responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing the Bank's Compliance Management System (CMS) governance framework during the formation of a de novo Industrial Loan Company (ILC). Reporting directly to the Chief Compliance Officer, this leader will establish the governance infrastructure, operating model, and core compliance processes necessary to support a safe, sound, and scalable compliance program that meets regulatory expectations from charter formation through ongoing operations.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop a compliance organization across multiple compliance domains or business areas, building high-performing teams
  • Establish compliance program strategy for significant organizational scope, creating comprehensive frameworks aligned with regulatory requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement of compliance processes, methodologies, and control frameworks across the compliance function
  • Develop strategic partnerships with business, legal, risk, audit, and technology leaders to embed compliance into operations
  • Solve highly complex compliance challenges, establishing new approaches when existing frameworks are insufficient for emerging regulatory requirements
  • Collaborate on decisions about compliance program design, resource allocation, and organizational priorities to manage regulatory risk effectively
  • Influence organizational approach to compliance through thought leadership, regulatory insights, and risk-based recommendations
  • Build organizational compliance capability through talent development, knowledge sharing, and establishment of compliance excellence standards

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant compliance experience and a Bachelor's degree OR any equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Proven experience managing compliance teams and delivering complex program initiatives through others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep knowledge of U.S. banking laws, regulations, and regulatory expectations governing Compliance Management Systems, including FFIEC guidance and consumer compliance regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience establishing or overseeing one or more core compliance governance functions, such as:
    • Policy & Procedure Governance
    • Compliance Risk Assessment
    • Regulatory Change Management
    • Regulatory Examination Management
    • Compliance Issue Management
    • Customer Complaint Oversight
    • Compliance Training & Awareness
    • Board and Executive Compliance Reporting
  • Demonstrated experience developing executive- and Board-level reporting, governance materials, and compliance metrics.
  • Experience working within a Three Lines of Defense governance model and providing independent oversight, effective challenge, and credible challenge to business and control functions.
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, including recruiting, developing, coaching, and leading high-performing teams.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, and drive execution in a complex, matrixed organization
  • Experience supporting a de novo bank charter, bank integration, significant regulatory transformation, or large-scale compliance program buildout.
  • Experience within a fintech, payments, or digital banking organization.
  • Knowledge of Industrial Loan Company (ILC) regulatory requirements and governance expectations.
  • Professional certifications such as CRCM, CAMS, CCEP, or other relevant compliance or risk management credentials.
  • Experience implementing or governing GRC platforms and compliance technology solutions.
  • Experience leading regulatory examinations and managing interactions with federal and/or state banking regulators.
  • Experience leveraging enterprise governance, compliance, or risk management capabilities while establishing legal-entity-specific oversight and governance.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide clear, pragmatic, and solution-oriented legal advice to enable business strategy while managing legal risk.
  • Participate in complex problem resolution, providing expert legal advice on high-stakes issues and disputes.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
  • Partner with business counterparts across the enterprise to help drive the delivery of effective legal services.
  • Manage legal risks and safeguard PayPal's legal interests, developing comprehensive risk management frameworks.
  • Escalate complex issues to senior legal leadership where appropriate.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Juris doctorate degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

PayPal is seeking an experienced international employment lawyer to join our lean, high-impact Employment Legal team supporting the APAC & EMEA regions. Reporting to the Director of Employment Legal International, you will work as part of a team of four to deliver strategic, proactive employment law advice to HR and business leaders across multiple jurisdictions within the two region, while contributing to broader global initiatives impacting our APAC & EMEA workforce.


Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

What You’ll Do

  • Provide timely, strategic employment law advice across our APAC jurisdictions with employees (Australia, China, Hong Kong SAR, India, Japan, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, and Thailand) and our EMEA jurisdictions with employees (Belgium, France, Germany, Israel, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Republic of Ireland, Spain, Sweden, UAE, and the UK & Northern Ireland), enabling compliant and commercially sound business decisions.
  • Monitor and anticipate legislative and regulatory developments across the regions, advising on legal risk, mitigation strategies, and required compliance controls.
  • Lead and manage employee litigation matters in partnership with external counsel, shaping strategy and ensuring effective, proportionate outcomes aligned with business objectives.
  • Advise on sensitive internal investigations, ensuring fair process, defensibility, and alignment with PayPal’s values and standards.
  • Partner closely with People Partners and the Employee Relations team on labour law matters, including workforce consultations, works council engagement, and restructuring initiatives.
  • Support organisational change and restructuring projects through proactive legal risk assessment and clear, pragmatic guidance.
  • Deliver practical and engaging employment law training to HR, managers, and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute to a consistent Employment Legal International voice and approach, supporting cross-border alignment and collaboration within the team.
  • Identify and manage employment-related risk proactively across the region.
  • Travel as required.

What We Are Looking For

  • A qualified lawyer in one of the APAC or EMEA jurisdictions with strong practical expertise in employment and labour law, with experience across two or more of the relevant jurisdictions.
  • Significant post-qualification experience (ideally 8+ years), including proven senior in-house experience within a multinational organisation.
  • Demonstrated capability in managing complex litigation, investigations, and workforce change projects.
  • Commercially pragmatic, solutions-focused, and confident advising senior stakeholders across multiple countries.
  • Excellent drafting and communication skills in English; additional European languages are advantageous.
  • Strong judgment, stakeholder management capability, and the ability to balance legal risk with business priorities.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, international environment.

Job Summary:

The Senior Director, Specialized Sales is a senior leadership role within the PayPal sales organization, responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of sales specialists focused on growing and strengthening PayPal merchant partnerships, driving incremental revenue, and accelerating adoption of PayPal's branded checkout, payments, and BNPL solutions across the Americas.

This leader owns the strategy and execution for the value-driven sale of PayPal's suite of specialized solutions. The Senior Director will set the vision for how the team engages named existing accounts and prospects, ensure the team anticipates and counters competitive moves, and instill a hunter/defender mentality across the org. This role partners closely with Account Management leadership, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Finance to structure creative, strategic commercial partnerships at scale.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide key inputs as an industry leader and expert.
  • Develop and articulate a clear, compelling vision and strategy.
  • Inspire others with strategic alignment to company-wide goals.
  • Focus on the long-term success strategy of the sales development function.
  • Lead and mentor senior leaders within the sales development team.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Duties and Responsibilities


  • Own and drive revenue growth targets for the PayPal specialized products across the full team's portfolio, ensuring alignment between merchant needs and PayPal's solutions
  • Build, lead, and develop a team of ~25 sales specialists, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and career development
  • Set team structure, territory/account alignment, and coverage model in partnership with front-book and back-book AM leadership
  • Own the health, accuracy, and forecasting of the US branded and unbranded checkout pipeline across the team, including regular reporting to senior leadership
  • Partner with senior internal stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and scale cross-sell opportunities across the portfolio
  • Provide senior-level oversight of complex sales cycles, stepping in on strategic or escalated deals to support discovery, product fit, pricing, negotiation, and contracting
  • Ensure the team executes with excellence across the full sales lifecycle: discovery, product fit consulting, sales pitch, pre-sales demo, pricing, negotiation, Compliance/UW, KYC/AML, Risk, contract generation, account training, launch-to-scale (LTS), and post-live support
  • Drive team-wide adoption of structured deal outcomes: co-marketing, case studies/testimonials, exclusivity or phased co-existence arrangements, A/B testing, and data sharing
  • Serve as the senior voice of the field to Product, Finance, Legal, Marketing, GTM, and Sales Enablement, shaping roadmap and go-to-market priorities based on aggregated customer and team feedback
  • Champion a strong team culture, modeling leadership behaviors, building trust, and driving high engagement and retention across the organization
  • Ensure team proficiency in core tools (Salesforce, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and sales methodology
  • Travel up to 40% of time

Key Attributes


  • Leads as a player-coach with an offensive, hunter mindset — building strategic account and territory plans and instilling that same mentality across the team
  • Fiercely competitive with a strong sense of urgency, able to translate that energy into team-wide accountability for results
  • Comfortable operating and leading through ambiguity, providing clarity and direction to the team
  • Team-centric, client-first leader able to direct and influence senior internal stakeholders and build durable cross-functional relationships
  • Unwavering focus on the merchant experience, setting the standard for white-glove pre- and post-sale support across the team
  • Intellectually curious and a continuous student of sales leadership
  • Strong program and organizational management skills
  • Flexible, decisive, and an energizing leader to work for and with

Job Summary:

The Head of Payment Operations, PayPal Bank leads the end-to-end payment operations function for PayPal Bank (in formation), including card acquiring settlement, ACH processing, deposit operations (retail, business and FBO), loan funding, payment posting, reconciliation, dispute and error resolution, and first-line operational risk controls. Reporting to the Chief Operations Officer, the role will design and manage a safe, sound and scalable framework aligned with the Bank’s Business Plan, including acquiring services, savings deposit operations and deposit funding, liquidity and settlement execution in partnership with Treasury. The role is accountable for operational execution, controls, governance and reporting suitable for FDIC-supervised operations and adherence to applicable laws, regulations and network requirements. The role leads payment operations staff and serves as a key operational interface with regulators, networks, audit, risk management and affiliate service providers.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide clear focused strategy and business priorities for your organization.
  • Establish global relationships throughout the organization to ensure excellent information flow and feedback on impacts of process, policy, and product changes.
  • Liaise with peers in other parts of the organization to align strategy and meet common goals.
  • lead global programs of work beyond the core functional deliverables to drive process improvement and alignment, employee engagement, and leadership initiatives in global financial crimes and consumer protections and across Risk Management.
  • Maintain a high level of subject matter expertise to coach, guide and influence other leaders and business managers toward process, policy, product, and organizational changes.
  • Participate in the design and execution of the strategic direction and execution of the Risk Operations Program
  • Drive multiple large projects to move the business forward.
  • Strengthen the overall business governance and operating model for the best-in-class Risk Operations organization

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Additional Information


Key Responsibilities: 

  • Lead and manage all payment and settlement operations for the Bank, including card acquiring settlement (e.g., Visa, Mastercard), ACH processing and return management, merchant settlement under a good-funds model, FBO account flows, retail and business savings deposit operations and loan disbursement and repayment processing. 
  • Oversee loan disbursement processing, repayment posting, ACH debit execution, and payment application controls in coordination with Credit, ensuring operational accuracy and segregation of duties. 
  • Establish and maintain effective daily settlement, reconciliation, general ledger control, dispute and exception management processes. 
  • Own the first-line operational risk and control environment for payment and deposit activities, including documented procedures, control monitoring, issue remediation and escalation. 
  • Ensure operational adherence to applicable laws, regulations, and network requirements, including card network rules, NACHA standards, BSA/AML/OFAC operational controls (in coordination with Risk), Regulation W affiliate transaction requirements, FDIC third-party oversight expectations, and consumer protection requirements including error resolution obligations under Regulation E, where applicable. 
  • Develop and monitor key performance and risk indicators (e.g., chargebacks, ACH returns, fraud trends, operational losses, reserve utilization) and report material issues to the COO and appropriate governance committees. 
  • Oversee operational performance and control adherence of affiliate and third-party service providers supporting payment and deposit activities in alignment with the Bank’s TPRM framework. 
  • Serve as the primary first-line operational liaison to Internal Audit and External Audit for payment, deposit, and settlement-related reviews. 

De Novo Charter Formation & ILC Buildout: 

  • Design and implement the payment operations framework in support of a newly chartered ILC, ensuring alignment with the approved Business Plan and regulatory expectations. 
  • Establish acquiring controls processes, including reserve account administration, network collateral tracking, direct settlement accounting and reconciliation controls. 
  • Develop and formalize policies, procedures and control standards aligned with organizational policies including Acquiring Services Risk and Liquidity Policies and the internal controls framework 
  • Partner with Technology and Finance to implement core systems to ensure segregation of Bank books and records and support accurate regulatory and financial reporting 
  • Participate in model validation support, operational readiness testing and pre-opening control assessments to ensure launch preparedness. 
  • Build quality assurance, control testing, and documentation standards to satisfy pre-opening regulatory review. 
  • Support development of management committee reporting (ALCO, ERMC, Compliance & Operations Committee) and assist in building examination-ready evidence files prior to first FDIC exam. 

Ongoing Program Leadership (Post Opening): 

  • Lead the ongoing execution and enhancement of the Bank’s payment, settlement, deposit and loan servicing operations, ensuring safe, sound and scalable performance aligned with the approved risk appetite.  
  • Maintain and strengthen the first-line operational control environment, including reconciliation integrity, dispute and error resolution (including Reg E, where applicable), reserve monitoring, chargeback and ACH return trends, and timely escalation of material risks.  
  • Ensure continued adherence to applicable laws, regulations and network requirements, including card network rules, NACHA standards, Regulation W considerations, and third-party oversight expectations.  
  • Partner with Finance, Risk and Credit to support deposit funding, liquidity forecasting, operational loss monitoring, audit remediation and ongoing examination readiness.  

Regulator Engagement & Exams: 

  • Serve as PPB’s primary point of contact for payment, acquiring services, ACH processing, network compliance and deposit operations  matters with the FDIC and other relevant supervisors; coordinate responses, meetings, and submissions.  
  • Provide clear documentation of payment flows, settlement controls, network compliance processes and affiliate transaction controls. 
  • Demonstrate strong first line ownership and evidence based control environment along with ensuring timely, documented and Board reported remediation plans. 

Culture, Training & Change Leadership: 

  • Drive a strong “tone from the top” culture focused on bank employees and PayPal Inc. stakeholder engagement related to their responsibility of detecting and appropriately reporting financial crimes. 
  • Support development of the bank’s risk culture by ensuring timely and relevant AML/CFT/OFAC trainings are delivered and completed. 

Governance & Reporting Lines: 

  • Primary reporting: ILC Chief Operations Officer 

Required Qualifications: 

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, economics, Accounting, or a related discipline (or equivalent combination of education and experience).  
  • 5+ years in a senior management or Director-level leadership role with direct oversight of operational teams and first line control responsibilities 
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in payment operations, banking operations, or financial services functions within a regulated financial institution 
  • Strong working knowledge of card network rules (e.g., Visa, Mastercard), NACHA Operating Rules, BSA/AML operational requirements, Regulation E error resolution standards, Regulation W affiliate transaction requirements, and third-party risk management expectations. 
  • Demonstrated experience leading card acquiring settlement, ACH processing and deposit operations, or comparable large-scale payment operations within a regulated banking environment. 
  • Direct experience interacting with federal or state banking regulators (FIDC, Federal Reserve, OCC and/or state banking regulators), including examination support and remediation oversight 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Certified Payments Professional (CPP), Accredited ACH Professional (AAP), Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) or equivalent professional certifications. 
  • Experience building,  transforming or operating within a bank-fintech partnership, sponsor bank, embedded finance or acquiring bank model.  
  • Deep familiarity with SAR/CTR governance expectations, investigative documentation standards, and examination- quality record keeping practices.

Job Summary:

This role is responsible for the strategy, development, launch and ongoing management of PayPal Bank’s Merchant and Consumer Savings deposit products. The role translates the Bank’s approved business plan into executable product strategies, business requirements, customer journeys, operating requirement and launch-readiness criteria. Working as an individual contributor under the Head of Product, the position coordinates closely with Operations, Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Servicing, and PayPal affiliate-service providers to ensure products are customer-focused, financially viable, operationally sustainable and aligned with the Bank’s regulatory obligations. The role maintains clear product accountability, supports governance and examination activities, and ensures product decisions, controls, performance and oversight are appropriately documented.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Inputs to product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders consistent with the shared vision for the product or enabling platform.
  • Implements the architectural roadmap that balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Controls for the customer experience and customer needs in product requirements and as an input to decision making.
  • Monitors metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Manages one or more workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Participates in operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Recent demonstrated experience managing deposit products within banking, fintech, or financial services, including product strategy, pricing, customer experience, servicing, and lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of merchant/small-business and consumer savings products, deposit pricing and funding, transfers, servicing, and account lifecycle management; experience with FBO or brokered deposit structures is a plus.
  • Experience supporting regulatory examinations, audits, product governance reviews, control assessments, issue remediation, and regulatory response activities.
  • Experience managing products delivered through affiliate, third-party, or shared-service models, including service levels, performance reporting, control evidence, and escalation processes.
  • Experience building or managing deposit products during bank formation, a de novo launch, product conversion, or significant platform transformation.
  • Relevant product, banking, risk, compliance, or project-management certification is preferred.

Job Summary:

The Tax Counsel - Information Reporting will be an experienced in-house tax attorney who will ensure overall compliance with policy related to information reporting and withholding tax rules (including FATCA, CRS, CARF and 1099) across global products, processes, and procedures. The successful candidate will be able to work with cross functional partners to evaluate new products and changes to existing products to determine applicability of existing information reporting policies and necessity for creation of new policies. They will exercise sound judgment in identifying legal risk and recommending defensible positions.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Independently advises on complex tax issues affecting business operations, transactions, and strategic initiatives.
  • Develops and documents technical tax analyses supporting planning strategies, reporting positions, audit defense, and regulatory compliance.
  • Partners directly with business units and Finance leadership to structure initiatives in a tax-efficient and compliant manner.
  • Identifies tax risk exposures and recommends mitigation strategies consistent with PayPal’s overall risk tolerance.
  • Coordinates with outside advisors where appropriate and manages discrete external engagements.
  • May mentor junior attorneys or legal professionals and contribute to knowledge development within the tax function.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant tax experience and a Juris Doctor (JD) degree or foreign equivalent

Job Summary:

What Do You Need To Know About The Role
This is an incident command role ( TDO- Technical Duty Officer). You'll direct application and infrastructure teams during incidents making work assignments, prioritizing troubleshooting paths, and authorizing critical actions like rollbacks and regional failovers. You need the technical depth to rapidly read Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes manifests, and CI/CD configurations to make informed decisions under pressure.

Meet Our Team
Command Center team serves as the operational and technical authority during PayPal's most critical incidents. We are a team of experienced infrastructure and reliability professionals who blend deep technical expertise with sound judgment under pressure, directing cross-functional engineering efforts across PayPal's core platforms and family of brands, including Venmo, Xoom, Zettle, and Braintree.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of system performance monitoring, identify inefficiencies, and lead initiatives to improve the overall availability and reliability of digital platforms and applications.
  • Lead and manage the response to complex, high-priority incidents, ensuring prompt resolution and a thorough root cause analysis to prevent future occurrences.
  • Design and implement advanced automation frameworks to improve operational efficiency, streamline processes, and reduce human error.
  • Lead reliability-focused initiatives, ensuring systems are highly available, resilient, and scalable, and promote best practices across engineering teams.
  • Enhance the monitoring infrastructure by identifying key metrics, optimizing alerting, and improving system observability to ensure the reliability of large-scale systems.
  • Forecast resource requirements and lead capacity planning activities to ensure systems can scale effectively to meet growing user demand.
  • Ensure robust disaster recovery strategies are in place and conduct regular testing to ensure systems can recover quickly from failures.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to identify opportunities for improving system architecture, focusing on scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance.
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior site reliability engineers, fostering skill development and knowledge sharing.
  • Drive continuous improvement across operational workflows, identifying areas for optimization, cost reduction, and performance enhancement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

What do you need to bring

    • Significant hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or GCP required; multi-cloud experience preferred)
    • Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or equivalent) including ability to read, review, and troubleshoot IaC configurations during incidents
    • Significant hands-on experience with Kubernetes and CNCF ecosystem tools, including troubleshooting K8s deployments, manifests, and cluster issues
    • Ability to quickly read and review code across multiple languages (Python, Go, Bash) and configuration formats (YAML, HCL, JSON)essential for effective incident troubleshooting
    • Proven experience managing critical incidents in Infrastructure-as-Code driven environments, including troubleshooting IaC state issues, GitOps failures, and cloud-native deployment problems
    • Professional-level certification in at least one major cloud platform (AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent)
    • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)
    • Strong knowledge of networking, load balancing, CDN technologies, and DNS management
    • Proficiency in scripting for operational automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell)5+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, infrastructure operations, or similar technical operations roles
    • Strong expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure)
    • Proficiency in infrastructure automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, etc.)
    • Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
    • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)
    • Strong knowledge of networking, load balancing, CDN technologies, and DNS management
    • Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.)

Job Summary:

Meet our team
The Payments Risk Engineering team is responsible for fraud detection and risk management at PayPal. We design, build, and support the services that are called on every money movement transaction between PayPal and its users and partners. Our solutions scale across millions of interactions, integrate with other APIs in real time, and deliver high availability and configurability to the business. We stay current with advances in technology and science and tie them back to business needs.

What you need to know about the role-
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to strengthen the risk prevention and mitigation systems that protect PayPal and its customers from fraud. Our team owns fraud detection, and risk management services across PayPal globally. These services are called on every interaction between users, partners, and PayPal. We also apply advances in AI, machine learning, and data science to real business problems.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
  • Advises immediate management on project-level issues
  • Guides junior engineers
  • Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
  • Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Your way to impact

• Protect customers and PayPal by building real-time risk systems that scale across millions of transactions.

• Keep payments seamless for good users while stopping fraud, with services that are highly available, reliable, and configurable.

• Shape the technical direction of the team by challenging the status quo, bringing fresh ideas, and championing clean, scalable engineering practices.

• Reduce technical debt and raise the quality bar for software and the team.


Your day to day

• Design, develop, and test features and services for our risk applications.

• Work with product managers in an agile setting to deliver high-quality solutions on time.

• Partner with developers, product, design, and analytics teams to explore new ideas and opportunities.

• Work with operations teams to keep services highly available and reliable.

• Take part in code reviews to maintain code quality.

• Contribute to our automated test suite to enable fast, reliable continuous integration.

• Communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

• Be proactive: anticipate issues and handle them before they escalate.

What do you need to bring-

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline with 4-6 years of experience.

• Strong applied experience: you’ve built, broken, and rebuilt software, and you know how to ship real-world products.

• Proficiency in back-end development with Java EE technologies (Java, application servers, servlet containers, JMS, JPA).

• Strong object-oriented programming skills and the ability to turn requirements into scalable designs.

• Experience designing and building REST APIs and web services or microservices in a commercial setting.

• Experience with design patterns, MVC, and frameworks such as Spring.

• Experience with service-oriented architectures and scalable, distributed Java services.

• Skill in designing for reliability, availability, scalability, and performance.

• Familiarity with engineering tools and practices such as Java build tools, unit testing, test automation, and CI.

• Strong communication skills.

• A mindset of ownership, curiosity, and drive to get results.

  • Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
  • Advises immediate management on project-level issues
  • Guides junior engineers
  • Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
  • Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver complete solutions across all phases of the SDLC for CPE's internal platforms, based on priorities set with the CPE manager.
  • Own CPE's tooling codebases as products — apply and uphold code review, testing and release practices for them, and be the named owner accountable for their state.
  • Carry the knowledge base platform from pre-production to production: monitoring, backup and restore, documented ownership, and the operational layer a service needs once a team depends on it daily.
  • Design, build and operate new services that reduce the team's toil on repetitive and manual work, including correlating operational signals that today are handled individually.
  • Own the PostgreSQL schema and data layer behind CPE's retrieval platform — schema design, migrations, roles and grants, indexing and query performance.
  • Advise CPE management on project-level technical issues, including build-versus-configure and sequencing decisions.
  • Review code from, and provide technical guidance to, engineers who write automation alongside their operational work.
  • Partner with engineering teams outside CPE to obtain the service topology and dependency knowledge CPE's tooling depends on.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ownership of a production codebase — not only writing code, but accountability for its design, review, tests, deployment and upkeep over time.
  • Working fluency in both Shell scripting, Python and TypeScript. Most of CPE's tooling are Shell scripts and Python; the MCP is in TypeScript.
  • Depth in databases: schema design, migrations, roles and grants, indexing and query performance, and running a database in production including backup and restore.
  • Production experience with cloud infrastructure — AWS and GCP are both in play — including deployment and observability.
  • Operational credibility with on-call engineers: prior time on a rotation, and an understanding of the work from the inside. This role is not in the on-call rotation, but is the escalation path for the services it owns.
  • Ability to drive a technical design across teams where the role holds no authority.
  • Comfort with ambiguity — much of this work has no precedent inside the team.

  • PostgreSQL + pgvector or another vector store — embeddings, similarity search, index tuning.
  • Retrieval systems or LLM tooling.
  • Managed Postgres at scale — Cloud SQL, RDS, Aurora.
  • Alerting and monitoring platforms — Datadog, Splunk, PagerDuty.

Credit Production Engineering runs 24/7 follow-the-sun support for PayPal's Financial Services platform — roughly 20 site reliability engineers across North America and APAC, with three structured handoffs a day. Job Summary:

We’re seeking a data-driven and creative CRM Performance Marketer to design and execute marketing strategies that acquire new customers. You will own the planning and execution of new customer acquisition CRM initiatives with a particular focus on incentives, merchant offers and core value props.

This role sits at the intersection of Marketing, MarTech, Operations, Product, and Analytics — requiring someone who thrives on using data and insights to craft personalized, high-impact campaigns that scale. You’ll use a customer first mindset to drive business growth, with the core KPIs being account sign up, account activations and successful habituation.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Liaise with media agencies on launch plans, optimization roadmaps, and budget alignment
  • Work with creative teams to define roadmaps, review proposals, and ensure seamless execution
  • Activate co-branding campaigns, product launches, and report results to leadership
  • Drive churn experimentation strategy, including ideation, testing, and customer experience evaluation
  • Write experiment briefs, testing plans, and coordinate end-to-end implementation
  • Monitor experiments post-launch, identify insights, and optimize in-flight results
  • Manage budget reporting, including agency costs and incentive payouts, for all campaigns

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Additional Responsibilities:

Develop & Execute CRM Strategy 

  • Responsible for defining the learning agenda and delivering against key performance indicators for new customer acquisition.  
  • Design and build comprehensive ad-hoc and always-on acquisition campaigns across owned channels internally and with 3rd party vendors — email, push notifications, in-app/app messaging, and landing pages (with direct mail as a potential secondary channel) — to drive acquisition and early habituation. 
  • Own acquisition landing page strategy, including page testing, personalization, and conversion optimization for sign-up flows. 

Segmentation & Personalization 

  • Audience development for prospecting and existing base (1st/ 3rd party data).  
  • Use 1st and 3rd party data to create dynamic audience segments and deliver tailored messaging at scale. 
  • Partner with 3rd party vendors to plan and execute initiatives. 

Automation & Experimentation 

  • Design and implement automated customer journeys, triggered campaigns, and A/B tests to improve key performance metrics such as CTR, push opt-in/open rate, in-app engagement, and conversion. 

Data & Insights 

  • Partner with analytics and finance teams to measure CRM performance, generate insights, and inform strategic decisions. 
  • Develop and track campaign forecasts to predict performance, engagement, business impact, spend and ROI. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Commercial, Product Marketing, and Integrated Marketing teams to align CRM strategies with product launches, promotional campaigns, and broader go-to-market initiatives. 
  • Lead others to solve issues of diverse scope. Anticipate issues and plan for mitigation. 

Vendor & Partner Management 

  • Evaluate, update and bring in third-party vendors to support acquisition initiatives as needed. 
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Vendor Management, and Compliance to negotiate contracts, SOWs, and data privacy assessments. 
  • Work with MarTech, Ops, and agency partners to onboard and operationalize new vendors into the campaign workflow. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in CRM, Lifecycle, or Performance Marketing (preferably in B2C, fintech, or e-commerce environments). 
  • Proven track record of executing multi-channel lifecycle programs tied to measurable growth outcomes. 
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience in data analysis, campaign forecasting, and KPI optimization. 
  • Proven skills to leverage customer segmentation and build testing methodologies. 
  • Excellent communication and project management skills with experience managing multiple stakeholders and timelines. 
  • Creative problem-solver with a growth mindset — eager to test, learn, and iterate quickly.
