This job provides day-to-day support to management, ensuring the smooth, efficient operation. It involves managing schedules, coordinating meetings, and expense tracking on behalf of the VPs. The assistant is responsible for preparing reports, organizing travel arrangements, Maintaining and updating databases and SharePoint sites, ensuring data accuracy, organization, and accessibility for stakeholders. Additionally, they may assist in project management tasks, liaising with other departments, and ensuring that deadlines are met. Scope: This job typically supports 2 or more Vice Presidents.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Manages calendar of the executive and daily work with some instruction from others.
  • Performs general administrative duties such as travel, expenses, department distribution list, purchase orders, ordering supplies in accordance with standard procedures & practices.
  • Engage and collaborate with the immediate team & internal partners.
  • May act as a delegate for the executive when reviewing and approving expense reports
  • Proactively identifies opportunities to increase efficiency and improve processes, anticipating the needs of the executive & team
  • Collaborate regularly with peers and internal partners while developing and maintaining strong relationships.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3 years of relevant work experience

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

PayPal is one of the leading global payments companies in the world. Initially conceived and designed for web payments, PayPal’s mobile and point of sale solutions have altered the payments landscape by blurring the lines between ecommerce and traditional brick and mortar commerce. PayPal’s innovative technology and approaches to payments, coupled with an increasingly complex and demanding legal and regulatory environment, provide robust career opportunities for attorneys motivated and driven by creative clients and a fast paced, cutting-edge culture.


PayPal’s Legal Team is looking for an Executive Assistant to support two (2) Vice Presidents and (1) Senior Director in the Legal organization. This individual must be capable of efficiently multi-tasking, at times under tight deadlines, and appropriately handling sensitive information. Success in this role also involves the ability to anticipate the needs of their leaders and takes the initiative to solve problems independently, while displaying appropriate judgment. In addition, this individual will be expected to proactively identify opportunities to make the overall legal organization and leadership team operate more efficiently over the long term.


Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:


Calendars, Meetings and Team Processes: 

  • Fully own, build and maintain the calendars of the primary executives you support. This includes advance planning, adjusting calendars to address urgent requests, managing incoming calendar emails and applying considered and appropriate judgment, including judgment about when to seek input direct from the executives you support.  
  • Understand overall group priorities and align schedules and meetings appropriately.  
  • Actively support team and leadership meetings.  This includes meeting coordination and logistics, such as ensuring technology availability, slide sharing, agenda distribution, as well as assisting with notes and follow-up actions. 
  • Effectively and efficiently coordinate virtual and in-person off-sites for team and leadership meetings, including agenda, logistics, travel and special events. 
  • Plan, coordinate and execute legal department events. 
  • Consistently and proactively suggests and introduces new ways of working to improve effectiveness. 

Travel and Expense:   

  • Makes travel arrangements expeditiously, accurately and in a cost-effective manner. 
  • Coordinates site visits (virtual and physical) of executives, including partnering with local legal leadership to develop a full itinerary (meeting times, special events, socials, dinners), transportation logistics and required travel documents. 
  • Manages expense reports to ensure on-time submission with required detail and accuracy 
  • Onboards suppliers, prepares and tracks purchase orders, invoice payments and expense reports to ensure accuracy and timely payments to suppliers. 

Office Administration/general: 

  • Maintain and update organizational charts, distribution lists and team meeting participants for the relevant legal teams. 
  • Handle incoming & outgoing courier, inter-office mail and post, as well as supporting on outgoing correspondence. 
  • Assist with registration and hosting any visitors coming to the site. 
  • Support onboarding of new employees and AWFs. 
  • Partner and network with other PayPal administrative assistants in order to collaborate, identify common challenges and opportunities for development, obtain information, solve problems and successfully navigate PayPal processes and policies. 
  • Completes ad-hoc and/or on-going projects and special assignments that ranges from financial/budget reporting, professional presentations, information gathering, budget/process planning, and following-up on key meetings decisions. 
  • Ensures absolute confidentiality of all sensitive information and communications.  
  • Embody and role model PayPal’s Values, One Team Behaviors and champion PayPal Policies. 
  • Provide general administrative support as required. 

Requirements and Relevant Experience: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree. 
  • Notary Public experience or ability to become a Notary Public. 
  • Proven ability to independently exercise sound judgment, prioritize appropriately, show initiative and problem solve.  
  • Must have demonstrated strong interpersonal and communication skills (both written and verbal), to include speaking clearly and persuasively with all levels in the organization. 
  • High degree of flexibility and adaptability; including the ability to work outside of regular business hours. 
  • Outstanding planning & organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail. 
  • Respect for confidentiality and discretion to properly handle sensitive information. 
  • Ability to confidently interface with executive-level contacts inside and outside the company. 
  • A “can-do” attitude that focuses on getting the job done in a highly collaborative and positive way. 
  • Ability to work with a diverse group of colleagues that are located in different time zones.  
  • Prior experience working for a publicly traded company preferred. 
  • Advanced knowledge of MS Office and related tools, including Outlook, Excel, Word, Forms and PowerPoint with the ability to create high-quality presentations, spreadsheets, surveys, and correspondence required. 
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to adhere to deadlines. 
  • Ability to work independently, meet deadlines in a fast-paced changing environment, and resolve issues with minimal supervision. 
  • Must be results focused and highly energetic to drive the defined team and organizational goals. 
  • Natural willingness to step up and take on projects/tasks necessary to support PayPal. 
  • Exhibits professionalism, a strong attention to detail, and a high degree of integrity.

title: Sr Lead Product Manager
locations: New York City, New York, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This job drives product strategy in alignment with a shared vision, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders. It includes planning and implementing an architectural roadmap that balances innovative design with regulatory requirements and customer needs. The position assesses customer experience and establishes data-gathering mechanisms to measure product success through usability studies and market analysis. Responsibilities also encompass overseeing product profitability, leading operational reviews, and partnering with various experts to maximize efficiency in a dynamic environment. This job is an individual contributor.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Drives product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders consistent with the shared vision for the product or enabling platform.
  • Plans and implements the architectural roadmap that balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Assesses the customer experience and customer needs in product requirements and decision making.
  • Sets up data gathering mechanisms relative to the metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Leads workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Oversees product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Plans operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content strategists, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers.
  • Maximizes efficiency in a constantly evolving environment where the process is fluid and creative solutions are the standard.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep experience in checkout (XO) and acquisition funnel product management, with a track record of driving pull-through and conversion improvements in high-scale, consumer-facing experiences.

Job Summary:

The Senior Manager, Bank FP&A is a Utah-based leadership role responsible for establishing and leading PayPal Bank’s financial planning and analysis capability. Reporting to the PayPal Bank CFO, the role owns the Bank’s standalone financial forecast, annual operating plan, long-range plan, product profitability analysis, net interest income forecasting, management reporting, and scenario analysis.

PayPal Bank is expected to operate as a standalone legal entity with its own governance, financial reporting, planning, and regulatory obligations while leveraging PayPal Inc. and other affiliates for certain services under formal intercompany arrangements. The role retains ownership of Bank FP&A assumptions, performance analysis, forecast governance, and management reporting, while coordinating with Corporate FP&A, Treasury, Controllership, Risk, Credit, Product, Technology, Legal, Tax, and other stakeholders.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Business partnering with leaders and VPs and the other cross-functional teams located globally
  • Build and retain a strong and effective team
  • Oversee month-end close and reporting activities, forecast, variance analysis and reporting of operating expense (as well as Contra)
  • Drive continuous process improvements both within the team and with the business
  • Provide analysis and recommendations to leadership groups quickly and effectively to drive results
  • Ensure strict adherence to corporate policies and GAAP regulations
  • Partner with leadership on risk awareness for projects
  • Develop key insights to provide finance senior leadership visibility into areas of risk
  • Work within finance and technology partners to identify areas of opportunity for improvement
  • Prepare and present results and forecasts to senior leaders
  • Track and re-trend results against forecasts and budgets

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in bank FP&A, strategic finance, business finance, product finance, or financial planning within banking, fintech, payments, or financial services.
  • Strong understanding of bank financial statements, net interest income, deposit economics, operating expenses, and forecast-to-actual analysis.
  • Ability to build financial models, manage forecast assumptions, explain variances, and prepare executive-ready materials.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment with strong documentation, controls, cross-functional collaboration, and governance discipline.
  • Experience with de novo bank formation, industrial banks, bank subsidiaries, or regulated legal-entity finance environments preferred.
  • Familiarity with deposit product economics, funds transfer pricing, bank business plan submissions, or regulatory examination readiness preferred.
  • Knowledge of Empyrean or similar bank forecasting and funds transfer pricing tools preferred.
  • Experience with enterprise planning, data warehouses, business intelligence/reporting, bank core systems, or subledger data environments.
  • MBA, CPA, CFA, or other relevant advanced degree or professional certification preferred.

Job Summary:

This job develops and executes strategic recruiting plans to attract top talent. They partner with hiring managers to understand specific hiring needs and create job descriptions. Job Summary:

As a Regional Sales Manager within Ignite SMB EMEA, you will lead a regional sales organisation delivered through our vendor partner, managed day to day through a layer of Team Leads and Performance Specialists. This is a sales leadership role first: you are expected to be a strong salesperson yourself, able to coach deal strategy, objection handling, and pipeline discipline, and to inspire reps to perform, not simply to review dashboards and hold others accountable from a distance. You will own your region's commercial results, build the capability of the Team Leads and Performance Specialists who run it, and act as a credible, data-informed voice to senior PayPal leadership on regional performance.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead functional projects and programs that drive business or process improvements.
  • Identify issues and recommend best practices based on specialized expertise.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze business trends and implement solutions.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of strategic initiatives within the sales function.
  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of sales processes and make recommendations for enhancements.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

German language skills

  • Business proficiency in German is preferred to support effective communication and collaboration with German-speaking sales teams and regional stakeholders.

Lead, Coach and Inspire Sales Talent

  • Sales leadership: Bring genuine sales credibility to the role. You know how to sell, and you use that skill to coach Team Leads and reps on deal strategy, objection handling, and pipeline management, not just to review their numbers.
  • Rep capability: Take ownership for whether reps on the floor are actually capable of doing the job. Use the Team Lead and Performance Specialist layer to get there, and treat the job as unfinished until the rep population is genuinely improving.
  • Inspiring performance: Motivate reps to want to perform, not just measure whether they do. Build a team culture people want to be part of, working through Team Leads and Performance Specialists to make that real on the floor every day.
  • Developing leaders: Invest in the growth of Team Leads and Performance Specialists as leaders in their own right. Understand their development needs, challenge them to grow, and build a layer that can run rep performance well without constant direction.

Drive Commercial Performance and Reporting

  • Data fluency: Read and present team performance data, including pipeline, conversion, ramp, and headcount, confidently and without relying on others to prepare it.
  • Capacity planning: Track headcount against pipeline targets and ramp timelines, flagging risk to leadership before it affects performance.
  • Strategic feedback: Give PayPal leadership evidence-based input on what is and is not working, drawing on patterns from the ground.

Build Stakeholder Relationships

  • Executive presence: Present to senior PayPal leadership and country GMs with clarity, translating operational performance into a clear narrative.
  • Cross-functional relationships: Build strong working relationships with Sales Leaders, HR, Enablement, Marketing, and the vendor organisation to drive shared accountability.
  • Ground-level visibility: Run regular touchpoints and skip-levels to stay connected to what is actually happening on the floor, not just what is reported up.

Own the Operating Rhythm

  • Rhythm of business: Own the weekly update, monthly GM cadence, and structured check-ins with Team Leads and Performance Specialists, keeping the operating rhythm consistent and disciplined.
  • Ownership and resilience: Take full accountability for regional performance and lead recovery when things are not working. Stay composed under pressure, act ahead of being asked, and bring solutions rather than problems to leadership.
  • Continuous improvement: Seek out feedback and apply it, championing change rather than defending the status quo, and creating space for your team to do the same.

Job Summary:

This job is responsible for overseeing the development, implementation, and evaluation of complex engineering operational programs. This role involves providing technical oversight and ensuring program success through effective management of engineering, technical, and procurement activities.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Scope: The project & program responsibilities are focused on the delivery of a product or computer-based system from design to release for customers.
  • Plan and manage a portfolio of engineering operational programs.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to program teams.
  • Establish and maintain program management processes and standards.
  • Monitor program progress and performance against objectives.
  • Communicate program status and issues to senior leadership.
  • Manage program budgets and resources.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience with program management methodologies and tools within an engineering environment.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager (IC8) to lead a multi-year AWS cloud transformation program focused on building disaster recovery (DR) resiliency — evolving our environments from single-region operation to full multi-region, active/active or active/passive high-availability architectures. This role owns the program end-to-end: technical strategy alignment, cross-team execution, DR testing cadence, and the audit and regulatory evidence required to demonstrate compliance to internal risk teams, external auditors, and the Board. 

This is a senior IC role for someone who can operate as a program manager with credible technical experience to pressure-test architecture decisions, sequence dependencies correctly, and know when a plan is at risk, without escalations from engineering as well as technical thought partner to engineering leadership, and a credible voice in front of C-suite and audit stakeholders. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
Program Leadership & Delivery 

  • Own the multi-year roadmap for the cloud transformation and DR program, translating a board-level commitment (e.g., multi-region HA by a target date) into phased milestones, dependencies, and staffing plans. 
  • Build and maintain the master program plan across infrastructure, application, data, and network workstreams, identifying critical path and cross-team dependencies. 
  • Drive a regular program governance cadence (steering committee, working groups, status reporting) with clear RAG status, risk registers, and decision logs. 
  • Manage vendor/professional-services engagements tied to the transformation. 

AWS Cloud Transformation & DR Architecture 

  • Partner with engineering and cloud architecture teams to define the target-state multi-region topology, including data replication strategy, failover/failback mechanisms, and RTO/RPO targets per service tier. 
  • Coordinate migration and re-architecture waves across service teams, sequencing work to minimize risk to production availability. 
  • Track technical debt and single points of failure that block multi-region readiness, and drive remediation plans with accountable owners. 
  • Maintain a working understanding of AWS services relevant to DR (e.g., cross-region replication, Route 53 failover, multi-region data stores) sufficient to evaluate trade-offs with architects. 

DR Testing, Audit & Compliance 

  • Own the DR testing program: tabletop exercises, partial failover tests, and full regional failover/failback tests, on a defined recurring cadence. 
  • Define and track DR test success criteria, capture findings, and drive closure of gaps identified during each test cycle. 
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal audit, risk, and compliance teams on DR readiness, producing evidence packages that satisfy audit and regulatory review (e.g., SOC 2, PCI, or equivalent framework requirements). 
  • Maintain DR runbooks, escalation procedures, and compliance documentation in a state that is always audit-ready, not just ahead of a scheduled review. 

Stakeholder & Executive Communication 

  • Prepare and deliver concise, BLUF-style executive updates to SVP/C-suite stakeholders and steering committees, distinguishing sourced fact from analysis and clearly flagging risk. 
  • Act as the connective tissue between engineering execution teams, architecture, security, legal/compliance, and finance/procurement. 
  • Represent the program in cross-functional planning cycles (e.g., annual/3-year planning, budget submissions) and translate technical scope into business-case language. 

Risk, Vendor & Headcount Management 

  • Identify, log, and actively manage program risks, including single points of failure in staffing (e.g., key-person dependencies) as well as technical risk. 
  • Manage relationships with AWS and any third-party implementation partners, including contract deliverables, SOWs, and milestone-based credits or commitments. 
  • Support hiring and onboarding for program roles as needed, and manage resourcing plans against the multi-year roadmap. 

WHAT YOU BRING 

  • 10+ years of technical program/project management experience, including at least 5 years leading large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform-resiliency programs. 
  • Demonstrated experience running an AWS-based (or equivalent hyperscaler) disaster recovery program, including hands-on exposure to multi-region architecture concepts, failover testing, and RTO/RPO planning. 
  • Proven ability to manage multi-year, multi-workstream programs with competing priorities and dependencies across several engineering teams. 
  • Strong executive communication skills; experience presenting to SVP/C-suite audiences and steering committees, with a preference for concise, BLUF-style reporting.

Job Summary:

In this role, you will be responsible for strengthening PayPal’s security posture by leading incident response efforts and applying digital forensics expertise to protect our infrastructure, systems, and data. You will coordinate cross-functional response activities, working with infrastructure, application, legal, compliance, and risk management teams to ensure swift containment and remediation of security events. You will contribute to incident response readiness through exercises and simulations, and drive post-incident reviews to capture lessons learned and identify strategic improvements. You will also develop and maintain incident response playbooks and forensic procedures, contribute to the overall security strategy, and mentor junior analysts to build a stronger, more capable team. Your efforts from Singapore will provide essential regional coverage and help maintain a strong defense against emerging threats across PayPal’s global operations.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Leverage specialized security expertise to identify and resolve complex cyber threat management challenges, recommending best practices and determining new approaches that have an impact on broader security operations, while aligning security strategies with business priorities.
  • Partner across teams and key stakeholders to drive security initiatives, leading and solutioning complex projects and programs to strengthen overall security posture.
  • Apply advanced analytical skills and sound judgment to solve security challenges, considering diverse perspectives and innovative solutions. Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, understanding their security implications to the company’s context.
  • Directly contribute to improvements within the security domain and occasionally beyond, ensuring decisions lead to meaningful enhancements in security practices and organizational resilience.
  • Leverage relationships across teams, both within and outside of security, to influence initiatives and integrate feedback into cyber threat management.
  • Develop and articulate clear plans and priorities for the team, guiding them to achieve security objectives while fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment.
  • Lead by example, providing mentorship and support to ensure the team successfully executes on initiatives and goals.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Your day-to-day:

In this role, you’ll focus primarily on incident response with forensic analysis applied during investigations:

  • Respond to and lead security incidents, in adherence to enterprise incident management process: Coordinate the full incident response lifecycle including detection, triage, containment, eradication, and recovery, providing timely updates on findings, root causes, and recommended remediation actions.
  • Serve as incident commander: Lead declared incidents during Singapore business hours, driving coordination across technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Conduct digital forensic analysis: Collect, preserve, and analyze digital evidence using industry-standard tools and techniques to determine the source, scope, and impact of security incidents while maintaining proper chain of custody.
  • Perform host-based forensics and timeline analysis: Examine forensic artifacts across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments to determine attack vector, lateral movement, and data exfiltration.
  • Correlate events from multiple sources and perform deep-dive and analysis to understand the impact of an incident: Analyze SIEM, EDR, firewall, network traffic, VPN, and proxy logs to build comprehensive incident timelines, understand the effectiveness of existing security controls and identify gaps to strengthen the controls, ensuring that future incidents are not repeated.
  • Create forensic and investigative reports: Prepare detailed technical reports suitable for senior leadership, legal counsel, and regulatory audiences.
  • Drive post-incident reviews: Ensure thorough documentation of lessons learned and identify improvements to strengthen organizational resilience.
  • Develop and maintain playbooks: Refine incident response playbooks, standard operating procedures, and forensic protocols to continuously improve response capabilities.
  • Maintain incident tracking: Drive continuous updates in the incident tracking system to ensure accurate documentation and reporting of security events.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders: Work with legal, compliance, and regulatory stakeholders as needed during incident progression, validating and communicating impact levels.
  • Engage external partners: Work with third-party vendors, consulting partners, and industry intelligence groups to enhance overall cybersecurity posture.
  • Mentor junior analysts: Provide technical guidance on incident response and forensic best practices.
  • Participate in on-call rotation: Provide regional incident response coverage as part of the Singapore on-call rotation.

What you need to bring:

  • Demonstrated experience in security incident handling and security operations within a SOC or similar high-tempo environment.
  • Strong digital forensics skills, including host-based forensics, evidence preservation, chain of custody, and data breach response.
  • Proficiency in analyzing forensic artifacts across Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems to determine attack vector, lateral movement, and data exfiltration.
  • Strong experience in correlating events from multiple sources (SIEM, EDR, firewall, network traffic, VPN, proxy logs) to build comprehensive timeline analyses.
  • Solid hands-on knowledge of SIEM, EDR, threat intelligence platforms, and forensic tools.
  • Familiarity with industry standards (e.g., NIST, MITRE ATT&CK) and best practices for incident response.
  • Experience with digital forensic tools such as EnCase, FTK, X-Ways Forensics, Axiom, Surge Collect, or equivalent open-source tools.
  • Familiarity with command line tools and scripting languages (Python, bash, etc.).
  • In-depth understanding of network protocols, systems, and infrastructure security principles.
  • Exceptional communication skills, capable of relaying complex security scenarios to executive stakeholders and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to organize case notes and prepare detailed technical and forensic reports.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with cloud infrastructures (AWS, GCP, Azure) and cloud-based forensic investigations.
  • Experience with proactive threat hunting activities to uncover security gaps, vulnerabilities, or unaddressed risks.
  • Ability to conduct malware analysis beyond basic triage.
  • Track record of leading technical initiatives or coordinating response efforts under pressure.
  • Certifications such as GCFA, GCFE, GCIH, CISSP, CCE or equivalent DFIR certifications.

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

PayPal’s Corporate Tax Department is seeking a Manager of Global Income Tax Reporting to join its Global Income Tax Reporting Team. This position, reporting to the Director of Global Income Tax Reporting, will work collaboratively with other members of the team, as well as PayPal's broader tax department, Controllership, and FP&A teams, to prepare and review the company's global quarterly and annual income tax provision calculations and related disclosures, complete effective tax rate forecasting, and model effective tax rate impacts of proposed/enacted global tax legislation and business initiatives.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Oversee tax matters within subject matter expertise.
  • Support audits and interactions with tax authorities.
  • Partner with tax leadership to evaluate tax impacts of business initiatives.
  • Mentor and train junior tax team members.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Key responsibilities include hands on preparation and management of the following:

  • Lead the preparation of the global income tax provision, including current and deferred taxes, quarterly AETR and discrete tax calculations, and GAAP and non-GAAP effective tax rates using OneSource Tax Provision.
  • Prepare quarterly and annual SEC income tax footnote disclosures, journal entries and tax account reconciliations.
  • Manage global tax accounting calculations including FIN 48 and IFRIC 23, and FAS 123R/ASC 718.
  • Partner with Tax, Corporate Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, and local finance teams to gather data and consolidate foreign tax provision calculations under U.S. GAAP, including legal-entity pretax income forecasting.
  • Prepare quarterly and long-term effective tax rate forecasts and model the impact of new accounting standards, proposed and enacted tax legislation, M&A activity, business initiatives, and internal restructurings.
  • Ensure internal control and SOX requirements over the income tax function are properly performed and documented.
  • Monitor developments related to ASC 740 and research complex income tax accounting matters.
  • Support process improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of the global income tax reporting process.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • BA/BS in Accounting or Finance equivalent; CPA; Masters in Taxation preferred
  • 8+ years of progressive professional experience in ASC740 income tax accounting for publicly held multinational companies; Big 4 public accounting experience required with additional multi-national corporate tax department experience highly desired.
  • Excellent tax accounting technical skills, analytical thinker, detail oriented
  • Ability to collaborate as part of a team
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to effectively relate tax accounting issues to non-tax provision personnel
  • Resourcefulness and adaptability; self-motivated with ability to work in a fast-paced environment with excellent prioritization and organizational skills
  • Experience with OneSource and SAP
  • Work Permit and Relocation Prerequisites: Must already possess valid authorization to work in the country where the position is advertised/located. Relocation support will not be provided for this role.

Job Summary:

Our SMB business exists so small businesses can compete like big ones, and as an AM2, you'll be the person hundreds of them count on. You'll own the end-to-end commercial relationship for around 200 SMB merchants, protecting existing transaction margin and driving growth through consistent, systematic servicing, retention and selling. It's a high-volume book, so structure and prioritisation matter just as much as the sales conversation itself.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Drive demand generation and qualification through cold calling, email outreach, and inbound lead response.
  • Negotiate and close contracts, addressing legal, financial, and technical concerns effectively.
  • Conduct thorough discovery to analyze customer needs and present pre-packaged solutions and use-cases.
  • Maintain a rigorous pipeline with accurate forecasting and regular reporting on pipeline status and revenue forecasts.
  • Collaborate across departments to ensure alignment and leverage customer insights to optimize offerings.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

What You'll Do

•     Be the single point of contact for your merchants, owning commercial outcomes end to end.

•     Use AI-powered tools to spot growth, cross-sell and risk opportunities across your book.

•     Keep pipeline, forecast and portfolio health reporting accurate, and share effective practices with fellow AM2 colleagues.

•     Coordinate internal teams to resolve merchant needs, and decide the right action when standard process isn't enough.


What You'll Bring — Minimum Qualifications

•     3+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Core Capabilities We're Looking For

•     Structured, organised, and able to plan and segment a large customer book while keeping follow-through and service quality high.

•     Skilled in customer and commercial conversations — building trust, identifying needs and converting the right opportunities without losing customer focus.

•     Comfortable using AI, data and playbooks to make sound trade-offs and escalate at the right time when several things need attention at once.

•     A reliable team collaborator who keeps records, pipeline and follow-ups accurate and aligned with internal stakeholders.

Job Summary:

PayPal’s Ads Tech team is building our next-generation advertising platform—a greenfield initiative combining advanced AI, large-scale systems engineering and PayPal’s unique merchant and transaction insights.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll help design and develop key parts of the platform, shape the technical roadmap and build reliable systems capable of operating at significant scale.

We believe the hardest problems are solved together. Our engineering culture values thoughtful debate, shared ownership and egoless collaboration—everyone has something to contribute and something to learn.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
  • Advises immediate management on project-level issues
  • Guides junior engineers
  • Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
  • Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:


What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop core components of PayPal’s advertising platform.
  • Contribute to the technical roadmap and help turn complex requirements into scalable software designs.
  • Build cloud-native backend systems with a strong focus on performance, resilience and maintainability.
  • Champion software craftsmanship, strong coding standards and tools that improve code quality.
  • Drive innovation and incremental improvements by taking initiative and challenging existing approaches.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering and other cross-functional teams to navigate ambiguity and deliver meaningful business outcomes.
  • Help create fault-tolerant systems designed for high availability and disaster recovery.
  • Share knowledge, support fellow engineers and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture.


What We’re Looking For


  • A highly experienced engineer with strong analytical and systems-design skills.
  • Deep appreciation for functional programming and its application to production systems.
  • A pragmatic problem-solver who can balance technical quality, scalability and business needs.
  • Someone comfortable working within a greenfield environment where not every problem has an established playbook.
  • A collaborative engineer who values collective success, constructive feedback and continuous learning.
  • A strong advocate for clean, reliable and maintainable code.


What You’ll Bring


  • 10+ years of software development experience, with a strong emphasis on functional programming.
  • Proficiency in at least one functional programming language—ideally Scala and its Typelevel ecosystem.
  • 5+ years of experience designing and architecting scalable backend systems, including cloud-native solutions, microservices or serverless architectures.
  • Experience with functional effect systems such as Cats Effect or ZIO.
  • Expertise in building fault-tolerant, highly available systems and planning for disaster recovery.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience developing large-scale, high-performance systems.
  • Experience working within Agile or Scrum software-development environments.


Nice to Have


  • Python development experience, particularly within a machine-learning context.
  • Knowledge of advertising technology, payment processing or the regulatory considerations surrounding these industries.


We Believe in You


Interested? Don’t hesitate to apply or reach out and let’s talk — We’d love to learn more about you!

Job Summary:

What you need to know about the role

As a Software Engineer in PayPal’s Public Cloud Engineering team, you will help to build a robust and scalable multi cloud platform to support PayPal to adopt public cloud services from AWS, GCP and Azure to accelerate migration from on premise environment. You will drive innovation in building public cloud environments leveraging your expertise and experience in building systems that further PayPal’s goal of bringing best-in-class customer experience to provide global payment acceptance solutions to all merchant/partner segments at PayPal

Meet our team

We are the Cloud Centre of Excellence team which enables engineers and developers within PayPal to make use of GCP, AWS and Azure cloud in secure reliable and scalable manner. Our team builds platform, self-service tools and automation using cutting edge cloud native technologies and solutions to reduce friction and enable product teams within PayPal to leverage GCP, AWS and Azure.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Oversee load balancers, Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB) equipment, Content Delivery Network (CDN) platforms, and troubleshoot client/server issues.
  • Handle proactive and reactive outages, work with vendors, and take ownership of network incidents, escalations, and root cause analysis.
  • Lead backbone network design and architecture for on-premises and public cloud migration, and build hybrid connectivity solutions.
  • Work with business unit leadership, product managers, and customers to develop project objectives, timelines, and feature requirements.
  • Support network system availability, manage network capacity, and ensure compliance with Information Security standards.
  • Deploy equipment, manage SSL certificate hosting and renewal, and build infrastructure for data centers and cloud environments.
  • Implement and continually improve operational procedures, systems, and network engineering best practices.
  • Offer on-call support, monitor infrastructure and hosted services, and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Manage and influence global teams, provide guidance and support, and mentor team members in areas of expertise.
  • Communicate incident impacts, risks, and mitigation plans to executives, document incident information, and create network engineering documentation and best practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

descriptionHtml:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

The Director, Chief of Staff is a strategic partner to the Chief AI Transformation & Simplification Officer, owning the analysis, models, investment cases, and executive communications that guide AI investment decisions. The role blends classic Chief of Staff duties with AI strategy, opportunity sizing, business-case development, financial modeling, and executive decision support.

Key duties: manage the executive operating rhythm (staff meetings, business reviews, offsites) and prepare briefings and decision materials; lead AI investment cases, including sizing, cost/benefit assumptions, and sensitivity analysis; build models comparing initiatives, investment levels, and resources; craft executive narratives for the CEO, ELT, and Board; coordinate with business, tech, finance, and corporate functions to track decisions and risks.

High-visibility, enterprise-facing role requiring financial acumen, structured analysis, and influence-based leadership without direct-line authority.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Establish overall business or technical strategy for the business operations of aligned organization.
  • Influence decisions as an advisor or counsel to business leadership.
  • Drive strategic objectives and ensure resources are effectively allocated.
  • Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.
  • Act as a liaison between business leadership, staff, and other key partners.
  • Optimize workflows and drive process improvements to enhance organizational performance.
  • Drive and monitor Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to address gaps in business and operations.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Significant experience in strategy, strategic planning, investment analysis, finance, consulting, business operations, or a related analytical discipline.
Demonstrated ability to build, interpret, and explain financial, business, and strategic models used to support investment and executive decisions.
Experience developing business cases, sizing opportunities, testing assumptions, and evaluating scenarios or investment tradeoffs.
Strong executive communication skills, including experience developing presentations, narratives, and decision materials for senior audiences.
Ability to synthesize ambiguous and complex information into practical recommendations and clear next steps.
Strong organizational, relationship-building, and project leadership skills in a matrixed environment.
Experience working across business and technology teams; knowledge of AI and emerging technology is preferred.

Job Summary:

This job implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), follows internal conventions and procedures, makes technical decisions, collaborates with peers and project leads, and contributes to code and design reviews. Commerce services turn a Venmo account into a place where a business can be found, browsed, and paid. You will build those experiences on Android, inside an app tens of millions of people already open every day.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
  • Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
  • Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
  • Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
  • May contribute to code & design reviews

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

What you will do

  • Design, build, test, and ship high-quality Android experiences for Venmo Commerce.
  • Develop modern, reusable UI using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose within Venmo's mobile architecture.
  • Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation through experimentation, launch, observability, and iteration.
  • Integrate mobile experiences with backend APIs, payments infrastructure, identity, risk, search, recommendations, analytics, and other platform capabilities.
  • Build experiences that are performant, resilient, accessible, secure, and intuitive across a broad range of Android devices.
  • Instrument product funnels and experiments, use data to understand customer behavior, and partner with Product and Data Science to improve outcomes.
  • Collaborate closely with iOS engineers to deliver coherent cross-platform experiences while applying Android-native patterns and best practices.
  • Participate in architecture and technical design reviews, contribute to code reviews, and raise the engineering quality bar across the team.
  • Debug and resolve production issues and contribute to the operational health of commerce experiences.

What you will bring

  • Experience building production Android apps in Kotlin.
  • Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, and Flow used in production, not just in a side project.
  • Solid architecture fundamentals: MVVM or MVI, multi module Gradle, dependency injection with Hilt.
  • REST or GraphQL integration with Retrofit and OkHttp, plus sensible caching and offline handling.
  • Testing as a habit: JUnit, MockK, Compose UI tests.
  • Clear written communication and a bias toward owning a feature end to end.

Nice to have

Payments or fintech background, PCI DSS awareness, Android Keystore and biometric auth, feature flags and experimentation, accessibility, marketplace or ecommerce product work.

Job Summary:

This role owns product strategy and execution for payment optimization across PayPal's branded and unbranded (PPCP) stacks, with direct accountability for authentication and authorization rate performance. The role also drives Global Platform Unification across our PSP businesses, concentrating on optimization capabilities and value-added services (VAS) that can be delivered consistently across regions and business lines. This is an individual contributor role.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Uses data to build insights on product or platform requirements consistent with the shared vision for the product.
  • Gathers insights from the customer experience and customer needs to input to product requirements
  • Analyzes research, market analysis and usability studies, research and market analysis to support data-driven decision making
  • Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Own product strategy and lifecycle performance: Manage, track, and report product performance across its full lifecycle, including strategy, planning, and issue prioritization, spanning wallet, issuer, platform decline, and risk decline optimization.
  • Drive the roadmap and statement of direction: Drive product development and improvements, including roadmap and statement of direction work, and manage the full product lifecycle from concept and design through testing, production deployment, and commercialization.
  • Drive wallet optimization: Own approval rate and acceptance for digital wallets such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, including tokenized and pass through wallet flows, wallet provisioning and updates, and the authentication and routing specific to each wallet.
  • Drive issuer optimization: Raise approval rates at the issuer level using the data issuers prefer, such as network tokens, merchant advice and decline codes, and enriched transaction metadata, along with issuer engagement and retry and routing strategies built for each issuer.
  • Drive platform decline optimization: Steadily reduce the declines that come from PayPal's own platform and gateway, such as technical and soft declines, validation errors, timeouts, formatting issues, and routing failures, working with engineering to measure, diagnose, and fix them.
  • Drive risk decline optimization: Work with Risk and Fraud to cut false declines from risk decisioning, tuning rules and models to approve more legitimate transactions while keeping fraud and chargeback exposure in check.
  • Own playbooks for each market: Own the playbooks that cover wallet mix, issuer preferences, 3DS exemptions, network token adoption, routing rules, and retry windows, and keep tuning them across all markets Paypal operates in.
  • Run experiments with data: Design and lead A/B and multivariate tests for method selection, routing, and retries, measure the impact on authorization rate and on each decline category, and iterate toward a measurable lift in approvals.
  • Prioritize by ROI and set OKRs: Prioritize features by quantified ROI, set OKRs tied to conversion lift and approval rate, and build business cases to support new product recommendations.
  • Write PRDs and technical specs: Author PRDs and sequence diagrams for gateway, processor, network, and wallet integrations, with clear requirements and strong acceptance criteria that lead to high quality launches.
  • Lead across teams and own reliability: Lead peers and dotted line relationships through the project lifecycle, serve as the main negotiator between internal teams and clients to resolve problems and use cases, and own incident runbooks, root cause analysis, and reliability KPIs alongside on call partners..

Job Summary:

What you need to know about the role-


We are looking for technologists with the highest levels of technical talent, programming, and communication skills with a keen desire to deeply understand our product and how to make our systems more robust and more resilient.

Meet our team

We are the Unified Integration Platform (UIP) team, PayPal’s enterprise data replication team. We replicate data at scale between data stores across PayPal, and between PayPal and external partners. Many of PayPal’s analytics, risk, finance, and product experiences depend on the data we deliver.
We are a close-knit, collaborative group of engineers who care about reliability, performance, and getting things right. We own our platform from design through production. You will work on hard scale problems in a high-impact area, learn from experienced teammates, and have room to grow your technical depth.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop data pipelines for efficient data collection and processing.
  • Build and maintain scalable data storage solutions.
  • Ensure data quality and consistency through validation and cleansing processes.
  • Implement data transformation techniques to prepare data for analysis.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and provide solutions.
  • Optimize data engineering processes for performance and reliability.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Your way to impact

You will help keep data flowing across PayPal. The pipelines you build and run at scale feed analytics, risk models, finance reporting, and customer-facing products. Your work will:

• Give teams across PayPal and our external partners fast, accurate, trustworthy data.

• Make replication faster, more reliable, and cheaper as volumes grow.

• Shorten the time it takes teams to onboard new data sources and targets.

• Raise the bar on quality, observability, and resilience for the platform.

Your day to day

• Design, build, and maintain batch and streaming replication pipelines that move high volumes of data between on-prem and cloud data stores.

• Tune pipelines for throughput, latency, and cost.

• Handle schema changes, backfills, and failure recovery without data loss or duplication.

• Build data quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting.

• Onboard new sources and targets with product, platform, and consuming teams.

• Join design reviews, code reviews, on-call, and root-cause analysis.


What do you need to bring-

• 2–4 years of experience in data engineering or backend software engineering.

• Strong programming skills in Java, Python, or Scala, and strong SQL.

• Hands-on experience with distributed data processing and streaming (Kafka, Spark, Dataflow, or similar).

• Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases, change data capture (CDC), and cloud platforms (GCP preferred).

• Understanding of data modelling, pipeline design, and performance tuning for high-volume systems.

• Strong debugging skills and a sense of ownership of your work end to end.

• Clear communication and a collaborative approach.

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Job Summary:

The Senior Manager, Solution Sales, Payouts is part of the North America Commercial sales team, partnering with Account Management to grow adoption and transaction margin for PayPal's Payouts solutions, including Enterprise Payouts and PayPal Payouts, across new and existing accounts.

Enterprise Payouts gives platforms and marketplaces a configurable, enterprise-grade way to disburse funds globally, across 200+ markets and 50+ currencies, through bank transfers, cards, digital wallets, and other local payout methods, while PayPal Payouts offers a simpler, self-serve way to send batch payments directly to PayPal and Venmo accounts.

This is a consultative sales role. The Specialist leads with discovery, not product pitch, diagnosing each merchant's specific needs before designing the right solution and positioning differentiated value against competitors, from opportunity through activation.

Success is measured by profitable activated volume within assigned verticals.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex projects of diverse scope requiring an understanding of current business trends.
  • Participate in complex problem resolution and determine methods for new assignments.
  • Implement initiatives that result in global process improvements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product sales strategies.
  • Provide expertise in product knowledge and market insights to enhance sales efforts.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:


Additional Required Qualifications 

  • Extensive experience with domestic and cross-border payout and disbursement solutions, and the ability to deploy the right combination of solutions to optimize for a merchant's unique needs; experience with Enterprise Payouts and PayPal Payouts specifically is a bonus. 
  • A consistent track record of exceeding quota targets. 
  • A strong analytical mind, with the ability to build ROI-based business cases and evidence-based sales narratives. 
  • Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams to structure win-win commercial outcomes. 
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders informally. 
  • Skilled storyteller, with the ability to communicate a compelling, value-based narrative to executive audiences. 
  • Expert in PowerPoint, Excel, and the Microsoft suite. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Ability to position Enterprise Payouts and PayPal Payouts against competitive and in-house alternatives, and translate payout economics, including disbursement speed and payout method flexibility, into a quantified, merchant-specific business case. 
  • 5+ years of experience solution selling to senior executives at Fortune 1000 companies, including experience engaging C-level decision makers across Product, Sales, and Finance. 
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CRM. 
  • Expertise in getting the most out of AI, using AI tools to accelerate discovery, research, solutioning, and pipeline analysis, not just familiarity with them. 
  • Financial analysis experience. 
  • MBA or other advanced degree in Finance, Business, or a related field. 

Additional Responsibilities 

  • Partner with Account Managers to identify, shape, and advance product-specific opportunities for new and existing accounts.

  • Leverage internal and external data to identify growth opportunities and build pipeline. 
  • Own and evolve the specialist team's playbook and selling process. 
  • Collect feedback and recommendations from Account Managers and customers, and channel them back to Product and GTM teams to help shape future product roadmaps. 
  • Designs and positions the right combination of PayPal capabilities, not a single product in isolation, and translates that combination into a client-specific business case and quantified value against competitive alternatives. 
  • Uses sales pipeline, back-book portfolio data, and product and merchant performance data to prioritize opportunities, build the commercial case, and support pricing decisions, treating data as the basis for prioritization, not a supporting exhibit. 
  • Builds credibility with and mobilizes Account Management, Solution Engineering, Integration Engineers, Finance, Legal, and Product without formal authority over those teams. 
  • Acts as a resource and force multiplier for other sellers, sharing knowledge of Payouts systems and operations, and ushering merchants from lead to live with a focus on discovery and solutioning.

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This role is responsible for providing analytical support for the Second Line oversight of Buy Now Pay Later products, including their Underwriting and Account Management practices, ensuring that the portfolio is properly managed and is operating according to strategic goals and within the risk appetite.

As part of the Second Line of Defense function, you will combine analytical rigor with credit risk domain expertise to provide independent oversight, delivering effective challenges on credit strategy and risk controls. To be successful, this role requires strong analytical skills, understanding of Credit Risk principles, and the ability to collaborate across multiple functions while maintaining independence.

This job will lead the development and implementation of advanced data science models and algorithms. You will work with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Your role involves driving best practices in data science, ensuring and data quality.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and implementation of advanced data science models.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements.
  • Drive best practices in data science.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity in all processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior data scientists.
  • Stay updated with the latest trends in data science.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

·       An advanced degree in a quantitative field, such as statistics, mathematics, or engineering (preferred).

·       3+ years of experience in credit risk management/lending, involving understanding of credit risk fundamentals (e.g. underwriting principles, credit risk metrics) (preferred).

·       Strong analytical skills, demonstrating ability to work with data, identify patterns, derive/visualize business insights, and translating them into compelling narratives.

·       Experience with merchant or small business lending environments is a strong plus.

·       Understanding of second line of defense functions is a strong plus

·       Proficiency with Python, SQL, or other statistical analysis tools is a strong plus.

·       Ability to assess, review and analyze current credit strategy and exposure limits/thresholds to ensure alignment to the Risk Appetite. Ensure adherence to changes in the business model and/or regulatory environment.

·       Excellent written and verbal skills; interpersonal and collaborative skills; ability to communicate credit risk concepts to technical and non-technical audiences; ability to communicate second line challenges in an effective and respectful manner.

·       Critical thinker with strong influencing, negotiation, and relationship building skills; an ability to interface internally and externally to ensure successful, high-quality outcomes.

·       Ability to work with geographically disperse teams, especially with teams situated abroad and in different time zones.

Job Summary:

This job contributes to product strategy alongside cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring alignment with the shared vision. It includes implementing an architectural roadmap that balances innovative design with regulatory requirements, customer needs, and profitability. The position focuses on enhancing customer experience and monitoring success metrics through usability studies and market analysis. Responsibilities also encompass managing workstreams for analytics and competitive analysis, overseeing product profitability, participating in operational reviews, and collaborating with content developers, data scientists, and designers. This job is an individual contributor.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Inputs to product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders consistent with the shared vision for the product or enabling platform.
  • Implements the architectural roadmap that balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Controls for the customer experience and customer needs in product requirements and as an input to decision making.
  • Monitors metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Manages one or more workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Participates in operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

About the Role

Great decisions depend on trustworthy, accessible data. As Lead Product Manager, you’ll own two connected areas: self-service analytics, the tools that let teams explore data and get answers on their own, and instrumentation, the real-time product behavioral data that powers those tools. You’ll define how teams across PayPal capture, govern, and use behavioral data, and how AI makes that data easier to explore and act on without an analyst in the loop.

You’ll partner with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Data Governance, Privacy, and Product teams to build tools people want to use and a data foundation they can trust.


What You’ll Do

  • Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for self-service analytics and instrumentation, tying both to business outcomes and user adoption.
  • Build AI-powered analytics experiences such as conversational querying, automated root-cause analysis, and AI agents that surface insights, so non-technical users get answers quickly.
  • Make AI-generated answers trustworthy: accurate, explainable, and grounded in governed, high-quality data.
  • Drive adoption across product, engineering, and business teams through enablement, training, and feedback loops, with clear metrics for usage, data quality, coverage, and time-to-insight.
  • Work closely with technical teams (data engineering, platform, and analytics engineering) to translate complex data architecture into clear product requirements.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives, manage dependencies and risks, and communicate progress and trade-offs to senior leadership.
  • Mentor other product managers and raise the bar on data-driven product practices.

What You’ll Bring

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including leading data, analytics, or developer-facing platform products.
  • Proven experience building self-service analytics tools, with an understanding of how AI/LLMs are changing how people interact with data.
  • Hands-on experience with real-time behavioral data and instrumentation: event streaming, tagging and tracking, schema management, and data pipelines.
  • Credibility with engineers and data scientists, with the ability to dig into technical detail and still communicate clearly to business partners.
  • A track record of influencing across a large, matrixed organization without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical skills, including comfort with SQL and analytics tools.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with semantic layers, metric definitions, or data catalogs.
  • Background in payments, fintech, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience launching AI-powered features in an enterprise setting.

Why PayPal

We’re guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. These guide how we work together and with our customers. You’ll help shape how a global payments company understands its customers and makes decisions.
