Job Summary:

The Senior Manager, SEC Reporting role will lead the preparation and review of PayPal's SEC filings (Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K) ensuring compliance with US GAAP and SEC rules and regulations and drive the financial statement filing process and timeline. This role demands strong project management and communication skills and the ability to partner and influence cross functionally with Controllership, Tax, FP&A, Legal, Investor Relations, and others. We are seeking someone with exceptional technical depth of US GAAP and SEC rules and the judgment to form and defend positions where the guidance is ambiguous or silent. This Senior Manager role will also prepare Disclosure Committee, Audit Committee, or other executive-level materials, and identify and deliver improvements to the reporting process, including automation of processes.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Partner with PayPal business leaders and wider PayPal finance organization on accounting and reporting matters
  • Drive accounting support within finance transformation work programs and other process enhancements
  • Provide accounting expertise and leadership to finance and business organizations
  • Consult with business partners regularly to ensure awareness of significant transactions and potential accounting impact

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active CPA, with a Big 4 public accounting foundation combined with external reporting and accounting policy experience at a large public company
  • Direct, hands-on experience preparing and reviewing Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K for a large accelerated filer, including financial statements, footnotes, MD&A, disclosure checklists, tie-outs, and Inline XBRL tagging.
  • Experience designing, documenting, and operating SOX internal controls and disclosure controls over the external reporting process, including coordinating with Internal Audit and external auditors.
  • Experience preparing or reviewing proxy statement financial disclosures in partnership with Legal and HR.
  • Experience supporting earnings releases and investor materials, including tie-out of financial content and coordination with Investor Relations, FP&A, and Comms.
  • Proven project management skills through building and holding a reporting calendar, coordinating deliverables across multiple functions, and sustaining quality under tight and repeating deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner and influence cross-functionally, working effectively with Controllership, Tax, FP&A, Legal, Investor Relations, and external auditors.
  • Deep knowledge of SEC reporting requirements — Regulation S-X, Regulation S-K, SAB Topics, and staff C&DIs.
  • Technical depth across several US GAAP topics: revenue recognition (ASC 606), credit losses (ASC 326), transfers of financial assets (ASC 860), consolidation and VIEs (ASC 810), business combinations (ASC 805), equity securities and equity method (ASC 321/323), share-based compensation and EPS (ASC 718, 260), derivatives and hedging (ASC 815), and segment reporting (ASC 280).
  • Demonstrated ability to research and interpret accounting guidance and disclosure guidance and use professional judgment to support conclusions; experience assessing and implementing new accounting standards and SEC rules across a multinational organization.
  • Experience with non-GAAP financial measures and their compliance with regulations, reconciliation preparation and review, and governance over the Company's non-GAAP reporting policies.
  • Ability to assess and challenge the appropriateness and effectiveness of disclosures, including benchmarking against peer filers and monitoring FASB, SEC, and PCAOB developments and emerging disclosure trends.
  • Experience preparing Disclosure Committee, Audit Committee, or other executive-level materials, with the judgment to calibrate technical detail to the audience and strong presentation-building skills.
  • Experience reviewing the work of and mentoring less experienced team members — setting priorities, providing constructive feedback, and raising the technical capability of the broader team.
  • Track record of improving or automating accounting and reporting processes — including experience with AI-enabled workflows, disclosure management platforms (Workiva preferred), or other reporting technology — paired with the control mindset to adopt new tooling without weakening the control environment.

payment services providers.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop and articulate a clear vision and strategy for risk management aligned with PayPal's overall strategy.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to assess and mitigate risks impacting operations and assets.
  • Inspire and lead teams to implement long-term sustainability and financial stability strategies.
  • Monitor and evaluate risk exposure to ensure compliance and safeguard the organization’s reputation.
  • Provide key inputs and guidance as an industry leader to influence decision-making at the executive level.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Role Overview

The Senior Director, Risk (Second Line of Defense) is a PPUK leadership role responsible for providing independent oversight, challenge, and governance across PayPal UK’s risk profile and develop and maintain the PPUK risk management framework.


The role supports protecting PayPal and enabling sustainable growth while operating within approved risk appetite, ensuring compliance with UK regulatory expectations. This includes FCA requirements Consumer Duty, Operational Resilience, Financial Crime, and safeguarding regulations applicable to Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), Credit and Crypto firms and payment services providers.


As a key member of PPUK leadership the role partners closely with UK and global executives, business leaders, and control functions to ensure robust identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of material risks impacting the PayPal UK regulated entity and customers (both consumers and merchants). The position requires exceptional executive presence, strong Board-level communication capability, and the ability to effectively influence and manage relationships across C-suite leadership, regulators, and global stakeholders.


Governance Memberships

• FCA Certified Individual

• Member of UK Executive Committee (UK EXCO)

• Member of UK Board Audit, Risk & Regulatory Committee (ARRC)

• Chair of UK Risk Committee

• Participant in UK Board governance and Board Risk discussions


Key Responsibilities

(1) Enterprise Risk Oversight

• Provide independent Second Line oversight and challenge across key risk domains including:

- Capital Risk (Counterparty, Liquidity & Market)

- Extended Enterprise / Third Party Risk

- Operational Risk (Continuity & Financial Accounting & Reporting)

- Technology Risk (Date, information protection, privacy & Service Delivery)

• Ensure material risks are identified, assessed, monitored, escalated, and managed appropriately across UK regulated entities.

• Review and challenge First Line risk assessments, controls, incidents, remediation plans, and risk acceptances.

• Development, implementation, and maintenance of the UK Risk Appetite Framework and associated KRIs/KPIs.

• Drive effective risk governance and promote a strong risk culture across PayPal UK.


(2) Safeguarding Officer Responsibilities

• Act as the FCA designated Safeguarding Officer for PayPal UK.

• Provide Second Line oversight of safeguarding arrangements in accordance with:

- FCA Electronic Money Regulations (EMRs), Payment Services Regulations (PSRs) FCA safeguarding guidance and expectations

• Ensure robust governance, monitoring, and oversight of safeguarding controls protecting customer funds.

• Independently assess the effectiveness of safeguarding frameworks, reconciliations, segregation controls, and safeguarding operational processes.

• Review and challenge safeguarding controls, third-party banking arrangements, reconciliations, and incident management processes.

• Ensure safeguarding breaches, incidents, or near misses are appropriately escalated, investigated, remediated, and reported.

• Oversee safeguarding-related regulatory reporting, attestations, audits, and remediation activities.


(3) Governance, Board & Regulatory Engagement

• Serve as a member of the UK Executive Committee (UK EXCO), contributing to strategic, operational, regulatory, and governance discussions.

• Serve as a member of the UK Boar Audit, Risk & Regulatory Committee (ARRC), providing independent oversight and challenge on material risk matters.

• Chair PPUK Executive level Risk Committee.

• Engage directly with the FCA, 3LOD internal audit, and external stakeholders as required.

• Maintain strong understanding of UK regulatory expectations impacting fintech, payments, e-money, and digital financial services.


Required Qualifications & Experience

Essential

• Significant senior leadership experience in the UK, working within a global regulated financial services or payments firm:

- Risk Management, Enterprise Risk, Operational Risk, Regulatory Risk including Board Level experience. Proven ability to influence and manage senior C-suite stakeholders effectively.

- Strong understanding of FCA regulatory expectations, Three Lines of Defense model

• Demonstrated capability providing independent challenge within complex regulatory and commercial environments.

• Strong analytical, strategic thinking, communication, and leadership skills.


Preferred

• Knowledge of: Digital payments, Wallets, Merchant acquiring, Fintech ecosystems.

Job Summary:

Job Description Summary
PayPal's Enterprise Systems and Employee Technology organization is building an AI-native enterprise across finance, HR, legal, sales and IT. We're looking for an Executive Assistant Business Partner to support the VP who leads it — a fast-moving, data-driven technology executive with a broad, matrixed portfolio. This is a strategic partner role, not a scheduling role.
This is a high-judgment role for someone who has supported a CIO, CTO or senior technology leader before and is comfortable in the language of IT and enterprise systems. You will understand the organization's priorities, manage the executive's calendar independently, and exercise judgment about when to involve them — operating as the operational right hand across a wide set of stakeholders.
Your way to impact
• Own and defend the executive's calendar, making fast trade-off decisions on priorities, conflicts and travel.
• Act as a trusted gatekeeper and first point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, from the executive leadership team to major technology vendors.
• Keep the executive ahead of what matters: meeting prep, follow-ups tracked, decisions and actions not dropped.
• Bring enough fluency in IT and enterprise systems to read context — who matters, what's urgent, what a meeting is really about — rather than handling logistics blind.
• Operate with discretion on confidential and sensitive information.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Manages calendar of the executive and daily work with some instruction from others.
  • Performs general administrative duties such as travel, expenses, department distribution list, purchase orders, ordering supplies in accordance with standard procedures & practices.
  • Engage and collaborate with the immediate team & internal partners.
  • May act as a delegate for the executive when reviewing and approving expense reports
  • Proactively identifies opportunities to increase efficiency and improve processes, anticipating the needs of the executive & team
  • Collaborate regularly with peers and internal partners while developing and maintaining strong relationships.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3 years of relevant work experience

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • 8+ years as an executive assistant, including direct support of senior executives or technology leaders in large, global organizations.
  • Prior experience supporting a CIO, CTO or senior technology executive — or working inside a technology organization.
  • Working familiarity with IT and enterprise systems (for example SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday) and the vocabulary of enterprise technology.
  • Excellent calendar, travel and inbox management under constant change.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, and the judgment to represent a senior executive well.
  • High discretion with confidential information.
  • Fluency with Microsoft 365 and Outlook, SharePoint, Google Workspace, Slack and collaboration tools.
  • Comfortable with a fast, candid, data-driven operating style; proactive rather than reactive.
  • Experience in executive operations or a strategic administrative business-partner role in a large, matrixed technology or financial-services company.
  • Fintech or payments industry background.
  • Experience supporting executives who work with major technology vendors and system integrators.
  • Exposure to AI tools for scheduling, notes and productivity.

Job Summary:

PayPal's Corporate Development team is looking for a Senior Analyst to help identify, evaluate, and execute acquisitions that advance the strategic and financial objectives of the company and its business divisions. This role is for someone who has built a strong foundation in investment banking and wants to move from advising on transactions to owning them, seeing a deal through from first idea to signed agreement to integration.

  • Assist in the coordination and execution of deal activities, including due diligence and post-deal integration

  • Collaborate with the investment team on various projects and initiatives
  • Provide insights based on market and financial analysis
  • Work effectively within teams and foster cross-functional collaboration
  • Multitask and prioritize assignments to meet deadlines
  • Support the development of business cases and evaluate investment opportunities

  • Background in fintech, consumer technology, or consumer financial services, whether through banking coverage, investing, corporate strategy, or an operating role
  • Strong financial modeling and valuation skills, including DCF, trading comparables, precedent transactions, and accretion/dilution analysis
  • Experience supporting transactions through multiple phases, including target screening, due diligence, negotiation, signing, close, and post-close integration
  • Sound judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams under tight deal timelines
  • A strategic owner's mindset: curious about how our businesses operate and why a deal makes sense, not only financially but operationally and strategically

Job Summary:

Venmo is looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the Venmo Credit Card and lead the development of our first lending offerings. This role combines ownership of a scaled consumer credit product with 0-to-1 product development, identifying and validating new ways Venmo can help customers access and manage credit. You will partner across Engineering, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Growth, Marketing, and external bank and lending partners to deliver customer-centered products that achieve business objectives while operating within regulatory and risk requirements.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Inputs to product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders consistent with the shared vision for the product or enabling platform.
  • Implements the architectural roadmap that balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Controls for the customer experience and customer needs in product requirements and as an input to decision making.
  • Monitors metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Manages one or more workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Participates in operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Additional Responsibilities

  • Own the Venmo Credit Card roadmap across acquisition, activation, engagement, rewards, servicing, and account management.
  • Establish business goals with Finance across new accounts, spend, balances, revenue, credit performance, and unit economics, and connect roadmap priorities to those outcomes.
  • Lead 0-to-1 lending initiatives, developing and testing product hypotheses based on customer needs, market opportunities, and Venmo's ecosystem.
  • Define MVPs, success metrics, experiments, and phased launch plans to validate customer demand and economics before scaling.
  • Build business cases for new lending products, including credit loss, funding, and profitability assumptions.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Legal on regulatory requirements and credit and fraud risk considerations.
  • Manage product planning and execution with issuing-bank, lending, funding, and technology partners as applicable.
  • Partner with Growth and Marketing on go-to-market strategy and with Customer Support and Operations on scalable servicing experiences.
  • Contribute to the broader Venmo Cards strategy in partnership with Debit Card and other product teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Product management experience in fintech, payments, consumer financial services, or another regulated consumer product.
  • Direct experience with credit cards, consumer lending, installment lending, or buy-now-pay-later products.
  • Experience taking a new product or business line from concept through launch.
  • Understanding of consumer credit economics, including interchange, interest income, credit losses, customer acquisition cost, and lifetime value.
  • Familiarity with underwriting, credit policy, loss forecasting, and portfolio management.
  • Experience partnering with a bank, issuer, lender, or other regulated third party.
  • Experience using SQL, BI tools, experimentation, or A/B testing to inform product decisions.
  • Strong executive communication and demonstrated ability to drive alignment across complex cross-functional teams.

As a Senior iOS Software Engineer, you will lead the architecture and quality of the PayPal POS iOS app, including payment-critical flows such as Tap to Pay on iPhone, Key In and reader connectivity. You will guide the team through taking over ownership of the app from our Sweden colleagues and set the bar for how we build, test and release.

Meet our team
Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
  • Advises immediate management on project-level issues
  • Guides junior engineers
  • Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
  • Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Your way to impact

• Own the architecture of the iOS app and keep it maintainable as the product converges with PayPal.

• Lead delivery of payment-critical features such as Tap to Pay on iPhone, Key In and reader pairing.

• Raise the quality bar through automation, observability and release discipline.

• Mentor engineers and lead the iOS side of knowledge transfer from Sweden.

Your day to day

• Lead design of complex features and refactors; write design documents and decision records.

• Own Tap to Pay on iPhone and ProximityReader flows, including entitlements, token and reader configuration.

• Define standards for architecture, testing, performance and accessibility.

• Partner with backend, product, design and security to deliver safe payment flows.

• Run app releases and rollouts and act as incident lead for iOS issues.

• Review pull requests and coach engineers at CL5 and below.

What do you need to bring-

• 4 to 7 years of iOS development experience, with a record of shipping and owning a large production app.

• Deep Swift expertise and strong app architecture, performance and release management skills.

• Experience with payment or hardware-connected apps: Tap to Pay on iPhone, EMV and contactless concepts, Core Bluetooth.

• Knowledge of PCI-aware design: handling of PAN and PIN data, tokens and entitlement flows.

• Experience leading technical work and mentoring engineers.

• Nice to have: modular app architectures, accessibility, and migration of apps across identity systems.

• Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden.

• A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records.

• Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product.

Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
  • Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
  • Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
  • Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
  • May contribute to code & design reviews

  • Make checkout and receipts fast and reliable for merchants at the counter, on phones and on terminals.
  • Deliver features across product library, inventory, purchase history, refunds and invoices.
  • Help legacy Zettle merchants move onto PayPal identity with a smooth sign-in and onboarding experience in the app.
  • Improve app stability, release quality and crash-free sessions across a wide range of devices.

Your day to day

  • Build and ship features in Kotlin and Java using Jetpack libraries, coroutines and Jetpack Compose.
  • Integrate with backend services over REST and GraphQL; handle auth and session flows.
  • Work with Bluetooth reader connectivity and terminal hardware integration under guidance.

Job Summary:

What you need to know about the role
As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, you will own the design and reliability of Java services across checkout, commerce, identity and money movement for PayPal POS. You will lead the technical side of taking ownership of these services from our Sweden team: shape the plan, mentor engineers, and be the person we trust with critical payment and financial flows.

Meet our team
Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned.
We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform.

Job Description:

  • Advises immediate management on project-level issues
  • Guides junior engineers

  • Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Reduce operational and financial risk in payment, settlement and payout flows through better design, automation and observability.

  • Grow the team: mentor engineers, review designs, and make knowledge transfer from Sweden stick.

Your day to day

  • Lead design and delivery of larger changes such as new payment flows, integrations and migrations, writing clear design documents and decision records.
  • Act as incident commander for your domain; run post-incident reviews and drive the fixes.
  • Own SLOs, alerting and capacity for your services; work with SRE and PayPal platform teams.
  • Review code and designs for the team, and coach engineers at CL5 and below.
  • Partner with product, Finance, security and compliance on payments, settlement, payouts and reconciliation.

  • 4 to7 years of software engineering experience, with deep Java expertise and a record of owning production services.
  • Proven design of distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including multi-region and failure-mode thinking.
  • Strong knowledge of payments: authorization, capture, refunds, clearing, settlement, chargebacks and reconciliation. Experience with ledgers, payouts or bank connectivity is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope, key management and secure access to sensitive data.
  • Experience leading cross-team technical work, mentoring, and handling incidents as lead.

You will act as a key partner to the SVP of the Americas supporting the execution of strategy and serving as a trusted advisor to translate vision into operational delivery. You will work across commercial and operational teams to ensure alignment, support execution, and turn insights into action to drive performance and growth.

  • Establish overall business or technical strategy for the business operations of aligned organization.
  • Influence decisions as an advisor or counsel to business leadership.
  • Drive strategic objectives and ensure resources are effectively allocated.
  • Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.
  • Act as a liaison between business leadership, staff, and other key partners.
  • Optimize workflows and drive process improvements to enhance organizational performance.
  • Drive and monitor Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to address gaps in business and operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Support for Commercial Execution - Support the SVP of Americas in overarching topics such as strategy formulation and priority setting for the businessPartner with segment leads across Enterprise, SMB and Consumer to provide insights and support, enabling growth, market responsiveness, and improved customer experience.
  • Insights-Driven Decision Making - Leverage data and business intelligence to drive informed decisions, identify risks and opportunities, and support executive-level planning.
  • Develop and implement strategic plans and initiatives to improve business processes and drive growth. Identify and implement operational efficiencies to increase productivity and reduce costs.
  • Performance Management - Define and leverage key metrics to monitor performance, identify issues, and support outcome-driven decision making across each business line (merchant and consumer).
  • Lead Operating Rhythms - Own and lead the operating rhythms of the region, including operating reviews and performance reviews. Ensure consistency, insight, and accountability across all review cadences.
  • Operating Model Governance - Ensure the markets operating model is functioning effectively, aligning teams, systems, and resources to support strategic goals.
  • Cross-functional partnership - Drive strong collaboration between Product, Marketing, Finance, Analytics and Revenue Operations functions to ensure alignment and operational execution of initiatives.
  • Analyze market trends and customer needs to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement. Stay updated on industry trends and changes in the e-commerce landscape to inform business strategies.
  • Manage budgets and resource allocation to support the Americas region.

  • 8+ years in senior business operations or general management roles, ideally within fast-growing tech environments. Experience in management consulting, e-commerce, digital transformation or business model transformation is a plus.

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to support go-to-market teams with operational insights, challenging norms and initiating recommendations for change.

  • Ability to work in a matrix organization – work with peers, manage upwards and downwards with an empathic leadership style. Proven ability to lead teams and drive alignment in dynamic, high-change environments

Job Summary:

The Business Development Representative (BDR) in PayPal’s Channel Partnerships and Business Development team creates new pipeline with higher-value merchants across Australia and New Zealand. The BDR researches target accounts in assigned verticals, reaches senior decision makers through calls, social selling, email and events, and qualifies each opportunity before handing it to Enterprise or SMB sales.

You’ll work with channel partners and the Enterprise and SMB sales teams, using PayPal’s partner and ecosystem relationships to open doors and sharing leads both ways. You’ll also help merchants that stall in onboarding get live. It’s a high-energy hunter role for people who want to learn enterprise sales and be judged on the quality of the pipeline they create.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Complete routine tasks with detailed instructions.
  • Utilize customer contact information to reach out via phone, social, and email.
  • Discover customer needs and explain PayPal’s value proposition.
  • -Gain customer commitment to take the next step in the sales process.
  • Suggest changes to existing processes and procedures to improve efficiency and results.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

 Your impact:

    • Open doors with higher-value merchants by combining your own outbound with PayPal’s partner and ecosystem relationships.
    • Turn first meetings into qualified opportunities that Enterprise and SMB sales are glad to receive: a clear need, the right decision maker and a realistic timeline.
    • Build deep knowledge of your assigned verticals: who buys payments, how they decide, and what makes PayPal relevant to them.
    • Be the Channel Partner Managers’ eyes and ears in the market. Share leads both ways, and bring back what you hear from merchants and partners.
    • Help merchants that stall in onboarding get over the line, working with partners and the onboarding teams.
    • Make the team better: record what works in messaging and process so the next BDR starts faster.
    • Keep Salesforce accurate and up to date so pipeline reporting can be trusted.

What you bring:

    • 1–2 years of sales, business development, marketing or lead generation experience. Payments, fintech, SaaS or eCommerce is a plus.
    • A hunter mindset: motivation, resilience and comfort with cold calls, with the skill to get past barriers and reach senior decision makers.
    • Experience developing leads from marketing campaigns or referrals is a plus.
    • A track record of achieving individual and team goals in a professional setting.
    • Curious and commercial: quick to learn a new vertical, its buyers and how they use payments.
    • Clear written and verbal communication, with strong follow-up and note-taking discipline.
    • Works well both independently and as part of a team in a high-energy, fast-changing sales environment.
    • A desire to learn enterprise sales methodologies and build a career in sales or partnerships.
    • Experience with Salesforce, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Gong is a plus.
    • Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a commercially minded marketing leader to serve as Sr Director, Marketing for the DACH region. This role will lead the Germany, Austria, and Switzerland marketing agenda, owning end-to-end market planning, budget allocation, campaign strategy, partner marketing, and execution across a highly matrixed, two-sided network.

The role will translate global strategies into locally relevant market plans while ensuring DACH insights inform global priorities. The successful candidate will work closely with corporate, global, and North America leadership, as well as regional Sales, Product, Finance, Analytics, Partnerships, and Marketing teams.

This is not a traditional brand marketing role. It is a commercially focused leadership position accountable for driving measurable business growth, optimizing marketing investment, and strengthening the consumer and merchant flywheel across the PayPal ecosystem.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop and articulate a clear, compelling vision and strategy for the marketing function
  • Provide key inputs as an industry leader and expert in marketing
  • Inspire and lead the marketing team to achieve long-term success
  • Align marketing strategies with PayPal-wide strategy and operations
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement in marketing practices
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure the marketing function supports overall business goals

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Establish and execute the overall marketing strategy for the organization
  • Influence executive-level decision-making on marketing initiatives
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to align marketing strategies with business objectives
  • Lead large-scale marketing projects and programs with significant impact
  • Analyze market trends and competitive landscape to inform strategic decisions
  • Provide strategic guidance and mentorship to marketing team leaders

As Sr Director, Integrated Marketing, you will be accountable for connecting marketing strategy and execution to commercial outcomes. You will: 

    • Lead the strategic development and execution of the DACH market plan.  
    • Own end-to-end planning across priorities, investments, campaigns, partners, and performance.  
    • Drive market share growth, customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and conversion.  
    • Apply a deep understanding of two-sided network businesses and consumer fintech to identify growth opportunities across consumers, merchants, partners, and platforms.  
    • Use flywheel economics to evaluate how marketing investments can create value across both sides of the network.  
    • Manage the DACH marketing portfolio, prioritizing initiatives and allocating resources toward the highest-value opportunities.  
    • Establish clear measurement frameworks and optimize marketing return on investment.  
    • Serve as a senior member of the German country leadership team.  
    • Build alignment across corporate, global, North America, and DACH stakeholders.  
    • Lead and develop the DACH Consumer Marketing team.  

Your Day-to-Day 

      • Develop annual and quarterly integrated market plans aligned to business priorities and global strategy.  
      • Translate global strategies into relevant local execution, balancing enterprise consistency with DACH market needs.  
      • Manage budget allocation, forecasting, investment prioritization, and performance reviews.  
      • Lead integrated campaigns across the full customer funnel, from demand creation through acquisition, engagement, and conversion.  
      • Develop customer and partner marketing strategies that drive measurable commercial growth.  
      • Partner closely with Sales to develop co-marketing initiatives, support priority opportunities, and strengthen partner value propositions.  
      • Work with growth marketing teams to capture demand, improve conversion, and accelerate performance.  
      • Collaborate with Product, Finance, Analytics, Partnerships, Operations, Brand, and regional teams to deliver integrated execution.  
      • Navigate complex and ambiguous business issues, manage trade-offs, and drive clear decisions and action.  
      • Identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of marketing investment.  
      • Share DACH insights and best practices with global teams while applying relevant global learnings locally.  
      • Mentor, inspire, and develop the DACH Marketing team.  

What You Need to Succeed 

      • Significant leadership experience in integrated, commercial, growth, consumer, fintech, payments, platform, marketplace, or similarly complex marketing environments.  
      • Deep understanding of two-sided network businesses and the consumer fintech landscape.  
      • Strong understanding of flywheel economics and the ability to apply it to marketing and business decisions.  
      • Highly analytical, with significant experience in MROI, performance measurement, and data-driven optimization.  
      • Strong financial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, resource allocation, and business-case development.  
      • Demonstrated experience managing a portfolio of markets, products, partners, or growth initiatives.  
      • Strong full-funnel marketing experience across online and offline channels.  
      • Experience developing and executing integrated campaigns tied to measurable business outcomes.  
      • Experience in partner marketing and working closely with Sales to drive commercial opportunities.  
      • Ability to operate effectively across global and local environments, translating enterprise strategy into market-relevant execution.  
      • Proven ability to work with senior corporate, global, North America, and regional leadership.  
      • Highly cross-functional, with the ability to bring together teams with different priorities and perspectives.  
      • Demonstrated ability to work through complex issues, manage ambiguity, and drive alignment and resolution.  
      • Excellent leadership, communication, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills.  
      • Results-driven, accountable, and motivated by measurable business impact.  

What Success Looks Like 

      • Creating a focused, commercially grounded DACH market strategy.  
      • Improving marketing effectiveness, efficiency, and MROI.  
      • Driving measurable growth across both sides of the PayPal network.  
      • Allocating resources toward the highest-value portfolio opportunities.  
      • Strengthening collaboration across global, corporate, North America, and DACH teams.  
      • Increasing speed, clarity, and accountability across integrated marketing execution.  
      • Developing a high-performing team of commercially minded marketers.  
      • Turn customer, partner, and market insights into meaningful business results.

Job Summary:

PayPal Payments Private Limited (PPPL) is the India subsidiary of PayPal Holdings, Inc. and a regulated payments entity supervised by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). As the entity-level Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this role is accountable for ensuring cybersecurity, information technology (IT) and information & communication technology (ICT) risk, and operational resilience capabilities are effectively implemented, governed, and evidenced within the regulated entity, while leveraging PayPal’s global technology and cybersecurity services.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Recognized as a security governance, risk, and compliance expert, independently addressing the most complex security risks and providing strategic direction on risk mitigation and governance practices across the security domain.
  • Define methods and procedures for new or special assignments, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive security risk and governance initiatives that align with business needs and objectives.
  • Lead complex, high-impact security governance and risk management initiatives, leveraging a deep understanding of business trends and security challenges to develop innovative risk mitigation strategies and solutions.
  • Possess a keen awareness of the broader impact of decisions, with initiatives driving enterprise-wide improvements in risk management and security governance, enhancing overall security practices and operational efficiency.
  • Lead a security risk and governance team; set clear priorities and define actionable plans, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
  • Guide team members through complex challenges, fostering their growth and development while maintaining a focus on high-impact results.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

This Senior Manager serves as the entity-level Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and First Line of Defense lead for information security, cyber resilience, and ICT risk management. The role provides local lead of technology services delivered by PayPal's global organisation, ensuring compliance with Reserve Bank of India (RBI) cybersecurity, ICT risk, operational resilience, data protection, and other applicable regulatory requirements.


The CISO is accountable for the local governance and assurance of enterprise security capabilities, ensuring they are effectively implemented, monitored, evidenced, and reported. Working closely with global engineering, infrastructure, cloud, security, SLOD & enterprise risk teams and business teams, the role requires strong technical expertise, sound risk judgement, regulatory interpretation, and excellent communication skills.



Information Security & Cyber Resilience

  • Serve as the entity-level CISO, leading local information security, cyber resilience, and ICT/IT risk management activities
  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of cyber and digital operational resilience capabilities across the regulated entity
  • Partner with global Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Site Reliability Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to strengthen the resilience of critical ICT services and business processes supporting the entity.
  • Ensure enterprise cybersecurity policies, standards, and control requirements are effectively implemented, monitored, and evidenced within the entity, and mapped to applicable RBI requirements.
  • Oversee operational resilience activities, including disaster recovery exercises, cyber simulations, failover testing, tabletop exercises, and resilience validation, and maintain evidence for regulatory and audit review.
  • Oversee adherence to payment data storage and localisation requirements applicable to the entity, coordinating with global teams on data residency, retention, and evidencing.

ICT Risk & Secure Technology Delivery

  • Act as the First Line ICT/IT Risk lead for major technology changes, cloud migrations, new product launches, and transformation initiatives affecting the regulated entity.
  • Lead ICT and cybersecurity risk assessments across infrastructure, applications, cloud services, third-party providers, and operational processes.
  • Ensure security, resilience, data protection, and regulatory requirements are embedded throughout technology delivery and operational processes.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to drive practical, measurable, and risk-based remediation of identified control gaps, including time-bound closure of vulnerabilities identified through VA/PT.
  • Oversee cybersecurity and operational resilience risks associated with third-party technology providers and cloud services supporting the regulated entity, Incident Management & Regulatory Engagement
  • Lead the First Line coordination of cybersecurity incidents and ICT disruption events in partnership with global Cybersecurity and Technology teams.
  • Lead the entity’s coordination of cyber incidents and ICT disruption events, including assessment, escalation, root cause analysis, recovery, and remediation tracking.
  • Drive post-incident reviews and resilience improvements to strengthen operational readiness and reduce future risk.
  • Act as the primary local point of contact for the RBI, CERT-In, external auditors, and internal assurance on cybersecurity, ICT risk, operational resilience, and data protection matters, maintaining a current view of the entity’s regulatory obligations and compliance posture and ensuring control design and evidence remain adequate to demonstrate compliance.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Monitor the effectiveness of cybersecurity and resilience controls, ensuring timely remediation of identified risks and control deficiencies.
  • Develop and report cybersecurity, operational resilience, and ICT risk metrics, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and management reporting to support informed decision-making, including inputs to the Board and IT Steering Committee.
  • Ensure the entity maintains compliance with applicable cybersecurity, ICT risk, operational resilience, data protection, and technology governance requirements under the RBI and other Indian regulatory frameworks, while aligning with PayPal’s global security standards.
  • Advise senior management on cyber risk, technology risk, regulatory developments, resilience readiness, and emerging threats, escalating material risks where appropriate.
  • Partner with global Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams to align enterprise security capabilities with local regulatory expectations and business priorities.

Experience

  • 10-12 years of experience in information security, cybersecurity, ICT/IT risk, technology operations, or cyber resilience within financial services, payments, fintech, or other highly regulated technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cybersecurity, ICT risk, or operational resilience initiatives while partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, and technology teams.
  • Experience operating within a First Line of Defense function or in a technology leadership role with accountability for security, resilience, or operational risk outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of modern technology environments, including cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, enterprise applications, cybersecurity operations, and secure technology delivery.
  • Sufficient technical proficiency to provide credible oversight, assessment, and challenge across areas such as cyber and operational resilience, disaster recovery and resilience testing, incident management and response, ICT risk assessment, secure technology change, and vulnerability management.
  • Experience engaging with regulators, external auditors, and internal assurance functions within regulated financial services environments — engagement with the RBI, CERT-In, or other Indian authorities is highly desirable.
  • Working knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape applicable to non-bank Payment System Operators / payment aggregators, including the RBI (Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices) Directions, 2023; the RBI Master Direction on Cyber Resilience and Digital Payment Security Controls for non-bank PSOs, 2024; the RBI Guidelines on Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways; CERT-In Directions (2022); and the DPDP Act, 2023.
  • Familiarity with recognised security and resilience standards (PCI DSS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework) is expected; exposure to international frameworks such as DORA, PSD2, GDPR, or NIS2 is beneficial given the global, matrixed operating model.
  • Experience influencing technical and business stakeholders and driving cross-functional initiatives in complex, matrixed organisations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native technologies, infrastructure resilience, security tooling, automation, and modern engineering operating models.
  • Experience with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms, operational risk tooling, and executive risk reporting is beneficial.

Core Competencies

  • Strong leadership skills with a collaborative and hands-on approach to driving cybersecurity and resilience outcomes.
  • Strong regulatory interpretation — a key skill for the role: the ability to read and apply RBI, CERT-In, and DPDP requirements, translate principle-based or ambiguous guidance into practical control and evidence expectations, and form and defend a reasoned position with regulators, auditors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to make sound, risk-based decisions during cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and rapidly evolving situations — including under compressed regulatory reporting timelines.
  • Strong technical understanding and proficiency across cybersecurity, cloud technologies, infrastructure, and ICT architectures in modern enterprise environments — sufficient to interpret technical detail, assess risk, and constructively challenge global delivery teams, without performing the technical work directly.
  • Deep knowledge of cyber resilience, operational resilience, technology risk management, and security controls in regulated financial services.
  • Credible technical partner for engineering, infrastructure, product, and security teams, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — a key skill for the role: the ability to produce clear regulatory correspondence, control narratives, root-cause and incident reports, and executive- and Board-level summaries, and to represent the entity credibly and articulately with regulators, auditors, senior management, and cross-functional technical teams.
  • Ability to assess complex cyber and technology risks and translate them into practical, risk-based business and engineering decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on practical implementation, measurable risk reduction, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to balance regulatory expectations, business priorities, and engineering realities to deliver pragmatic and effective cybersecurity outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively within a global, matrixed organisation, balancing enterprise standards with local Indian regulatory obligations.
  • High standards of governance, documentation, and execution, with strong attention to regulatory expectations and operational excellence.
  • Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning, with an interest in emerging technologies, cloud security, AI-related cyber risks, threat intelligence, and evolving resilience practices.

Job Summary:

At PayPal, real-time decisioning powers customer protection and global commerce. We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to lead product direction for a risk domain across a portfolio of risk strategies. Partnering with risk strategy leaders, you’ll set the domain’s product vision and roadmap, turning outcomes like loss reduction, approval rates, and customer experience into product plans. You’ll define what each strategy needs, from rules and models to data and customer treatments, and shape the roadmap of our next-generation Risk Decisioning Platform. Near term, you’ll move strategies off legacy systems and ramp them to full production; beyond that, you’ll launch new strategies and use experimentation and automation to keep optimizing. Working with data science, modeling, and engineering, you’ll track performance and captured savings and represent the domain in product and steering committee reviews. You bring deep risk domain expertise and strong technical fluency.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Inputs to product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders consistent with the shared vision for the product or enabling platform.
  • Implements the architectural roadmap that balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Controls for the customer experience and customer needs in product requirements and as an input to decision making.
  • Monitors metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Manages one or more workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Participates in operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building products in fraud, account integrity, credit, or other risk domains, in close partnership with risk strategy teams.
  • Track record of setting a multi-year product vision and roadmap, balancing near-term delivery with longer-term bets.
  • Working knowledge of how risk decisions are made and tuned, including rules, ML models, features, and step-up and friction treatments, and the tradeoff between loss and customer experience.
  • Strong quantitative skills: defining and interpreting risk metrics (loss, catch, false positive, and approval rates), sizing opportunities, and connecting product changes to business impact.
  • Experience launching through controlled rollouts and experimentation, including champion/challenger tests and staged traffic ramps.
  • Experience translating business needs into clear asks for data science, modeling, and platform teams, and managing dependencies across them.
  • Experience leading major platform transitions, such as migrating risk strategies off legacy systems, while protecting performance.
  • Ability to influence senior business stakeholders and drive milestone-based delivery across multiple teams.

Job Summary:

The Senior Manager, Compliance prioritizes activities across sub-functions and drives continuous improvement of compliance programs. This role solves highly complex compliance problems, determines new methods for emerging regulatory challenges, and develops business partnerships while leading teams and building organizational capabilities.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop a compliance organization across multiple compliance domains or business areas, building high-performing teams
  • Establish compliance program strategy for significant organizational scope, creating comprehensive frameworks aligned with regulatory requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement of compliance processes, methodologies, and control frameworks across the compliance function
  • Develop strategic partnerships with business, legal, risk, audit, and technology leaders to embed compliance into operations
  • Solve highly complex compliance challenges, establishing new approaches when existing frameworks are insufficient for emerging regulatory requirements
  • Collaborate on decisions about compliance program design, resource allocation, and organizational priorities to manage regulatory risk effectively
  • Influence organizational approach to compliance through thought leadership, regulatory insights, and risk-based recommendations
  • Build organizational compliance capability through talent development, knowledge sharing, and establishment of compliance excellence standards

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant compliance experience and a Bachelor's degree OR any equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Proven experience managing compliance teams and delivering complex program initiatives through others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Key Responsibilities

1. Payments Scheme Oversight (Cards & SEPA)

  • Serve as the EU compliance subject-matter contact for payments scheme obligations, including card networks and SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Instant, SDD Core, and Verification of Payee).
  • Monitor, interpret, and assess updates from card networks and European Payment Council for SEPA scheme, and collaborate with the business to ensure relevant requirements are implemented effectively and within required timelines.
  • Provide ongoing oversight of EU entity activities conducted under its card network licenses and SEPA scheme participation.

2. Issuing, Acquiring & SEPA Processing Oversight

  • Review and challenge key controls across:
    • Card issuing and card acquiring lifecycles
    • SEPA credit transfer and direct debit processing activities
  • Support oversight of:
    • Card issuance, activation flows, merchant onboarding, transaction monitoring, and dispute management
    • SEPA payment execution, settlement, exception handling, and scheme compliance controls
  • Ensure customer, merchant, and counterparty processes operate in line with applicable regulatory and scheme standards.

3. Regulatory Oversight

  • Interpret and apply European regulatory requirements relevant to card and SEPA schemes at a practical level.
  • Partner with legal, risk, and operational teams to ensure compliance is embedded into product and process design.
  • Support preparation for regulatory reviews and provide compliance reporting as required.

4. Governance & Reporting

  • Maintain oversight plans, compliance dashboards, and risk indicators for payments scheme activities.
  • Provide regular updates to senior management and internal governance committees.
  • Identify, escalate, and track remediation of key compliance risks and issues in a timely manner.

5. Collaboration & Partnership

  • Work cross-functionally with product, operations, engineering, risk, treasury, and global compliance teams.
  • Build strong working relationships across the business to support effective and pragmatic compliance outcomes.
  • Support new initiatives and product changes by assessing card and SEPA compliance impacts and providing guidance.

Preferred Qualifications (Revised)

  • Experience in card issuing, card acquiring, and/or payments scheme governance, including card networks and/or SEPA schemes.
  • Familiarity with SEPA payment schemes, such as SCT, SCT Instant, SDD Core, and Verification of Payee, or equivalent account-to-account payment frameworks.
  • Prior involvement in second-line compliance oversight, risk management, or control assurance within a regulated payments or financial services environment.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide effective review, challenge, and influence.
  • Ability to work effectively in a complex, global, and cross-functional organization.
  • Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks applicable to payment services, such as PSD2/PSD3 and related regulatory guidance.

Strong knowledge of common design patterns, algorithms, and object-oriented programming with expertise in design patterns such as MVC and MVVM.

Job Summary:

At PayPal, real-time decisioning powers customer protection and global commerce. We’re looking for a Senior Lead Product Manager to lead product direction for a risk domain across a portfolio of strategies spanning multiple strategy leaders. Partnering with risk strategy leaders, you’ll set the domain’s vision and multi-year strategy, deciding where to invest and turning outcomes like loss reduction, approval rates, and customer experience into product plans. You’ll be a leading voice in shaping our next-generation Risk Decisioning Platform. Near term, you’ll move strategies off legacy systems and ramp them to full production; beyond that, you’ll launch new strategies and use experimentation and automation to keep optimizing. You’ll lead cross-functional pods, track captured savings with business partners, represent the domain to executives, and mentor other PMs. You bring deep risk domain expertise, technical fluency, and executive presence.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Drives product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders consistent with the shared vision for the product or enabling platform.
  • Plans and implements the architectural roadmap that balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Assesses the customer experience and customer needs in product requirements and decision making.
  • Sets up data gathering mechanisms relative to the metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Leads workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Oversees product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Plans operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content strategists, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers.
  • Maximizes efficiency in a constantly evolving environment where the process is fluid and creative solutions are the standard.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Significant experience building products in fraud, account integrity, credit, or other risk domains, in close partnership with risk strategy leaders. 
  • Track record of setting a multi-year product vision and strategy for a business domain, balancing near-term delivery with longer-term bets. 
  • Experience leading product for a multi-team risk portfolio alongside business owners, and reporting outcomes to executive stakeholders. 
  • Deep knowledge of how risk decisions are made and tuned, including rules, ML models, features, and step-up and friction treatments, and the tradeoff between loss and customer experience. 
  • Strong quantitative skills: defining and interpreting risk metrics (loss, catch, false positive, and approval rates), prioritizing opportunities across a portfolio, and connecting product changes to business impact. 
  • Experience launching through controlled rollouts and experimentation, including champion/challenger tests and staged traffic ramps. 
  • Experience shaping platform roadmaps from the business side, turning domain needs into clear priorities for data science, modeling, and platform teams, and resolving competing demands. 
  • Experience leading major platform transitions, such as migrating risk strategies off legacy systems, while protecting performance. 
  • Experience mentoring product managers and establishing repeatable product practices. 
  • Ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive milestone-based delivery across many teams.

Job Summary:

What you need to know about the role-
As an iOS Software Engineer, you will build and maintain the PayPal POS app that small businesses use every day to take payments, run checkout and manage their shop. You will work on features across the app experience, from first sign-in and bootstrap to checkout, receipts, refunds and invoices, and learn how it connects to card readers and Tap to Pay on iPhone.


Meet our team
Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff
  • Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures
  • Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions
  • Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions
  • May contribute to code & design reviews

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Your way to impact

  • Make checkout and receipts fast and reliable for merchants who depend on the app at the counter.
  • Deliver features across product library, inventory, purchase history, refunds and invoices.
  • Help legacy Zettle merchants move onto PayPal identity with a smooth sign-in and onboarding experience in the app.
  • Improve app stability, release quality and crash-free sessions.

Your day to day

  • Build and ship features in Swift using modern concurrency; UIKit and SwiftUI as the product requires.
  • Integrate with backend services over REST and GraphQL; handle auth and session flows.
  • Work with Bluetooth reader connectivity (Core Bluetooth) and Apple payment frameworks under guidance.
  • Write unit and UI tests, and take part in code reviews, CI/CD and staged releases.
  • Investigate crashes and production issues using analytics and monitoring and fix root causes.
  • Pair with Sweden engineers and write documentation and runbooks for areas you take over.

What do you need to bring-

  • 1 to 3 years of iOS development experience with strong Swift.
  • Hands-on with SwiftUI and/or UIKit, networking, local persistence and concurrency.
  • Experience with unit and UI testing and CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps.
  • Understanding of secure handling of sensitive data on device.
  • Interest in payments; experience with in-app payments, Bluetooth peripherals or NFC is a plus.
  • Nice to have: Objective-C, GraphQL clients, Apple Tap to Pay on iPhone.
  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden.
  • A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records.
  • Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product.

Job Summary:

The Senior Director, Experience Design - Checkout will lead the design vision, strategy, and execution for PayPal's checkout experiences, shaping how consumers move through complex payment flows from merchant experiences through completion. This leader will guide a team focused on optimizing and evolving experiences at scale, combining strong design craft with experimentation, iteration, and systems thinking. Partnering closely with Product and Engineering, this role will shape roadmaps and outcomes, strengthen design standards and governance, and build a culture where designers effectively advocate for the customer while delivering simple, intuitive, and high-quality checkout experiences.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop and articulate a clear, compelling vision and strategy in alignment with Experience Design strategy and operations that inspires others
  • Oversee and direct the development of user interface plans with direct impact on PayPal revenue, expense, budget, and growth
  • Negotiate with and influence the decision-making of senior internal and external executives and decision-makers
  • Create operational and strategic objectives that enhance user and customer experiences using domain knowledge and extensive expertise
  • Provide guidance to critical cross-functional and cross-organizational teams focused on experience design across PayPal
  • Identify and resolve strategic user interface and interaction design with new or innovative solutions

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5 years of experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

PayPal is going through a once-in-a-generation transformation, creating a significant opportunity for a Design leader to help shape the next generation of interactions and systems for how humans and agents experience the world. This is a race to establish a durable system for the next generation of commerce as technology organizations shift and functions are redefined. Checkout is the proof point for when theoretical experiences become transactions that must meet regulation and navigate identity, compliance, safety, and security. PayPal shaped the first generation of putting money on the internet; we expect to equally influence and shape the next. We are looking for a leader who can hold big ideas while working tactically and incrementally - building, learning, and adapting in a rapidly shifting environment. Anchoring in first principles for customers and their rising expectations of experiences is a design challenge that has not been solved yet, and we are at the forefront of working on what that means around the world.


Role Scope & Priorities:

• Influence and execute on an existing 3-year strategy and work with cross-functional partners to set a design direction for PayPal's checkout experiences, delivering within and beyond the strategy, with a focus on flows, handoffs, and orchestration through completion.

• Lead the optimization and evolution of existing experiences at scale, using experimentation, iteration, customer insight, and strong design judgment to improve outcomes.

• Lead design planning, prioritization, and execution in close partnership with Product and Engineering, translating customer, business, and technical needs into strong design outcomes.

• Strengthen design systems, governance, standards, and review mechanisms to improve consistency, quality, and scalability across teams and products.

• Strengthen the connection between the Checkout design team and the broader Experience Design organization, raising expectations for craft, quality, and design advocacy.

• Build and develop a high-performing design team that can operate effectively in ambiguity, challenge ideas constructively, and ship, learn, and iterate.

• Represent Design with senior stakeholders, using strong storytelling, partnership, and influence to shape priorities and outcomes.


Experience & Capabilities:

• Significant product/experience design leadership experience, including experience leading design teams and managers.

• Demonstrated experience optimizing complex, existing products or flows at scale through experimentation and iteration;

• Strong, current design craft and fluency with modern design tools, with the ability to engage directly in the work, review designs, and shape frameworks and solutions. The expectation is that we are all makers and in the work, knowing how to scale through your team and having foundational knowledge of how the work gets done.

• Experience working within and shaping design systems.

• Demonstrated experience building, scaling, or significantly improving design systems, governance models, or design review processes.

• Strong track record partnering with Product and Engineering while maintaining a clear design point of view and advocating effectively for customers and design quality.

• Ability to operate in ambiguity, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and combine high craft with a strong commitment to delivery.

• Exceptional storytelling, communication, stakeholder partnership, and executive influence skills.

• Experience designing checkout, commerce, payments, transactional flows, or similarly complex digital experiences strongly preferred.

• 10+ years design leadership experience strongly preferred.

Job Summary:

The Sr. Manager, Global Accounts Solution Sales, Risk-as-a-Service partner with Account Management to grow adoption & transaction margin for PayPal's RaaS solutions within a focused portfolio of strategic accounts.

These solutions apply AI-driven risk models, built on transaction data from across PayPal's network, to help merchants protect revenue while preserving approval rates. Fraud Protection Advanced puts fraud decisioning directly in the merchant's hands with expert support, Chargeback Protection has PayPal assume that risk on eligible transactions, and Dispute Automation centralizes how merchants manage and contest disputes across payment providers.

This is a consultative role. The Specialist lead with diagnosing specific merchant needs before designing the solution & positioning differentiated value, building trusted-advisor relationships that expand adoption over time.

Success is measured sustained, profitable expansion within an assigned portfolio of strategic accounts.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex projects of diverse scope requiring an understanding of current business trends.
  • Participate in complex problem resolution and determine methods for new assignments.
  • Implement initiatives that result in global process improvements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product sales strategies.
  • Provide expertise in product knowledge and market insights to enhance sales efforts.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:


Additional Required Qualifications 

  • Extensive experience with transactional risk and fraud tools across the transaction lifecycle, and the ability to deploy the right combination of solutions to optimize for a merchant's unique needs; experience with Fraud Protection Advanced (FPA), Chargeback Protection (CBP), and Dispute Automation (DA) specifically is a bonus. 
  • A consistent track record of exceeding quota targets, ideally through growing and retaining large, existing accounts. 
  • A strong analytical mind, with the ability to build ROI-based business cases, account plans, and evidence-based sales narratives. 
  • Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams to structure win-win commercial outcomes. 
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders informally. 
  • Skilled storyteller, with the ability to communicate a compelling, value-based narrative to executive audiences. 
  • Proven ability to build trusted-advisor relationships with executive stakeholders and develop long-term account strategies within large, complex enterprise accounts. 
  • Expert in PowerPoint, Excel, and the Microsoft suite. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Ability to position FPA, CBP, and DA against competitive and in-house alternatives, and translate risk and dispute economics, including chargeback ratios and dispute volume, into a quantified, merchant-specific business case. 
  • 5+ years of experience managing and growing strategic accounts through solution selling to senior executives at Fortune 1000 companies, including experience engaging C-level decision makers across Product, Sales, and Finance. 
  • Experience selling or knowledge of omni-channel and in-store payments solutions. 
  • Expertise in getting the most out of AI, using AI tools to accelerate discovery, research, solutioning, and pipeline analysis, not just familiarity with them. 
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CRM. 
  • Financial analysis experience. 
  • MBA or other advanced degree in Finance, Business, or a related field. 

Additional Responsibilities 

  • Partner with Account Managers to develop and execute strategic account plans that identify, shape, and advance product-specific opportunities within an assigned portfolio of existing strategic accounts. 
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior merchant stakeholders, building long-term relationships and shaping risk, fraud, and dispute strategy across a focused portfolio of accounts. 
  • Lead regular business reviews that connect RaaS performance to each merchant's business outcomes and surface new areas of value. 
  • Lead deeper discovery, solution design, competitive positioning, and pricing construction on qualified opportunities. 
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities that require sound judgment and an understanding of current market and business trends. 
  • Carry the target for the strategic accounts in your portfolio, driving expansion, retention, and sustained growth. 
  • Leverage internal and external data to identify whitespace and expansion opportunities within existing accounts and build pipeline. 
  • Own and evolve the specialist team's playbook and selling process. 
  • Collect feedback and recommendations from Account Managers and strategic customers, and channel them back to Product and GTM teams to help shape future product roadmaps. 
  • Designs and positions the right combination of PayPal capabilities, not a single product in isolation, and translates that combination into a client-specific business case and quantified value against competitive alternatives. 
  • Uses sales pipeline, back-book portfolio data, and product and merchant performance data to monitor account health, prioritize expansion opportunities, build the commercial case, and support pricing decisions, treating data as the basis for prioritization, not a supporting exhibit. 
  • Builds credibility with and mobilizes Account Management, Solution Engineering, Integration Engineers, Finance, Legal, and Product without formal authority over those teams. 
  • Acts as a resource and force multiplier for other sellers, sharing knowledge of RaaS systems and operations, and guiding strategic merchants from adoption through ongoing optimization and expansion, with a focus on discovery and solutioning.

Job Summary:
