Job Description:

As a Machine Learning Engineer PhD Intern, you will work with experienced engineers, data scientists, and product teams to research, develop, and evaluate machine learning solutions. You’ll take on complex technical problems, work with large datasets, and contribute to model development and deployment. You should be comfortable applying advanced machine learning knowledge, communicating your findings, and collaborating to bring solutions into PayPal products and services.

  • Conduct applied research to identify and develop machine learning solutions for complex business challenges. 
  • Design, build, and evaluate machine learning models, using appropriate methods to assess their effectiveness, reliability, and suitability for use. 
  • Analyze data and conduct experiments to generate insights and guide model development. 
  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and cross-functional partners to translate business needs into scalable machine learning solutions. 
  • Contribute to the development and deployment of machine learning pipelines and solutions in production environments. 
  • Monitor model performance and identify opportunities to improve outcomes, reliability, and efficiency. 
  • Document research, experiments, and technical decisions, and communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Stay informed about developments in machine learning and assess their potential relevance to PayPal’s products and services.

  • Currently pursuing a PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field. 
  • Strong foundation in machine learning and statistics, with research experience developing and evaluating models. 
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.

Job Summary:

Machine Learning Engineer Interns at PayPal help develop innovative AI and machine learning solutions that support products and services used by millions of people every day. Working across PayPal, Braintree, Venmo, and Paydiant, our teams apply machine learning to complex challenges in connected payments. We’re looking for candidates with strong programming and analytical skills, curiosity about machine learning, and a desire to build reliable solutions that improve functionality, performance, and customer experiences.

Job Description:

As a Machine Learning Engineer Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers, data scientists, and product teams to explore and build machine learning solutions. You’ll contribute to data preparation, model development, experimentation, and deployment, with guidance from your team.   • Write clean, maintainable code and document experiments, results, and technical decisions.

  • Familiarity with data structures, algorithms, data analysis, or statistical concepts. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Job Summary:

The Indirect Tax Manager will be a key technical expert supporting PayPal's U.S. indirect tax strategy and compliance. This role is responsible for tax advisory, audit support, and technical analysis across sales & use tax, personal property tax, and gross receipts taxes for PayPal and its U.S. affiliates. The successful candidate will collaborate across Tax, Finance, Legal, Product, and AP functions—managing complex audits, researching evolving tax developments, and delivering timely tax guidance to business stakeholders. This position reports to the Director of Indirect Tax – Americas and is part of a broader global Indirect Tax team committed to building sustainable tax strategies and driving continuous improvement in tax operations.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Essential Responsibilities:
  • Oversee tax matters across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Partner with tax leadership to evaluate tax impacts of business initiatives.
  • Drive process improvements, systems enhancements, and best practices.
  • Provide technical guidance and training to team members.
  • Support audits and interactions with tax authorities.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Key Responsibilities


Tax Audit & Compliance Management

  • Lead or support sales & use tax, personal property tax, and gross receipts tax audits from initiation through resolution
  • Prepare comprehensive audit schedules, workpapers, and supporting documentation for auditor and government document requests
  • Manage audit timelines, stakeholder communication, and escalation of complex or high-risk issues to senior leadership
  • Coordinate with external tax consultants and internal teams (Accounting, Finance, Legal) to resolve audit findings

Tax Research & Advisory

  • Research and monitor changes in indirect tax law, regulations, and case law with potential impact on PayPal's business and affiliates
  • Provide timely, accurate tax guidance and technical analysis to Finance, Product, and Business stakeholders on indirect tax implications of new products, services, and business initiatives
  • Respond to ad-hoc indirect tax inquiries with clear written and verbal analysis
  • Support tax provision accounting and policy development for indirect tax matters

Tax Software & Systems

  • Advise on and support deployment of indirect tax software solutions (Avalara, OneSource, Vertex) for new products, services, and technology initiatives
  • Identify optimization opportunities in tax technology and systems

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Drive or assist in the preparation and analysis of complex, moderately cross-functional tax projects (M&A structuring, new market entry, regulatory changes, process improvements)
  • Collaborate with AP, Product, Legal, Accounting, and Finance teams to gather information, resolve technical questions, and ensure accurate reporting
  • Serve as an escalation point and trusted advisor for indirect tax questions across the organization

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • 7+ years of indirect tax experience, with demonstrated expertise in sales & use tax; prefer mix of Big 4/national accounting firm experience and in-house corporate tax roles
  • Advanced proficiency in indirect tax research tools (Vertex, CCH IRD, RIA Checkpoint, or equivalent)
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Detail-oriented with ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, data analysis, VLOOKUP) and Word
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a cross-functional team
  • Organized, proactive, and capable of managing ambiguity

Strongly Preferred Qualifications

  • Sales & Use, Personal property tax audit experience and management
  • Sales tax nexus analysis and multistate tax compliance
  • Tax provision accounting experience (ASC 450)
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or progress toward certification

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Canadian GST/HST compliance and audit experience
  • Value Added Tax (VAT) or international indirect tax experience
  • LATAM indirect tax experience (Mexico, Brazil, or other key markets)
  • E-commerce platform tax knowledge
  • Experience supporting financial technology or payments industry

Job Summary:

PayPal’s Cyber & Information Security (PCIS) team is looking for self-driven, detail-oriented Cybersecurity interns who will be aligned to specific security and risk teams. With access to cutting-edge technologies and resources, you will stay at the forefront of the ever-evolving cyber threat landscape. We strive to create a culture of security by empowering teams to take responsibility for securing their own code and environments. We do this by providing leaders and engineers with the visibility, tools, guidance, training, and support needed to create secure products and systems. We prevent, identify, and respond to critical vulnerabilities within our ecosystem, driving response to limit potential impact to the business.

As a PayPal Cybersecurity Intern, you will get the opportunity to work closely with a variety of security and risk teams, business partners, and stakeholders to drive high impact security and risk technology and services.

Job Description:

Your day-to-day role may include: 

Tech 

  • Implement and test Next Gen platform security products as part of SDLC to enable PayPal's product development. 
  • Perform quality code reviews to validate against the secure coding guidelines, ensuring that the code conforms to the design. 
  • Drive vulnerability analysis and remediation. 
  • Identify, drive, and implement security process improvements. 
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, developers, security architects, product managers, program managers, and other teams to deliver high-quality products. 
  • Stay up to date with the latest security trends, technologies, vulnerabilities, and attacks, and incorporate this knowledge into threat models. 
  • Determine the impact of vulnerabilities in our environment and how to communicate them to stakeholders across the company. 

Risk 

  • Understand and apply the enterprise policies, standards and framework for governance, risk & compliance and be an advocate of PayPal’s “Risk as a Lifestyle” philosophy. 
  • Execute based on the Enterprise Risk Management standard on how to identify, assess, mitigate, monitor, test and report on risks and controls required by the PCIS organization. 
  • Work with different stakeholders and external auditors to maintain up-to-date documentation for scoping, testing, and remediation of risks and controls across the enterprise.  
  • Work with the central technology controls testing team to validate key controls with stakeholders to provide an early warning to management for timely correction and remediation action.  
  • Assess audit findings / gaps, including control weaknesses in coordination with different stakeholders and assist with development of risk-based approach for management action plans.  
  • Support development of tools and solutions to enable Technology risk management across PayPal organization and continuously identify opportunities to bring in efficiencies in risk management function. 

What you need to bring: 

Overall 

  • Passion for cybersecurity and learning through asking questions and experimenting with different approaches 
  • Willingness to collaborate with team members and communicate effectively within a professional setting 
  • Ability to take initiative and seek out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills 
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced environment, in a self-driven manner, taking initiative and ownership to propose improvements and solutions 
  • Attention to detail, excellent analytical thinking, communication and time management skills 

Tech 

  • Basic understanding of secure coding practices and common security vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10) 
  • Experience with at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, Ruby, etc.) 
  • Interest in learning about application security, including security tools like SAST, DAST, and SCA 
  • Basic understanding of version control systems like Git 
  • Experience in working with large data sets to determine patterns and drive to key takeaways 

Risk 

  • Interest in learning risk management methodologies, frameworks, and principles (e.g., SOX, COBIT, NIST, CSA, ITIL, PCI, GDPR, etc.) to evaluate and recommend a best approach to mitigating risk with best-in-class controls. 
  • Innovate in the PayPal dynamic workplace by designing repeatable, sustainable processes that operationalize the risk management function

  • This is a Summer 2027 Internship program. Spring and Fall 2027 internships are not available.  
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

Job Summary:

This leader owns the invest side of Enterprise Systems & Employee Technology. That means how we plan, fund, deliver and prove the value of technology investments: the three-year and one-year plans, portfolio governance, program management, and the methodology and governance the delivery model runs on. The role also leads ESET’s move from a standard delivery model to fully AI-enabled delivery.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic oversight and management of program operations, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and driving innovation within the DCCE (Data Center & Cloud Evolution) space.
  • Oversee the traceability of data center assets, including power and space considerations, to ensure accurate planning and optimization driven by program outcomes.
  • Partner with business unit teams to strategically plan and implement initiatives that address technical debt, optimize underutilized resources, and improve data center workload efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on cloud-driven workload transformations, aligning efforts to optimize data center operations and reduce redundant resource utilization.
  • Evaluate and refine processes within operations, leading initiatives to build and implement the next level of operational improvements.
  • Manage and control production applications and services across all PayPal CN data centers, ensuring high availability and operational excellence.
  • Ensure site reliability by leading efforts to resolve cross-border operational issues in collaboration with global, cross-functional teams.
  • Create and implement robust processes to enhance production stability, leveraging software development to support production operations effectively.
  • Lead system monitoring initiatives by establishing standard monitoring policies, supporting event processing, and driving timely issue resolution to maintain operational integrity.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Responsibilities include: 

  • AI-enabled delivery transformation — Own the roadmap and operating model for moving ESET from standard delivery to fully AI-enabled delivery across the whole lifecycle: requirements and design, build and data, testing, go-live and cutover, and hypercare through handover to Run. Set targets by value stream and platform. Lead the change, including team shapes, roles and skills for human-plus-AI work. 
  • AI-enabled delivery process — Define, stage by stage, where AI is applied, where humans decide, and how work hands off, with quality gates, traceability and audit evidence at each stage. Cover requirements capture and solution scoping, design, data readiness and migration, test design and automation, release and go-live readiness, and hypercare triage and knowledge transfer to Run. 
  • Methodology and governance — Own the delivery methodology and playbook (SDLC, agile and hybrid) that all value streams follow, replacing local approaches: stage gates, definitions of done, production-readiness and release criteria. Own the governance framework around it at portfolio, program and delivery level: forums, decision rights, RACI, escalation paths and decision logs. Publish, train, assess adherence, and revise both as AI-enabled delivery changes the model. 
  • Tooling, enablement and adoption — Identify, standardize and enable the AI tools for each delivery stage, working with platform owners. Run training and enablement. Track adoption and outcomes by value stream, platform and stage, so every analyst, engineer, tester and consultant is augmented and the tools are used well, not just licensed. Build-level engineering tools sit with the Run-side lead; this role makes sure they fit the end-to-end process. 
  • Delivery economics and sourcing — Reset estimation, level-of-effort conventions, capacity plans and budget requests for AI-enabled delivery. Write productivity commitments into vendor and integrator contracts and track the savings. Plan the mix of employees, contractors, vendors and agents. 
  • Strategy and planning framework — Own the three-year and one-year planning cycles: gate criteria, business-case and solution-scoping templates, and entry and exit criteria. Turn ESET strategy and operating-model direction into plans each stream can execute against. 
  • Portfolio and investment governance — Set how investments are categorized (Run, Grow, Transform), prioritized, funded and reviewed, with CapEx and OpEx treatment built into the standard. Run the portfolio review. Partner with the Run-side lead on the Run, Grow and Transform mix and on Run capacity. 
  • Work classification and intake — Own the standard that classifies work as projects, managed enhancements or Run tasks by size and planning cadence, with one intake and clear routing to tooling, funding and capacity. 
  • Program leadership — Own plan, status and executive readouts for the highest-priority cross-stream programs. Surface risks and dependencies early and escalate with a recommendation. Coach program leads across the organization. 
  • Total-cost resourcing — Standardize how budget requests are built: current capacity plus new headcount and contract workers at a blended rate, reviewed by Finance before submission. Keep the portfolio of record (ServiceNow SPM) reconciled across the three-year, one-year and in-year views. 
  • Benefits realization — Define how committed savings, such as insourcing, vendor consolidation and AI productivity gains, are baselined, tracked to actuals and supported under audit.

Job Summary:

This leader owns operational excellence across Enterprise Systems & Employee Technology. That means the standards the estate runs on, one central view of how it performs — including every AI agent we run — and the accountability of each value stream and platform to its operational metrics, autonomy targets, ServiceNow adoption and productivity goals.

ESET (Enterprise Systems & Employee Technology) serves Finance, Sales, People, Legal and Core IT through business-aligned value streams, service streams and shared platforms. This role sits in the Strategy, Portfolio and Operational Excellence office of the Chief of Staff and reports to me (Pallavi Deshpande). It works horizontally across all value streams, service streams and platforms.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic oversight and management of program operations, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and driving innovation within the DCCE (Data Center & Cloud Evolution) space.
  • Oversee the traceability of data center assets, including power and space considerations, to ensure accurate planning and optimization driven by program outcomes.
  • Partner with business unit teams to strategically plan and implement initiatives that address technical debt, optimize underutilized resources, and improve data center workload efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on cloud-driven workload transformations, aligning efforts to optimize data center operations and reduce redundant resource utilization.
  • Evaluate and refine processes within operations, leading initiatives to build and implement the next level of operational improvements.
  • Manage and control production applications and services across all PayPal CN data centers, ensuring high availability and operational excellence.
  • Ensure site reliability by leading efforts to resolve cross-border operational issues in collaboration with global, cross-functional teams.
  • Create and implement robust processes to enhance production stability, leveraging software development to support production operations effectively.
  • Lead system monitoring initiatives by establishing standard monitoring policies, supporting event processing, and driving timely issue resolution to maintain operational integrity.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Job Summary

This leader owns operational excellence across Enterprise Systems & Employee Technology. That means the standards the estate runs on, one central view of how it performs — including every AI agent we run — and the accountability of each value stream and platform to its operational metrics, autonomy targets, ServiceNow adoption and productivity goals.

ESET serves Finance, Sales, People, Legal and Core IT through business-aligned value streams, service streams and shared platforms. Most Level 1 and Level 2 work is delivered by managed-service partners, and a growing share by AI agents. This role makes that model run predictably and transparently, with less human touch each year.

The role partners with the Director, Autonomous Operations, who owns end-user support and the service desk. This role covers applications and the end-to-end view on top, and sets the standards both follow. It also drives developer and consultant productivity: it identifies, enables and tracks the tools that augment every engineer, analyst and consultant, and measures whether they are adopted.

The role owns operational excellence across ESET: the standards the estate runs on, one central view of how it performs (including every AI agent we run), and each value stream's and platform's accountability to its operational metrics, autonomy targets, ServiceNow adoption and productivity goals. Most Level 1 and Level 2 work is delivered by managed-service partners and a growing share by AI agents; this role makes that model run predictably and transparently, with less human touch each year. It partners with the Director, Autonomous Operations (end-user support and service desk) and is the Run-side counterpart to the Senior Manager, Program Management, Strategy & AI-Enabled Delivery.

The role sets the standard, publishes the numbers, and holds leaders and their vendors to their targets. Those leaders own execution. This role owns the standard, the measurement and the escalation.

Success looks like one operational standard across the estate, every value stream running ITSM and CMDB in ServiceNow with clean data, one view of every agent in production, autonomy targets met and converted to cost reduction, tools adopted rather than just licensed, and audits passed with evidence the system produces on its own.


Essential Responsibilities include:

  • Run operating standards — Define and own the standards for incident, major incident, problem, change, request, knowledge and CMDB/asset management that every value stream and platform follows. One standard, federated execution.
  • Operational accountability — Run the scorecard that grades each value stream and platform on availability, MTTR, MTTD, change success, incident recurrence, corrective-action closure and CMDB data quality. Set targets, RAG bands and named owners. Chair the standing operational review, separate from the portfolio review. Escalate misses and drive remediation to closure.
  • Agent visibility across ESET — Maintain one central view of every AI agent run across all value streams and platforms: inventory, owner, purpose, performance, cost, incidents and controls. Set the standard for registering, monitoring and retiring agents. Report the view to ESET leadership.
  • AI Ops — Drive AIOps and agent-based workflows across applications and infrastructure: alert triage, runbook automation, incident investigation and post-incident review. Keep a ranked automation pipeline, require safeguards and traceability, and report realized benefit, not activity.
  • End-to-end autonomy targets — Partner with the Director, Autonomous Operations, who owns autonomy for end-user support and the service desk. Cover applications and the end-to-end view on top. Set and baseline yearly autonomy targets (human-touch reduction) for L1 and L2, track milestones by service area, ticket pattern and technology, and tie service cost reduction to autonomy actually attained.
  • Developer and consultant productivity — Identify the tools that make each role more productive, and work with platform owners to enable them. Track adoption and productivity outcomes by value stream and platform. Make sure every engineer, analyst and consultant is augmented, and that the tools are used well, not just licensed.
  • Major incident and problem governance — Coordinate executive-level escalations. Move the estate from post-incident review to proactive root-cause resolution, with owners and corrective actions tracked to closure.
  • Change governance — Chair the change governance forum and report change-success and emergency-change trends to executive leadership.
  • ServiceNow adoption — Make sure every value stream fully adopts ServiceNow for ITSM, CMDB and related workflows, on both process and data. Process: incident, change, problem and request run in the platform, not in side tools or email. Data: complete, owned and accurate CIs against the CMDB data-quality standard — coverage, ownership, accuracy. Measure adoption by value stream, work gaps with the platform owner and value stream leaders, and report it in the scorecard.
  • Vendor service performance — Hold managed-service providers to SLAs, OLAs and contracted autonomy milestones. Run service reviews with Sourcing and the responsible leaders.
  • Executive visibility — Own the operational data model and executive reporting, including the control-tower view. One source of truth, an auditable evidence trail, no hand-built decks.
  • Audit and control — Represent operations in internal and external audits. Build evidence collection into the scorecard and automate controls where feasible.
  • Executive advisory and coaching — Advise ESET leadership on run-side risk, remediation priorities and the operating-model implications of the numbers. Coach operations leads and engineers on SLOs, incident response, observability and production readiness.

Top Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • [8+] years in enterprise IT operations, service management: ITSM across incident, problem, change and CMDB; ServiceNow strongly preferred, including driving platform adoption and data quality across business units.
  • Operational governance without direct authority: led governance across multiple organizations or vendors, built a scorecard or standard that changed behavior, and managed outsourced or multi-vendor service performance against SLAs and contracted targets.
  • AI Ops and automation outcomes: delivered measurable automation or AIOps results (ticket deflection, MTTR reduction, cost reduction) and governed or monitored AI agents or automation in production (inventory, performance, cost, controls).
  • Hands-on with observability and incident tooling (Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace or similar);
  • Working knowledge of audit and control frameworks (SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, SOX IT general controls); drove adoption of engineering or productivity tooling and measured the outcome.

Nice to have

  • Financial services or another regulated environment
  • Applying AI agents or LLM-driven workflows to operations
  • Digital employee-experience tooling (Nexthink or similar) and service-desk automation
  • ITIL 4 Managing Professional, Lean Six Sigma, SRE or cloud credentials

Job Summary:

The Market RevOps Lead is an individual contributor who acts as the strategic RevOps business partner to the sales market leader and second-line managers. You are the person a sales leader thinks out loud with before committing to a coverage, quota or investment decision. You bring the assembled picture across compensation, planning, forecast and process, along with a point of view on what to do next.

Alongside your market, you will take on strategic projects that matter across IGM. A central operations and insights team and global owners build the models, definitions and standards. Your job is to make them work in markets they were not designed for and to carry those markets’ needs back into what they build.

IGM Markets span Asia Pacific, Middle East and Africa, and Latin America. You will be supporting a couple or more of key markets in Asia Pacific / Middle East along with running strategic projects that have an impact across IGM.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex projects to improve sales operations.
  • Analyze business trends to identify opportunities for process enhancements.
  • Implement new methods and procedures for special assignments.
  • Coordinate with global teams to ensure consistency in operations.
  • Mentor managers and provide guidance on project execution.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

What you will do

In market, you will answer six questions for the market leader:

  • What should we do about it? Be a thought partner. Frame the question before answering it, challenge the assumption underneath it, and bring options with a recommendation.
  • Will we make the number? Establish the forecast and inspection cadence, hold the forecast at market leader level, and drive accountability down to the rep and first-line manager.
  • Is the plan achievable? Translate revenue goals into coverage, territory, capacity and quota, and defend the outcome with sales leadership.
  • Can we sell faster? Diagnose friction across the sales lifecycle, from lead handoff to contract signature, and push the fixes through global owners.
  • Are we running it well? Run the market operating cadence and own QBR support, including the narrative, the decisions it asks for and the follow-through.
  • Did it actually stick? Lead change and adoption in market, and aim enablement at gaps the performance data shows.
  • You will also be the escalation point for complex deals and the link between sales, marketing, finance, risk and global teams.

Beyond the market, you will lead or co-lead strategic projects where your judgment and experience are most useful. These could be cross-market planning or compensation design questions, seller productivity, onboarding and risk process change, or whatever else IGM needs addressed. The balance between market work and project work will depend on the market you cover and on your strengths.


What you will bring

  • Judgment. You form a view with incomplete information and are accountable for the call.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You structure the problem rather than wait for someone to hand you one.
  • Thought partnership. Senior leaders seek you out, and you hold a view under pressure.
  • Business-model fluency. You can hold a strategy conversation at market leader level without retreating to data.
  • Influence without authority. Most of what you deliver is produced and adopted by people who do not report to you.
  • Project leadership. You can scope an ambiguous problem, line up the right partners, and drive it to a result.
  • Hands-on capability. You can build the model, work the data or draft the narrative yourself when a situation calls for it. It is not an everyday expectation, because most of the production work sits with the team around you.
  • Executive presence. You are credible in the room and willing to disagree in it.
  • Experience: 10+ years in sales strategy, revenue operations, finance business partnering or consulting, with exposure to compensation, planning and forecast.

Job Summary:

The Manager, Business Processes, SOX Program is a key leader within the Company’s Internal Audit SOX function and is responsible for transforming the delivery of the Company’s global SOX business process audit program, driving a shift toward a more efficient, technology-enabled, and risk-focused approach. This role will modernize how SOX is executed by leveraging data, automation, and AI, while serving as a strategic partner to the business and ensuring a high-quality, scalable control assurance framework.

This role goes beyond execution, it requires a top-tier leader who combines deep technical SOX expertise, business process mastery, and forward-looking innovation.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, drive end-to-end SOX strategy for business processes, and lead a high-performing team to deliver a best-in-class, scalable, and future-ready SOX program.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Manage audit assignments, including drafting audit issues and reports, socializing findings with management, and soliciting feedback
  • Facilitate issue tracking and validate closure of identified issues
  • Develop and maintain professional working relationships with colleagues, business units, and support areas
  • Stay updated on industry and business changes to inform audit plans, approaches, and risk assessments
  • Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls for regulatory and technology risks
  • Provide coaching, mentoring, and leadership to less experienced team members
  • Identify regulatory and technology risks and act as a business partner to relevant teams

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

·        Oversee annual SOX planning, including risk assessment, materiality, scoping, and timeline governance

·        Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing SOX team

·        Partner with external auditors to drive efficient, high-quality audits with minimal disruption

·        Oversee and optimize co-sourcing partner model and performance

·        Own and lead the end-to-end SOX lifecycle for business process controls (O2C, R2R, P2P,  etc.)

·        Act as the primary escalation point and decision-maker for complex control, audit, and accounting issues

·        Oversee end-to-end deficiency lifecycle, including identification, evaluation, and remediation tracking

·        Ensure internal controls are well-designed, scalable, and operate effectively across a complex, global environment

·        Drive continuous improvement and rationalization of controls to reduce redundancy and increase reliance on automated controls

·        Lead the development of SOX program reporting, including materials for Audit Committee, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and executive-ready messaging.

·        Lead complex technical accounting and process risk assessments, especially in areas of judgment and estimation

·        Anticipate and respond to business and system changes (e.g., new products, acquisitions, platform changes)

·        Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI, data analytics, and automation to reduce and improve risk coverage and precision

·        Develop framework to assess and mitigate risks introduced by AI-driven processes, including:

o   Model governance

o   Data integrity and bias

o   Explainability and auditability of AI outputs

·        Serve as a strategic advisor to Finance and business leaders on:

o   Control design

o   Process optimization

o   Risk trade-offs

·        Lead SOX readiness efforts for:

o   New product launches

o   System implementations (ERP, financial platforms)

o   M&A integrations

·        Provide forward-looking risk insights, not just retrospective testing

·        Build strong partnerships across Finance, IT, Product, Legal, and Operations

·        Communicate complex control and risk topics in a clear, concise, executive-ready manner

·        Influence decisions at the Director, Senior Director, VP levels

·        Set a high-performance bar, fostering accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement

·        Attract and retain top-tier talent, building a pipeline of future leaders

·        Drive a culture of ownership, curiosity, and operational excellence


·        Exceptional ability to:

o   Operate autonomously in ambiguous environments

o   Influence without authority

o   Balance strategic thinking with execution rigor

·        Proven track record of owning and scaling SOX programs, not just supporting execution

·        Demonstrated experience modernizing SOX programs (automation, analytics, AI)

Job Summary:

PayPal’s in-house B2B Brand and Creative team is hiring a Brand Program Manager to own the planning, governance, and delivery of brand and creative programs for the B2B marketing organization. You'll turn approved briefs into integrated program plans, manage external agency partners, and work across marketing, product, and events to keep high-visibility work on schedule and on brand. You'll also run the operating cadence behind that work and continuously improve how the team delivers. This is a program management role, not a production role.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Identify issues and recommend best practices for content creation and management within the team.
  • Understand merchant needs, strategic goals, and business objectives
  • Collaborate with team members to develop compelling narratives and visual assets that engage audiences.
  • Monitor and evaluate the performance of content initiatives and suggest necessary adjustments.
  • Stay informed about industry trends to ensure content strategies remain relevant and effective.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts and maintain regular communication with internal teams
  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality content

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

YOUR DAY TO DAY:
- Own delivery of brand and creative programs across marketing, product, social, communications, web, and events, from approved brief through launch.

- Build and manage timelines, approval gates, and dependencies, and surface risks early to keep high-visibility programs on track.

- Manage external creative agencies day to day, including onboarding on process and brand standards, consolidating stakeholder feedback, guiding approvals, and tracking scope and budget.

- Partner with the B2B team to develop program roadmaps and scalable operating standards, including intake, review workflows, and accountability structures.

- Plan creative capacity against demand, flag constraints early, and apply lessons from past programs to current work.

- Use AI-enabled workflows to streamline briefing, documentation, feedback capture, and collaboration, and scale the tools that improve speed and quality.

- Keep the merchant at the center of how programs are prioritized and judged.

 
WHAT SKILLS WILL HELP YOU BE SUCCESSFUL:
• Sound creative judgment, with the ability to apply brand standards in reviews and turn feedback from multiple stakeholders into clear, actionable direction.
• The ability to bridge creative teams and marketing stakeholders, speaking fluently about both the work and the business.
• Strong prioritization: you keep multiple programs moving in parallel, stay composed under pressure, and work independently.
• Rigor in planning, documentation, and risk management.


WHAT YOU BRING:
• 5+ years of program management experience in an in-house creative or brand team, a creative agency, or a marketing organization.
• Direct experience managing external creative agencies, including briefing, scope management, feedback consolidation, and delivery accountability.
• Track record delivering multi-workstream, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and approval stages.
• Working knowledge of B2B digital channels (paid, content, social, email, web), enough to plan realistic timelines, dependencies, and handoffs.
• Proficiency with project and collaboration tools such as Asana, Slack, Teams, and Microsoft 365, and comfort reviewing work in Figma.
• Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and work across time zones.
• Practical fluency with AI tools and a demonstrated interest in improving how teams work.
• B2B marketing experience (preferred).
• Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, design, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Job Summary:

This job is a sophisticated thought partner who uses specialized expertise to identify issues and recommend best practices. Leads functional projects and programs, partners where analysis requires an understanding of business trends, and contributes to business or process improvements within the function.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead functional projects and programs, ensuring alignment with business trends.
  • Identify issues and recommend best practices to improve processes.
  • Partner with various teams to analyze and understand business trends.
  • Contribute to business or process improvements within the function.
  • Develop strategies to enhance product sales and customer satisfaction.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Job Summary  

The Manager, Product Sales – PSC (Payment Services & Crypto) is part of the Commercial sales team, partnering with Account Management to grow adoption and transaction margin for PayPal's PSC portfolio across new and existing accounts in UK or DACH.  

The PSC portfolio spans four solution areas: (1) Payouts, including Enterprise Payouts for platforms and marketplaces disbursing funds globally via bank transfers, cards, wallets and local payout methods, and PayPal Payouts for self-serve batch payments to PayPal and Venmo accounts; (2) Risk-as-a-Service (RaaS), including Fraud Protection Advanced, Chargeback Protection and Dispute Automation, which apply AI-driven risk models built on PayPal's global network data to protect merchant revenue while preserving approval rates; and (3) Crypto solutions for businesses.  (4) Omni-channel pay-ins, which let merchants accept payment across online, in-app and in-person channels through a unified experience. 

Success is measured by profitable activated volume within assigned markets and verticals.


Essential Responsibilities  

  • Lead complex projects of diverse scope requiring an understanding of current business trends.  
  • Participate in complex problem resolution and determine methods for new assignments.  
  • Implement initiatives that result in global process improvements.  
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product sales strategies.  
  • Provide expertise in product knowledge and market insights to drive sales outcomes on enterprise deals.

Additional Responsibilities  

  • Partner with Account Managers to identify, shape, and advance PSC opportunities for new and existing accounts across the UK or DACH market.  
  • Lead deeper discovery, solution design, competitive positioning, and pricing construction on qualified opportunities.  
  • Design and position the right combination of PayPal capabilities across Payouts, RaaS and Crypto and Omni-channel, not a single product in isolation, and translate it into a client-specific business case with quantified value against competitive alternatives.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities that require sound judgment and an understanding of current market, regulatory and business trends.
  • Carry the target for the opportunities you develop or advance.
  • Use sales pipeline, back-book portfolio data, and product and merchant performance data to prioritize opportunities, build the commercial case, and support pricing decisions, treating data as the basis for prioritization, not a supporting exhibit.
  • Leverage internal and external data to identify growth opportunities and build pipeline.
  • Act as a force multiplier for Account Managers and other sellers, sharing PSC product knowledge and ushering merchants from lead to live.
  • Build credibility with and mobilize Account Management, Solution Engineering, Integration Engineers, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Product without formal authority over those teams.
  • Partner with product-line specialists to share best practice and adapt playbooks to local requirements.
  • Own and evolve the specialist team's playbook and selling process for the local market.
  • Collect feedback and recommendations from Account Managers and customers, and channel them back to Product and GTM teams to help shape future product roadmaps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience across two or more of the following: domestic and cross-border payouts and disbursements; transactional fraud, chargeback and dispute management; crypto or digital-asset solutions for businesses. Direct experience with PayPal's products is a bonus.
  • Ability to position PSC solutions against competitive and in-house alternatives, and translate payout economics (disbursement speed, payout method flexibility), risk and dispute economics (chargeback ratios, dispute volume, approval rates) and crypto use cases into a quantified, merchant-specific business case.
  • Working knowledge of the European payments and regulatory landscape (for example PSD2/SCA and, for crypto, MiCA) and of how it varies by market.
  • Acts as a resource and force multiplier for other sellers, ushering merchants from lead to live with a focus on discovery and solutioning.
  • Expertise in getting the most out of AI, using AI tools to accelerate discovery, research, solutioning, and pipeline analysis, not just familiarity with them.
  • 5+ years of experience solution selling to senior executives at large enterprises, including experience engaging C-level decision makers across Product, Sales, Finance and Risk.
  • A consistent track record of exceeding quota targets.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CRM.
  • MBA or other advanced degree in Finance, Business, or a related field.
  • Financial analysis experience and a strong analytical mind, with the ability to build ROI-based business cases and evidence-based sales narratives.  
  • Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams to structure win-win commercial outcomes.  
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders informally.  
  • Expert in PowerPoint, Excel, and the Microsoft suite.  
  • Skilled storyteller, with the ability to communicate a compelling, value-based narrative to executive audiences.  
  • Experience selling or knowledge of omni-channel and in-store payments solutions.

Job Summary:

PayPal and Venmo, leading destinations for consumer financial services, are expanding their consumer credit offerings. As Senior Legal Product and Regulatory Counsel on the U.S. Credit Legal team, you will be a trusted advisor to the business on PayPal and Venmo credit products, including Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), and other innovative new credit offerings. You will guide new products from ideation through launch, support BNPL growth through new partnerships, integrations, and agentic commerce, and help shape our response to a fast-moving BNPL legal landscape. This high-impact role suits a pragmatic, business-minded consumer credit lawyer.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide clear, pragmatic, and solution-oriented legal advice to enable business strategy while managing legal risk.
  • Participate in complex problem resolution, providing expert legal advice on high-stakes issues and disputes.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
  • Partner with business counterparts across the enterprise to help drive the delivery of effective legal services.
  • Manage legal risks and safeguard PayPal's legal interests, developing comprehensive risk management frameworks.
  • Escalate complex issues to senior legal leadership where appropriate.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 8+ years relevant experience and a Juris doctorate degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:


  • Serve as product and regulatory counsel for new and existing PayPal and Venmo consumer credit products, including BNPL and other emerging credit offerings, both closed and open-end, partnering with Product, Credit Risk, Compliance, Marketing, and Finance from concept through launch and ongoing operation, to include complaints and issue management.
  • Advise on product design, disclosures, underwriting and adverse action, servicing, collections, marketing, and customer communications to ensure compliance with federal and state consumer credit laws, including TILA/Reg. Z, ECOA/Reg. B, FCRA/Reg. V, EFTA/Reg. E, UDAAP, GLBA, SCRA/MLA, TCPA, and state lending, licensing, and other emerging product-specific laws.
  • Support BNPL expansion through new merchant integrations, platform partnerships, and agentic commerce, including review of sales materials and related commercial and program agreements.
  • Support government relations and policy efforts by analyzing newly enacted and proposed laws and regulations, assessing their impact on PayPal and Venmo products, and helping to prepare comment letters, legislative advocacy, and implementation plans.
  • Support regulatory exams, inquiries, and audits by federal and state regulators (e.g., CFPB, FTC, and state agencies), and help manage outside counsel.
  • Monitor and communicate emerging legal and regulatory developments in consumer credit and fintech, and develop practical guidance, templates, and training for business partners.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled tools to improve legal workflows and speed reviews.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as in-house counsel at a fintech, bank, or lender, or at a law firm with a consumer financial services regulatory practice, advising on consumer credit products from design through launch.
  • Deep working knowledge of TILA/Reg. Z, FCRA/Reg. V, ECOA/Reg. B, and UDAAP, and state law equivalents, with direct experience in BNPL, installment lending, or other short-term and small-dollar credit products.
  • Substantial FCRA expertise, particularly in credit reporting, furnishing, or consumer report use cases.
  • Familiarity with state consumer lending and licensing regimes and the evolving state BNPL legislative and regulatory landscape, as well as landscapes governing other emerging consumer credit products; experience with legislative or regulatory advocacy is a plus.
  • Experience supporting bank partnership or program-manager models and with regulatory exams and agency engagement (CFPB, FTC, state regulators).
  • Experience with commercial partnership and technology agreements, and an interest in emerging areas such as agentic commerce.
  • Strong business judgment, with the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical advice for senior business leaders and to balance risk with opportunity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable managing multiple high-priority projects in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Collaborative, proactive, and curious, with high standards of integrity and discretion.

Job Summary:

This job focuses on owning a defined area of an enterprise data platform that serves as the system of record for customer, session, and transaction data across multiple brands. It involves gathering client and engineering needs to define clear product requirements, and analyzing platform usage, data quality, and performance metrics to guide prioritization. Responsibilities include managing the product roadmap, leading planning, delivery tracking, and retrospectives, and driving client and data migrations from legacy systems to a cloud-native platform. The role includes monitoring platform health, adoption, and budget, and collaborating with engineering, architecture, data governance, privacy, security, and client teams to resolve dependencies and risks. This job is an individual contributor.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Uses data to build insights on product or platform requirements consistent with the shared vision for the product.
  • Gathers insights from the customer experience and customer needs to input to product requirements
  • Analyzes research, market analysis and usability studies, research and market analysis to support data-driven decision making
  • Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6 or more years of product management experience, including ownership of a data platform, data infrastructure, or developer-facing product at enterprise scale.
  • Working knowledge of cloud data architecture, especially Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with Spanner, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and change data capture pipelines is preferred.
  • Hands-on understanding of data platform concepts such as system of record design, entity resolution, data modeling, federated data architecture, API design (REST, gRPC, GraphQL), and caching and consistency tradeoffs.
  • Experience leading large data or system migrations, including cohort-based or phased client onboarding, cutover planning, and legacy decommissioning.
  • Experience working with data governance, privacy, and security requirements, including data classification, access control, retention, and regulatory obligations.
  • Track record of defining platform metrics such as availability, latency, data quality, adoption, and client satisfaction, and using them to guide decisions.
  • Ability to write clear, specific requirements and decision documents that engineering teams can act on without further interpretation.
  • Proven ability to influence without authority across engineering, architecture, risk, payments, and business partners.
  • Background in payments, fintech, risk, or financial services data is preferred.
  • Prior experience as a software engineer, data engineer, or data architect is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Advanced degree preferred.

This is a university intern position. You must be graduating in 2028 with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field from an accredited college or university.

Job Summary:

What do you need to know about the role

The Core Platforms Technology team is looking for a talented, self-driven, and analytically minded Business Operations professional. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, the Business Operations Analyst will partner with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams to improve operating discipline, generate actionable insights, and enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
This role combines business operations, data analysis, workforce and capacity planning, portfolio governance, communications, and program execution.

Meet Our Team

The Business Operations team supports the Core Platforms Technology leadership team and helps the organization operate effectively at scale. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Finance, People, Strategy, and other Business Operations teams to translate business priorities into measurable plans and coordinated execution.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead functional projects and programs to optimize operational processes.
  • Identify issues and recommend best practices for process improvements.
  • Partner with various departments to understand business trends.
  • Drive business or process improvements within the function.
  • Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.
  • Act as a point of contact or liaison between business leadership, staff, and other key partners.
  • Promote transparent reporting and foster a culture of data-driven decision-making by defining key metrics and evaluating progress.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities


In this role, you will:


  • Prepare, analyze, and interpret organizational and operational data, including workforce census, OKRs, KPIs, capacity, investment plans, roadmaps, delivery health, and other leadership reporting.
  • Translate data into actionable insights, clearly identifying trends, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for leadership consideration.
  • Create dashboards, executive presentations, and decision-support materials that communicate complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to maintain data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistent operating metrics.
  • Support annual and quarterly planning processes, including workforce planning, capacity planning, resource allocation, and scenario modelling for employees and contingent workers.
  • Support portfolio and operating reviews by tracking priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and follow-through.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring operational processes and reporting.
  • Use company-approved AI and automation tools to accelerate analysis, generate initial insights, synthesize information, and improve the efficiency of reporting and communications.
  • Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and business context, while adhering to applicable data privacy, security, and responsible-AI requirements.
  • Help develop and maintain operating playbooks, training materials, communications, templates, and best practices for the organization.
  • Develop leadership messaging for internal communications, organizational updates, operating reviews, and executive presentations.
  • Support employee engagement and organizational effectiveness initiatives in partnership with People Business Partners and business leaders.
  • Lead or contribute to cross-functional initiatives and special projects, from problem definition and analysis through implementation and measurement of outcomes.

What You Need to Bring


  • 5+ years of experience in business operations, strategic planning, analytics, program management, technical project management, or a related discipline, preferably within a technology or engineering organization.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into insights, recommendations, and executive-level narratives.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Working knowledge of data-analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Looker or equivalent platforms.
  • Practical experience using generative AI or AI-enabled productivity tools for research, data synthesis, reporting, communications, workflow improvement, or decision support.
  • Understanding of responsible AI use, including data confidentiality, output validation, bias awareness, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Ability to identify repeatable processes that can be simplified or automated using AI, workflow tools, or low-code solutions.
  • Strong execution orientation, with demonstrated ownership from problem definition through delivery and follow-through.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior executives and technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt quickly in an environment characterized by change and ambiguity.
  • Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a cross-functional, matrixed organization.
  • Ability to establish credibility, build trusted relationships, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to balance business partnership with constructive challenge and timely escalation of risks.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience supporting platform engineering, infrastructure, cloud, developer productivity, enterprise technology, or another complex technical organization.
  • Experience with portfolio management, technology investment planning, engineering capacity planning, or organizational health metrics.
  • Familiarity with automation or low-code tools such as Power Automate, Copilot, or similar platforms.

Job Summary:

You will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to enhance services through innovative AI/ML solutions. Your role will involve building scalable ML pipelines, ensuring data quality, and deploying models into production environments to drive business insights and improve customer experiences.

Job Description:

PayPal, Inc. seeks Staff Machine Learning Engineer in San Jose, CA 

Job Duties: Manage FSI Data Integration Project with Risk Models. Work with Infra and Online Engineering Teams to ensure the relevant features can and will be exposed to the different system checkpoints. Verify and validate exposure as online variables, such as existence and quality. Work with the Global Analytics and Data Science teams to enumerate the features. Perform feature comparisons to identify where the unique features engineered by FSI can provide measurable uplift. This work will scale across models for multiple fraud domains, including account takeover, collusion, seller risk, credit risk, and more. Work with model developers on a development plan and will ensure they are able to use FSI features and assist them in case of issues. Create a New Risk Model Based on Linking Features. descriptionHtml:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

Consumer financial services are central to the future of PayPal and Venmo. We have exciting new products in development and need an experienced consumer credit lawyer to play a key role in legal support for our evolving Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) business, fast-growing consumer revolving credit business, and innovative new credit products. As Director, Legal Counsel on the U.S. Credit Legal team, you will be a strategic advisor to product and strategy teams, guiding products from ideation through launch and scale, and help shape our response to a fast-moving legal and regulatory landscape. This high-impact role suits a pragmatic, business-minded consumer credit lawyer who leads by influence and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Provide strategic legal advice and support to senior management, influencing business strategy an decision making.
  • Anticipate regulatory and legal risks, and proactively design strategies to manage them.
  • Perform legal and regulatory compliance risk assessments, propose creative solutions where applicable, and help advance business objectives.
  • Manage escalations, collaborate across other teams and develop solutions to enable business partners to achieve their goals.
  • Develop a strong rapport and working relationship with business counterparts across the enterprise to help drive the delivery of effective legal services.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations, leading the adoption of cutting-edge legal technologies and best practices.
  • Manage legal risks and safeguard PayPal's legal interests, developing forward-looking risk management strategies.
  • Provide key inputs as an industry leader and expert, staying ahead of legal trends and influencing industry standards.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years relevant experience and a Juris doctorate degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Serve as product and regulatory counsel for PayPal and Venmo consumer credit products, including BNPL (closed-end), consumer credit cards (open-end), and other innovative credit products in development, partnering with Product, Credit Risk, Compliance, Marketing, and Finance from concept through launch and ongoing operation, to include complaints and issue management.
  • Provide legal support for credit underwriting and fraud strategy, including credit decisioning models and policies, adverse action and other disclosures, use of data and alternative data, and fraud controls, in partnership with Credit Risk, Fraud, and Compliance teams.
  • Provide fair lending support, including advising on ECOA/Reg. B and UDAAP considerations in product design, underwriting, marketing, and servicing, model and policy reviews, and fair lending testing and monitoring.
  • Provide legal support for incorporating BNPL and credit products into PayPal- and Venmo-branded checkout, including checkout experience and disclosures, merchant and partner integrations, and agentic commerce.
  • Advise on product design, disclosures, marketing and rewards, servicing, billing and disputes, and collections, to ensure compliance with federal and state consumer credit laws, including TILA/Reg. Z (including the Credit CARD Act), ECOA/Reg. B, FCRA/Reg. V, EFTA/Reg. E, UDAAP, GLBA, SCRA/MLA, TCPA and state law equivalents.
  • Support the relationships with bank issuing, program, merchant, and platform partners, including review of sales and marketing materials and familiarity with related commercial and program agreements.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to colleagues, develop practical guidance, templates, and training for business partners, and identify opportunities to use AI-enabled tools to improve legal workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience as in-house counsel at a fintech, bank, card issuer, or lender, or at a law firm with a consumer financial services regulatory practice, advising on consumer credit products from design through launch.
  • Deep, demonstrated expertise in consumer credit cards, BNPL or other closed-end installment credit, including TILA/Reg. Z, ECOA/Reg. B, FCRA/Reg. V, EFTA/Reg. E, and UDAAP, and state law equivalents.
  • Substantial experience advising on credit underwriting and fraud strategy, and on fair lending (ECOA/Reg. B, disparate impact, and model and policy review).
  • Experience advising on the integration of credit products into digital checkout and payments experiences, and an interest in emerging areas such as agentic commerce.
  • Familiarity with state consumer lending and licensing regimes and the evolving state BNPL legislative and regulatory landscape.
  • Experience with bank partnership or program-manager models, card network rules, and commercial partnership and co-brand agreements.
  • Strong business judgment and presence, with the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical advice for business leaders and to balance risk with opportunity.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, mentor others, and manage multiple high-priority projects in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; collaborative, proactive, and curious, with high standards of integrity and discretion.
